name: Elytron Surki

description.value:
The top layer of your carapace is especially mobile, and you can unfurl it to catch the air gracefully as you fall. You take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall.

  • Evolution Your shoulder nodes have evolved into a pair of spines that you can energize to project a pair of glowing wings. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} as an innate spell once per day, targeting yourself; while your wings are energized, you shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for the next 20 feet.
  • Evolution Your shoulder nodes have evolved into a fan of thin membranes that resonate when magic is coursed through them. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VPl4pifKcq7ecK87]{Stridulating Song} action.

_desc_en:
The top layer of your carapace is especially mobile, and you can unfurl it to catch the air gracefully as you fall. You take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall.

  • Evolution Your shoulder nodes have evolved into a pair of spines that you can energize to project a pair of glowing wings. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} as an innate spell once per day, targeting yourself; while your wings are energized, you shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for the next 20 feet.
  • Evolution Your shoulder nodes have evolved into a fan of thin membranes that resonate when magic is coursed through them. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VPl4pifKcq7ecK87]{Stridulating Song} action.
_desc_ko:
당신의 껍질 최상층은 특히 유연하여, 추락할 때 이를 펼쳐 우아하게 공기를 붙잡을 수 있습니다. 당신은 추락 거리에 관계없이 낙하 피해를 받지 않습니다.

  • 진화 당신의 어깨 결절은 한 쌍의 가시로 진화하여, 여기에 에너지를 불어넣어 한 쌍의 빛나는 날개를 투사할 수 있습니다. 당신은 하루에 한 번 자신을 대상으로 @link[spells.fly]{비행}을 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 날개에 에너지가 채워져 있는 동안, 당신은 반경 20피트에 밝은 빛을, 그다음 20피트에 어두운 빛을 발산합니다.
  • 진화 당신의 어깨 결절은 마법이 통과할 때 공명하는 얇은 막의 부채꼴로 진화했습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.stridulating-song]{마찰 노래} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Dog Kholo

description.value: You're a nimble-bodied kholo with a prehistoric, almost dog-like build. Though you typically move like a quadruped, you can still stand and fight like a biped, allowing you to use all equipment normally. If you have both hands free, you can increase your Speed to 30 feet as you run on all fours.

_desc_en: You're a nimble-bodied kholo with a prehistoric, almost dog-like build. Though you typically move like a quadruped, you can still stand and fight like a biped, allowing you to use all equipment normally. If you have both hands free, you can increase your Speed to 30 feet as you run on all fours.
_desc_ko: 당신은 선사시대적이고 거의 개와 같은 체형을 가진 민첩한 몸의 콜로입니다. 당신은 보통 네발짐승처럼 움직이지만, 여전히 두 발로 서서 싸울 수 있으므로 모든 장비를 정상적으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 두 손이 모두 비어 있다면, 네 발로 달리며 이동 속도를 30피트로 늘릴 수 있습니다.

name: Warden Human (BB)

description.value:
You and your family members are survivors, and you've learned how to take care of yourself. Pick one of the following benefits.

  • Add 4 to your maximum Hit Points.
  • You become an expert in Fortitude saving throws.
  • You become trained in medium armor.

Note: This heritage is from the Beginner Box and features non-standard heritage features

_desc_en:
You and your family members are survivors, and you've learned how to take care of yourself. Pick one of the following benefits.

  • Add 4 to your maximum Hit Points.
  • You become an expert in Fortitude saving throws.
  • You become trained in medium armor.

Note: This heritage is from the Beginner Box and features non-standard heritage features
_desc_ko:
당신과 당신의 가족은 생존자들이며, 스스로를 돌보는 법을 배웠습니다. 다음 혜택 중 하나를 선택하십시오.

  • 최대 체력에 4를 더합니다.
  • 인내 내성 굴림에 대해 숙련(전문가)이 됩니다.
  • 중형 갑옷에 대해 숙련(훈련됨)이 됩니다.

참고: 이 유산은 초보자 상자에서 나온 것으로 비표준 유산 기능을 특징으로 합니다

name: Spellkeeper Shisk

description.value: Your magical knowledge allows you to cast simple spells. Choose occult or primal. You gain one cantrip from that magical tradition's spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate spell at will, as a spell of your chosen tradition. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your magical knowledge allows you to cast simple spells. Choose occult or primal. You gain one cantrip from that magical tradition's spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate spell at will, as a spell of your chosen tradition. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신의 마법 지식은 간단한 주문을 시전할 수 있게 해줍니다. 신비 또는 원시 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 당신은 그 마법 전통의 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 얻습니다. 당신은 이 주문을 선택한 전통의 주문으로서 의지대로 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)과 동일한 주문 등급으로 강화됩니다.

name: Warrenbred Hobgoblin

description.value: Your ancestors lived underground. Your ears are larger than those of other hobgoblins and sensitive to echoes. While you're underground, when you target an opponent that is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from you or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from you, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one. In addition, if you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your ancestors lived underground. Your ears are larger than those of other hobgoblins and sensitive to echoes. While you're underground, when you target an opponent that is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from you or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from you, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one. In addition, if you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상은 지하에서 살았습니다. 당신의 귀는 다른 홉고블린보다 크고 메아리에 민감합니다. 당신이 지하에 있을 때, 당신에게 @link[conditions.concealed]{은폐됨} 또는 @link[conditions.hidden]{숨음} 상태인 적을 대상으로 하는 경우, 은폐된 대상에 대한 평면 판정 DC를 3으로, 숨은 대상에 대해서는 9로 낮춥니다. 또한, @link[actions.squeeze]{비집고 통과} 곡예 판정에 성공을 굴렸다면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Climbing Animal

description.value:
You are an animal whose limbs are adapted to grab, climb, and brachiate. You might be dexterous and ready to use tools like a chimpanzee or otter, or you may simply be a quick climber like a bear, raccoon, or sloth.

You have a land Speed of 20 feet, a climb Speed of 20 feet, and one animal attack of your choice (typically claw, fist, or jaws).

_desc_en:
You are an animal whose limbs are adapted to grab, climb, and brachiate. You might be dexterous and ready to use tools like a chimpanzee or otter, or you may simply be a quick climber like a bear, raccoon, or sloth.

You have a land Speed of 20 feet, a climb Speed of 20 feet, and one animal attack of your choice (typically claw, fist, or jaws).
_desc_ko:
당신은 사지가 붙잡고, 오르고, 나뭇가지 사이를 이동하기에 적합한 동물입니다. 침팬지나 수달처럼 손재주가 있고 도구를 사용할 준비가 되어 있을 수도 있고, 곰, 너구리, 나무늘보처럼 그저 빠른 등반가일 수도 있습니다.

당신은 지상 이동 속도 20피트, 등반 이동 속도 20피트, 그리고 당신이 선택한 동물 공격 하나(보통 발톱, 주먹, 또는 턱)를 가집니다.

name: Budding Speaker Centaur

description.value: You were born with a spark of magic that could set you on the path to becoming a Greenspeaker or Faithspeaker. Select divine or primal. If you selected divine, you're a Faithspeaker. If you selected primal, you're a Greenspeaker. This choice can't be changed. You gain one cantrip from the chosen spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: You were born with a spark of magic that could set you on the path to becoming a Greenspeaker or Faithspeaker. Select divine or primal. If you selected divine, you're a Faithspeaker. If you selected primal, you're a Greenspeaker. This choice can't be changed. You gain one cantrip from the chosen spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신은 그린스피커나 페이스스피커가 되는 길로 나아갈 수 있는 마법의 불씨를 가지고 태어났습니다. 신성 또는 원시를 선택하십시오. 신성을 선택했다면 당신은 페이스스피커입니다. 원시를 선택했다면 당신은 그린스피커입니다. 이 선택은 변경할 수 없습니다. 당신은 선택한 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 얻습니다. 당신은 이 주문을 의지대로 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)과 동일한 주문 등급으로 강화됩니다.

name: Arctic Elf

description.value: You dwell deep in the frozen north and have gained incredible resilience against cold environments, granting you cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

_desc_en: You dwell deep in the frozen north and have gained incredible resilience against cold environments, granting you cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신은 얼어붙은 북부 깊은 곳에 거주하며 추운 환경에 대한 놀라운 회복력을 얻어, 당신 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 동일한 냉기 저항을 얻습니다. 당신은 환경적 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극단적인 것으로 취급합니다(믿을 수 없는 추위는 극단적으로, 극단적인 추위는 심각한 것으로 등등).

name: Hunting Catfolk

description.value:
You come from a long line of skilled hunters and trackers and have a particularly keen sense of smell. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine a creature's location. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} a creature or object if you've smelled it before.

_desc_en:
You come from a long line of skilled hunters and trackers and have a particularly keen sense of smell. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine a creature's location. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} a creature or object if you've smelled it before.
_desc_ko:
당신은 오랜 세대에 걸친 숙련된 사냥꾼과 추적자의 혈통 출신이며 특히 예민한 후각을 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 사거리 30피트의 부정확한 후각을 얻습니다. 이는 후각을 사용하여 생물의 위치를 파악할 수 있음을 의미합니다. GM은 보통 당신이 생물의 바람 아래쪽에 있을 때 사거리를 두 배로 늘리거나, 바람 위쪽에 있을 때 사거리를 절반으로 줄입니다.

또한, 이전에 냄새를 맡은 적이 있는 생물이나 물체를 @link[actions.track]{추적}할 때 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Nephilim

description.value: Your nature is influenced by celestials, fiends, or monitors. This manifests as a combination of features that belie your heritage, such as golden eyes, a halo, horns, or a tail. You gain the nephilim trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from nephilim feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: Your nature is influenced by celestials, fiends, or monitors. This manifests as a combination of features that belie your heritage, such as golden eyes, a halo, horns, or a tail. You gain the nephilim trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from nephilim feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 본성은 천상체, 악마, 또는 감시자의 영향을 받았습니다. 이는 황금빛 눈, 후광, 뿔, 또는 꼬리처럼 당신의 유산을 드러내는 특징들의 조합으로 나타납니다. 당신은 혈통의 특성에 더해 네필림 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 저광 시야를 얻으며, 당신의 혈통이 이미 저광 시야를 가지고 있다면 대신 암시야를 얻습니다. 당신은 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 네필림 재주와 당신 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Kaleidoscopic Athamaru

description.value: Your scales are a spectrum of color that shimmers in the light. In areas of bright light or dim light, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Performance checks. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.0LwQufKtXfRda0BR]{Dazzle Seeker} reaction.

_desc_en: Your scales are a spectrum of color that shimmers in the light. In areas of bright light or dim light, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Performance checks. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.0LwQufKtXfRda0BR]{Dazzle Seeker} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신의 비늘은 빛 속에서 반짝이는 색의 스펙트럼입니다. 밝은 빛이나 어두운 빛의 지역에서, 당신은 공연 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신은 또한 @link[actions.dazzle-seeker]{눈부심 추적자} 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Whisper Elf

description.value: Your ears are finely tuned, able to detect even the slightest whispers of sound. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures within 30 feet of you. When you target an opponent that is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from you or hidden from you, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one. This benefit doesn't apply if you can't hear or if the creature is incapable of making sound (for example, if it's affected by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence} spell).

_desc_en: Your ears are finely tuned, able to detect even the slightest whispers of sound. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures within 30 feet of you. When you target an opponent that is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from you or hidden from you, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one. This benefit doesn't apply if you can't hear or if the creature is incapable of making sound (for example, if it's affected by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence} spell).
_desc_ko: 당신의 귀는 아주 미세한 소리의 속삭임조차 감지할 수 있을 정도로 정교하게 조율되어 있습니다. 당신은 당신으로부터 30피트 이내의 @link[conditions.hidden]{숨은} 또는 @link[conditions.undetected]{미탐지} 생물을 찾기 위해 @link[actions.seek]{탐색} 행동을 사용할 때 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신에게 @link[conditions.concealed]{은폐됨} 또는 숨음 상태인 적을 대상으로 할 때, 은폐된 대상에 대한 평면 판정 DC를 3으로, 숨은 대상에 대해서는 9로 낮춥니다. 이 혜택은 당신이 들을 수 없거나 생물이 소리를 낼 수 없는 경우(예: @link[spells.silence]{침묵} 주문의 영향을 받는 경우)에는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Littlehorn Minotaur

description.value: Though no less powerful, your frame (and your horns) are smaller than those of most other minotaurs. Instead of Large, your size is Medium. Your horns unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage instead of 1d8, but it has the agile trait.

_desc_en: Though no less powerful, your frame (and your horns) are smaller than those of most other minotaurs. Instead of Large, your size is Medium. Your horns unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage instead of 1d8, but it has the agile trait.
_desc_ko: 결코 덜 강력하지는 않지만, 당신의 체구(그리고 당신의 뿔)는 대부분의 다른 미노타우로스보다 작습니다. 대형 대신 당신의 크기는 중형입니다. 당신의 뿔 비무장 공격은 1d8 대신 1d6 관통 피해를 입히지만, 민활 특성을 가집니다.

name: Ponygait Centaur

description.value: You are smaller than most other centaurs, though no less fleet of foot. Instead of Large, your size is Medium. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saving throws.

_desc_en: You are smaller than most other centaurs, though no less fleet of foot. Instead of Large, your size is Medium. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saving throws.
_desc_ko: 당신은 대부분의 다른 켄타우로스보다 작지만, 결코 발이 덜 빠르지는 않습니다. 대형 대신 당신의 크기는 중형입니다. 당신은 반사 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Thickskin Tripkee

description.value: Your thick leathery skin resembles that of a toad. You gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against diseases and poisons.

_desc_en: Your thick leathery skin resembles that of a toad. You gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against diseases and poisons.
_desc_ko: 당신의 두껍고 가죽 같은 피부는 두꺼비의 피부를 닮았습니다. 당신은 혈통으로부터 6점 대신 8점의 체력을 얻습니다. 당신은 질병과 독에 대한 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Cactus Leshy

description.value: Spines cover your body. You gain a spine unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your spines are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: Spines cover your body. You gain a spine unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your spines are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 가시가 당신의 몸을 뒤덮고 있습니다. 당신은 1d6 관통 피해를 입히는 가시 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 가시는 격투 계열에 속하며 정교함 및 비무장 특성을 가집니다.

name: Dogtooth Tengu

description.value: In addition to a beak, your mouth also features a number of vicious, pointed teeth. Some legends claim your powerful jaws can even bite through steel. While you aren't that strong yet, your fangs can still leave terrible wounds. Your beak unarmed attack gains the deadly d8 trait.

_desc_en: In addition to a beak, your mouth also features a number of vicious, pointed teeth. Some legends claim your powerful jaws can even bite through steel. While you aren't that strong yet, your fangs can still leave terrible wounds. Your beak unarmed attack gains the deadly d8 trait.
_desc_ko: 부리에 더해, 당신의 입에는 여러 개의 사나운 뾰족한 이빨도 있습니다. 일부 전설은 당신의 강력한 턱이 강철조차 물어뜯을 수 있다고 주장합니다. 아직 그 정도로 강하지는 않지만, 당신의 송곳니는 여전히 끔찍한 상처를 남길 수 있습니다. 당신의 부리 비무장 공격은 치명 d8 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Venomshield Nagaji

description.value: Your intrinsic connection to nagas and mundane serpents grants you an innate resistance to toxins of every sort. You gain resistance to poison equal to half your level (minimum 1 resistance), and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against poison.

_desc_en: Your intrinsic connection to nagas and mundane serpents grants you an innate resistance to toxins of every sort. You gain resistance to poison equal to half your level (minimum 1 resistance), and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against poison.
_desc_ko: 나가와 평범한 뱀들과의 내재적 연결은 당신에게 모든 종류의 독소에 대한 선천적 저항을 부여합니다. 당신은 당신 레벨의 절반(최소 1 저항)과 동일한 독 저항을 얻으며, 독에 대한 모든 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Hunter Automaton

description.value: You were designed to serve as a scout or assassin and have a body resembling a pack hunter like a large cat or wolf. Though you typically move like a quadruped, you can still stand and fight like a biped, allowing you to use all equipment normally. Your quadruped design allows you to move quickly; if you have both hands free, you can increase your Speed to 30 feet as you run on all fours.

_desc_en: You were designed to serve as a scout or assassin and have a body resembling a pack hunter like a large cat or wolf. Though you typically move like a quadruped, you can still stand and fight like a biped, allowing you to use all equipment normally. Your quadruped design allows you to move quickly; if you have both hands free, you can increase your Speed to 30 feet as you run on all fours.
_desc_ko: 당신은 정찰병이나 암살자로서 봉사하도록 설계되었으며 큰 고양이나 늑대 같은 무리 사냥꾼을 닮은 몸을 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 보통 네발짐승처럼 움직이지만, 여전히 두 발로 서서 싸울 수 있으므로 모든 장비를 정상적으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 당신의 네발짐승 설계는 빠르게 움직일 수 있게 해줍니다. 두 손이 모두 비어 있다면, 네 발로 달리며 이동 속도를 30피트로 늘릴 수 있습니다.

name: Snaptongue Tripkee

description.value: Your tongue is especially long, and you can launch it with extraordinary range and precision. You can use your tongue to deliver spells with a range of touch and perform extremely simple Interact actions, such as opening some types of unlocked doors. Your tongue can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish, and you can't use it to hold items.

_desc_en: Your tongue is especially long, and you can launch it with extraordinary range and precision. You can use your tongue to deliver spells with a range of touch and perform extremely simple Interact actions, such as opening some types of unlocked doors. Your tongue can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish, and you can't use it to hold items.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혀는 특히 길어서, 비범한 사거리와 정밀도로 발사할 수 있습니다. 당신은 혀를 사용하여 접촉 사거리의 주문을 전달하고, 잠기지 않은 일부 유형의 문을 여는 것과 같은 극히 간단한 상호작용 행동을 수행할 수 있습니다. 당신의 혀는 손가락이나 상당한 손재주가 필요한 행동, 판정이 필요한 모든 행동을 포함하여 수행할 수 없으며, 물건을 쥐는 데 사용할 수도 없습니다.

name: Charhide Goblin

description.value: Your ancestors have always had a connection to fire and a thicker skin, which allows you to resist burning. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You can also recover from being on fire more easily. Your flat check to remove persistent fire damage is DC 10 instead of DC 15, which is reduced to @Check[flat|dc:5] if another creature uses a particularly appropriate action to help.

_desc_en: Your ancestors have always had a connection to fire and a thicker skin, which allows you to resist burning. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You can also recover from being on fire more easily. Your flat check to remove persistent fire damage is DC 10 instead of DC 15, which is reduced to @Check[flat|dc:5] if another creature uses a particularly appropriate action to help.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상은 항상 불과의 연결과 더 두꺼운 피부를 가지고 있었으며, 이는 당신이 화상에 저항할 수 있게 해줍니다. 당신은 당신 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 동일한 화염 저항을 얻습니다. 당신은 또한 불이 붙은 상태에서 더 쉽게 회복할 수 있습니다. 지속 화염 피해를 제거하기 위한 당신의 평면 판정은 DC 15 대신 DC 10이며, 다른 생물이 특히 적절한 행동으로 도움을 준다면 @Check[flat|dc:5]로 감소합니다.

name: Cavernstalker Kobold

description.value: You hatched in a warren with narrow tunnels that was also home to a being of primal earth energy, which has made you limber and flexible. When @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climbing} rock walls, stalactites, and other natural stone features, you move at half your Speed on a success and at full Speed on a critical success (and you move at full Speed on a success if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P04Hw8E6WAWARKHP]{Quick Climb}). This doesn't affect you if you're using a climb Speed. If you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}, you get a critical success instead.

rules.text: When you climb natural stone, you move at half your Speed on a success, and full speed on a critical success.
rules.title: {item|name}

rules.text: When you roll a success to Squeeze, you get a critical success instead.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: You hatched in a warren with narrow tunnels that was also home to a being of primal earth energy, which has made you limber and flexible. When @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climbing} rock walls, stalactites, and other natural stone features, you move at half your Speed on a success and at full Speed on a critical success (and you move at full Speed on a success if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P04Hw8E6WAWARKHP]{Quick Climb}). This doesn't affect you if you're using a climb Speed. If you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 원시 대지 에너지를 지닌 존재의 보금자리이기도 했던 좁은 터널의 굴에서 부화하여, 유연하고 나긋나긋해졌습니다. 바위벽, 종유석, 그 밖의 자연적 석재 지형을 @link[actions.climb]{등반}할 때, 당신은 성공 시 이동 속도의 절반으로, 대성공 시 전체 이동 속도로 이동합니다(그리고 @link[feats.quick-climb]{빠른 등반}을 가지고 있다면 성공 시에도 전체 이동 속도로 이동합니다). 이는 당신이 등반 이동 속도를 사용하는 경우에는 영향을 미치지 않습니다. @link[actions.squeeze]{비집고 통과} 곡예 판정에 성공을 굴렸다면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Liminal Catfolk

description.value: You've inherited a closeness to the far corners of the world, where the boundaries between dimensions grow thin. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to half your level rounded up. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Occultism checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about creatures that originated on planes other than the Universe.

_desc_en: You've inherited a closeness to the far corners of the world, where the boundaries between dimensions grow thin. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to half your level rounded up. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Occultism checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about creatures that originated on planes other than the Universe.
_desc_ko: 당신은 차원 사이의 경계가 얇아지는 세계의 먼 구석과의 친밀함을 물려받았습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.detect-magic]{마법 탐지} 소마법을 신비 선천 주문으로 의지대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)으로 강화됩니다. 당신은 또한 우주 외의 세계에서 기원한 생물에 대해 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]{지식 회상}을 하는 신비학 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Mottle-Coat Centaur

description.value: Your coat is mottled or striped, granting you natural camouflage in your home environment. Select a terrain from the following: arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, or swamp. In your selected terrain, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} and to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}.

_desc_en: Your coat is mottled or striped, granting you natural camouflage in your home environment. Select a terrain from the following: arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, or swamp. In your selected terrain, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} and to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 털은 얼룩덜룩하거나 줄무늬가 있어, 당신의 고향 환경에서 자연스러운 위장을 제공합니다. 다음 지형 중 하나를 선택하십시오: 북극, 사막, 숲, 산악, 평원, 또는 늪지. 선택한 지형에서, 당신은 @link[actions.hide]{은신} 또는 @link[actions.sneak]{잠행}을 위한 은밀 판정과 @link[actions.feint]{속임 동작}을 위한 기만 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Coral Athamaru

description.value: Coral covers patches of your body, which provides a natural layer of defense. Coral athamarus often choose Coral Symbiotes and other related ancestry feats. The coral plates are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of +3, and have the aquadynamic and comfort traits. You can never wear other armor or remove the coral. You can etch armor runes onto the coral.

_desc_en: Coral covers patches of your body, which provides a natural layer of defense. Coral athamarus often choose Coral Symbiotes and other related ancestry feats. The coral plates are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of +3, and have the aquadynamic and comfort traits. You can never wear other armor or remove the coral. You can etch armor runes onto the coral.
_desc_ko: 산호가 당신 몸의 여러 부분을 덮고 있어, 자연스러운 방어층을 제공합니다. 산호 아타마루는 흔히 산호 공생체 및 그 밖의 관련 혈통 재주를 선택합니다. 산호판은 판금 갑옷 계열의 중형 갑옷으로, AC에 +4 아이템 보너스, 민첩 상한 +1, 판정 페널티 -2, 이동 속도 페널티 -5피트, 근력 수치 +3을 부여하며, 유체역학 및 편안함 특성을 가집니다. 당신은 결코 다른 갑옷을 착용하거나 산호를 제거할 수 없습니다. 당신은 산호에 갑옷 룬을 새길 수 있습니다.

name: Sailfish Merfolk

description.value: The lower half of your body resembles a powerful sailfish, complete with a large dorsal fin. Using this fin, you can move through the water faster and leap farther. Your swim Speed increases to 30 feet. When you attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Athletics check, and you can Swim instead of Striding before attempting the jump.

_desc_en: The lower half of your body resembles a powerful sailfish, complete with a large dorsal fin. Using this fin, you can move through the water faster and leap farther. Your swim Speed increases to 30 feet. When you attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Athletics check, and you can Swim instead of Striding before attempting the jump.
_desc_ko: 당신 몸의 하반신은 커다란 등지느러미를 가진 강력한 돛새치를 닮았습니다. 이 지느러미를 사용하여, 당신은 물속에서 더 빠르게 이동하고 더 멀리 도약할 수 있습니다. 당신의 수영 이동 속도가 30피트로 증가합니다. @link[actions.high-jump]{높이뛰기} 또는 @link[actions.long-jump]{멀리뛰기}를 시도할 때, 당신은 운동 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 도약을 시도하기 전에 성큼걷기 대신 수영할 수 있습니다.

name: Caveclimber Kobold

description.value: You live in a vertically-oriented home, and you're a consummate climber. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You can use your clawed feet and tail to Climb, leaving your hands free. Additionally, if you succeed at an Athletics check to Climb, you critically succeed instead.

rules.text: When you roll a success to Climb, you get a critical success instead.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: You live in a vertically-oriented home, and you're a consummate climber. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You can use your clawed feet and tail to Climb, leaving your hands free. Additionally, if you succeed at an Athletics check to Climb, you critically succeed instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 수직으로 배치된 집에서 살며, 완벽한 등반가입니다. 당신은 전제 조건을 충족하지 못하더라도 @link[feats.combat-climber]{전투 등반가} 기술 재주를 얻습니다. 당신은 발톱 달린 발과 꼬리를 사용하여 등반할 수 있으므로, 손을 자유롭게 둘 수 있습니다. 또한, 등반을 위한 운동 판정에 성공하면, 대신 대성공합니다.

name: Forge Dwarf

description.value: You have a remarkable adaptation to hot environments. This grants you fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on).

_desc_en: You have a remarkable adaptation to hot environments. This grants you fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신은 뜨거운 환경에 대한 놀라운 적응력을 가지고 있습니다. 이는 당신에게 당신 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 동일한 화염 저항을 부여하며, 당신은 환경적 열기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극단적인 것으로 취급합니다(믿을 수 없는 열기는 극단적으로, 극단적인 열기는 심각한 것으로 등등).

name: Kanchil

description.value: You have the head of a mouse deer and hooves instead of feet, with a reputation for being clever and persuasive—able to get yourself out of sticky situations with wordplay and a bit of luck. You become trained in Deception (or another skill if you were already trained in Deception). You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie when specifically attempting to avoid danger or punishment (such as trying to convince a dragon not to eat you), to Deception DCs against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} checks to uncover such lies, and to initiative rolls when you roll Deception for initiative.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You have the head of a mouse deer and hooves instead of feet, with a reputation for being clever and persuasive—able to get yourself out of sticky situations with wordplay and a bit of luck. You become trained in Deception (or another skill if you were already trained in Deception). You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie when specifically attempting to avoid danger or punishment (such as trying to convince a dragon not to eat you), to Deception DCs against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} checks to uncover such lies, and to initiative rolls when you roll Deception for initiative.
_desc_ko: 당신은 애기사슴의 머리와 발 대신 발굽을 가지고 있으며, 영리하고 설득력이 있어 말솜씨와 약간의 운으로 곤란한 상황에서 빠져나올 수 있다는 평판을 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 기만에 숙련(훈련됨)이 됩니다(이미 기만에 숙련되어 있었다면 다른 기술). 당신은 특히 위험이나 처벌을 피하려 할 때(예를 들어 용에게 자신을 잡아먹지 말라고 설득하려는 경우) 거짓말을 하기 위한 기만 판정, 그러한 거짓말을 밝혀내려는 @link[actions.sense-motive]{동기 파악} 판정에 대한 기만 DC, 그리고 선제 판정으로 기만을 굴릴 때의 선제 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Shadow of the Sailor

description.value: Your shadow flits across the surface of the water, and so do you. You can walk on the surface of still water and other non-damaging liquids, moving at half your normal Speed. You can attempt to walk along the surface of flowing water as well, still moving at half Speed, but to do so, you must succeed at an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} using the DC of a Swim check to move through the water; on a failure, you fall into the water. This Acrobatics check doesn't use an action.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your shadow flits across the surface of the water, and so do you. You can walk on the surface of still water and other non-damaging liquids, moving at half your normal Speed. You can attempt to walk along the surface of flowing water as well, still moving at half Speed, but to do so, you must succeed at an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} using the DC of a Swim check to move through the water; on a failure, you fall into the water. This Acrobatics check doesn't use an action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 그림자가 물의 표면을 스쳐 지나가듯, 당신도 그렇게 합니다. 당신은 정지된 물과 그 밖의 피해를 주지 않는 액체의 표면을 정상 이동 속도의 절반으로 걸을 수 있습니다. 당신은 흐르는 물의 표면을 따라 걷는 것도 시도할 수 있으며, 여전히 절반 속도로 이동하지만, 그렇게 하려면 그 물을 통과하는 수영 판정의 DC를 사용하여 @link[actions.balance]{균형 잡기} 곡예 판정에 성공해야 합니다. 실패하면 물에 빠집니다. 이 곡예 판정은 행동을 사용하지 않습니다.

name: Steadfast Tanuki

description.value: Your pride in your true tanuki form knows no bounds. You gain your choice of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fsovjV7yFMGiVs6z]{Everyday Form} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.U8rjCtUuk6qhFyZs]{Teakettle Form} as a bonus ancestry feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your pride in your true tanuki form knows no bounds. You gain your choice of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fsovjV7yFMGiVs6z]{Everyday Form} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.U8rjCtUuk6qhFyZs]{Teakettle Form} as a bonus ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 진정한 너구리 형태에 대한 자부심은 끝이 없습니다. 당신은 보너스 혈통 재주로 @link[feats.everyday-form]{일상 형태} 또는 @link[feats.teakettle-form]{찻주전자 형태} 중 선택한 것을 얻습니다.

name: Farsight Goloma

description.value: Your eyes have adapted to see more in less than favorable conditions. You gain low-light vision.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your eyes have adapted to see more in less than favorable conditions. You gain low-light vision.
_desc_ko: 당신의 눈은 좋지 않은 조건에서 더 많이 볼 수 있도록 적응했습니다. 당신은 저광 시야를 얻습니다.

name: Thorned Rose

description.value: Your beautiful petals and seemingly smooth skin hide silent barbs to pierce the unwary. Your body is covered with wickedly sharp thorns to discourage those that might prey upon you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ncdryKskPwHMgHFh]{Wicked Thorns} reaction.

_desc_en: Your beautiful petals and seemingly smooth skin hide silent barbs to pierce the unwary. Your body is covered with wickedly sharp thorns to discourage those that might prey upon you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ncdryKskPwHMgHFh]{Wicked Thorns} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신의 아름다운 꽃잎과 겉보기에 매끄러운 피부는 방심한 자를 찌르는 조용한 가시를 숨기고 있습니다. 당신의 몸은 당신을 잡아먹으려는 자들을 단념시키기 위해 사악하게 날카로운 가시로 뒤덮여 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.wicked-thorns]{사악한 가시} 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Winter Catfolk

description.value: You have a thick coat of fur that protects you from the cold. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

_desc_en: You have a thick coat of fur that protects you from the cold. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신은 추위로부터 당신을 보호하는 두꺼운 털 코트를 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 당신 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 동일한 냉기 저항을 얻습니다. 당신은 환경적 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극단적인 것으로 취급합니다(믿을 수 없는 추위는 극단적으로, 극단적인 추위는 심각한 것으로 등등).

name: Abyssal Merfolk

description.value: You live far, far below the surface of the ocean. Your fish tail might resemble a viperfish or anglerfish, and you might have luminous eyes or translucent skin. Abyssal merfolk have an uncanny reputation, but they can exist in even the most lightless realms. You gain darkvision and are immune to the crushing pressure of the oceanic depths.

_desc_en: You live far, far below the surface of the ocean. Your fish tail might resemble a viperfish or anglerfish, and you might have luminous eyes or translucent skin. Abyssal merfolk have an uncanny reputation, but they can exist in even the most lightless realms. You gain darkvision and are immune to the crushing pressure of the oceanic depths.
_desc_ko: 당신은 바다 표면 아래 아주 깊은 곳에 삽니다. 당신의 물고기 꼬리는 독사물고기나 아귀를 닮았을 수 있고, 발광하는 눈이나 반투명한 피부를 가졌을 수도 있습니다. 심연 인어는 기이한 평판을 가지고 있지만, 가장 빛이 없는 영역에서도 존재할 수 있습니다. 당신은 암시야를 얻으며 대양 심해의 짓누르는 압력에 면역입니다.

name: Full Moon Sarangay

description.value: You were raised in a shamanic tradition transcending a single sarangay community or heritage. You spent your youth under the guidance of a shaman elder, who taught you to commune with spirits in the hope that you'll one day use that knowledge to advise and guide your people. Those from your tradition are priests or shamans who channel the spirits and see things others can't. You gain an ancestry attribute boost to Wisdom instead of Strength, and you gain an attribute flaw in Constitution instead of Wisdom. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ua0O6tQ3D5099mmH]{Folk Healer} ancestry feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You were raised in a shamanic tradition transcending a single sarangay community or heritage. You spent your youth under the guidance of a shaman elder, who taught you to commune with spirits in the hope that you'll one day use that knowledge to advise and guide your people. Those from your tradition are priests or shamans who channel the spirits and see things others can't. You gain an ancestry attribute boost to Wisdom instead of Strength, and you gain an attribute flaw in Constitution instead of Wisdom. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ua0O6tQ3D5099mmH]{Folk Healer} ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 단일한 사랑가이 공동체나 유산을 초월하는 주술 전통 속에서 자랐습니다. 당신은 어린 시절을 샤먼 원로의 지도 아래 보냈으며, 그는 언젠가 당신이 그 지식을 사용하여 당신의 백성을 조언하고 인도하기를 바라며 영혼과 교감하는 법을 가르쳤습니다. 당신의 전통 출신들은 영혼을 매개하고 다른 이들이 볼 수 없는 것을 보는 사제나 샤먼입니다. 당신은 근력 대신 지혜에 혈통 능력치 상승을, 지혜 대신 건강에 능력치 결점을 얻습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.folk-healer]{민간 치유사} 혈통 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Frilled Lizardfolk

description.value: You can flare your neck frill and flex your dorsal spines, Demoralizing your foes. When you do, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.W4M8L9WepGLamlHs]{Threatening Approach} action.

_desc_en: You can flare your neck frill and flex your dorsal spines, Demoralizing your foes. When you do, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.W4M8L9WepGLamlHs]{Threatening Approach} action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 목의 주름을 펼치고 등지느러미를 곧추세워 적을 위협할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 때, @link[actions.demoralize]{위협}은 청각 특성을 잃고 시각 특성을 얻으며, 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못하는 생물을 위협하려 할 때 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 당신은 또한 @link[actions.threatening-approach]{위협적 접근} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Sandstrider Lizardfolk

description.value: Your thick scales help you retain water and combat the sun's glare. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). Environmental heat effects are one step less extreme for you, and you can go 10 times as long as normal before you are affected by starvation or thirst. However, unless you wear protective gear or take shelter, environmental cold effects are one step more extreme for you.

_desc_en: Your thick scales help you retain water and combat the sun's glare. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). Environmental heat effects are one step less extreme for you, and you can go 10 times as long as normal before you are affected by starvation or thirst. However, unless you wear protective gear or take shelter, environmental cold effects are one step more extreme for you.
_desc_ko: 당신의 두꺼운 비늘은 수분을 유지하고 태양의 눈부심에 맞서는 데 도움이 됩니다. 당신은 당신 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 동일한 화염 저항을 얻습니다. 환경적 열기 효과는 당신에게 한 단계 덜 극단적이며, 당신은 굶주림이나 갈증의 영향을 받기까지 평소보다 10배 오래 버틸 수 있습니다. 그러나 보호 장비를 착용하거나 피난처를 취하지 않는 한, 환경적 냉기 효과는 당신에게 한 단계 더 극단적입니다.

name: Inured Azarketi

description.value: Your ancestors had to survive in polluted water that made every breath noxious. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). Furthermore, you can survive outside of water for 72 hours before you begin to suffocate.

_desc_en: Your ancestors had to survive in polluted water that made every breath noxious. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). Furthermore, you can survive outside of water for 72 hours before you begin to suffocate.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상은 모든 호흡을 유독하게 만드는 오염된 물에서 살아남아야 했습니다. 당신은 당신 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 동일한 독 저항을 얻습니다. 게다가, 당신은 질식하기 시작하기 전에 물 밖에서 72시간 동안 생존할 수 있습니다.

name: Adaptive Anadi

description.value: You descend from a line of anadi who worked to perfect their transformation magic, allowing them to integrate into a wider variety of cultures. Choose a common, Medium humanoid ancestry. Your human form is replaced with a form that matches this choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} feat for your chosen humanoid ancestry.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You descend from a line of anadi who worked to perfect their transformation magic, allowing them to integrate into a wider variety of cultures. Choose a common, Medium humanoid ancestry. Your human form is replaced with a form that matches this choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} feat for your chosen humanoid ancestry.
_desc_ko: 당신은 변신 마법을 완성하여 더 다양한 문화에 통합될 수 있도록 노력한 아나디 혈통의 후손입니다. 흔한 중형 인간형 혈통 하나를 선택하십시오. 당신의 인간 형태는 이 선택에 맞는 형태로 대체됩니다. 당신은 또한 선택한 인간형 혈통에 대해 @link[feats.adopted-ancestry]{입양된 혈통} 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Stuffed Poppet

description.value: You have little inside you other than cotton, sawdust, or dried leaves. You take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You have little inside you other than cotton, sawdust, or dried leaves. You take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸속에는 솜, 톱밥, 마른 잎사귀 정도밖에 들어 있지 않습니다. 당신은 떨어진 거리에 관계없이 낙하로 인한 피해를 받지 않습니다.

name: Snow Rat

description.value: You have a thicker coat and bulkier frame to defend against the cold, granting you cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

_desc_en: You have a thicker coat and bulkier frame to defend against the cold, granting you cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신은 추위를 막기 위해 더 두꺼운 털과 더 튼튼한 체구를 지니고 있어, 자신의 레벨 절반(최소 1)에 해당하는 냉기 저항을 얻습니다. 당신은 환경상의 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극단적인 것으로 취급합니다(믿을 수 없는 냉기는 극심한 냉기로, 극심한 냉기는 심각한 냉기로, 이런 식으로 처리됩니다).

name: Deep Rat

description.value: Your ancestors lived deeper underground than other ratfolk, granting you the ability to see in the dark. You gain darkvision.

_desc_en: Your ancestors lived deeper underground than other ratfolk, granting you the ability to see in the dark. You gain darkvision.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상은 다른 랫폭보다 더 깊은 지하에서 살았기에, 당신은 어둠 속에서 볼 수 있는 능력을 얻었습니다. 당신은 암시야를 얻습니다.

name: Stormtossed Tengu

description.value: Whether due to a blessing from Hei Feng or hatching from your egg during a squall, you are resistant to storms. You gain electricity resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You automatically succeed at the flat check to target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature if that creature is concealed only by rain or fog.

_desc_en: Whether due to a blessing from Hei Feng or hatching from your egg during a squall, you are resistant to storms. You gain electricity resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You automatically succeed at the flat check to target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature if that creature is concealed only by rain or fog.
_desc_ko: 헤이 펑의 축복 덕분이든 폭풍 속에서 알을 깨고 나왔기 때문이든, 당신은 폭풍에 저항력을 지닙니다. 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반(최소 1)에 해당하는 전기 저항을 얻습니다. 오직 비나 안개에 의해서만 은폐된 @link[conditions.concealed]{은폐} 상태의 크리처를 목표로 삼기 위한 무작위 판정에 당신은 자동으로 성공합니다.

name: Mistbreath Azarketi

description.value: You descend from azarketis who migrated to land environments that could support their need for water. Over time, your people adapted to life on land culturally and physically, even resulting in azarketis born with human hair like their Azlanti ancestors. You no longer need to be immersed in water every 24 hours to maintain your skin and can instead mist or wipe your skin with water to live comfortably. Your land Speed is 25 feet, but your swim Speed is only 15 feet.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en: You descend from azarketis who migrated to land environments that could support their need for water. Over time, your people adapted to life on land culturally and physically, even resulting in azarketis born with human hair like their Azlanti ancestors. You no longer need to be immersed in water every 24 hours to maintain your skin and can instead mist or wipe your skin with water to live comfortably. Your land Speed is 25 feet, but your swim Speed is only 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 물을 필요로 하는 자신들의 요구를 감당할 수 있는 육지 환경으로 이주한 아자르케티의 후손입니다. 시간이 흐르며 당신의 종족은 문화적으로도 육체적으로도 육지 생활에 적응했으며, 그 결과 아즐란티 조상처럼 사람 같은 머리카락을 지니고 태어나는 아자르케티까지 나타났습니다. 당신은 더 이상 피부를 유지하기 위해 24시간마다 물에 잠길 필요가 없으며, 대신 피부에 물을 뿌리거나 물로 닦는 것만으로 편안하게 살 수 있습니다. 당신의 육상 이동 속도는 25피트이지만, 수영 이동 속도는 15피트에 불과합니다.

name: Oathkeeper Dwarf

description.value:
Growing up, you never tried to lie to get what you wanted, and even when necessary, lying makes you uncomfortable. The especially faithful might even have thought that you were blessed by the dwarven god of duty, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.zhPhYge7VJbIlJvA]{Kols}.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} and to Perception DCs against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to you.

Furthermore, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to convince others you speak the truth when you are telling the truth, and you take a -4 circumstance penalty to lie and to your Deception DC against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}.

_desc_en:
Growing up, you never tried to lie to get what you wanted, and even when necessary, lying makes you uncomfortable. The especially faithful might even have thought that you were blessed by the dwarven god of duty, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.zhPhYge7VJbIlJvA]{Kols}.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} and to Perception DCs against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to you.

Furthermore, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to convince others you speak the truth when you are telling the truth, and you take a -4 circumstance penalty to lie and to your Deception DC against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}.
_desc_ko:
자라면서 당신은 원하는 것을 얻기 위해 거짓말을 하려 한 적이 없으며, 필요한 경우조차도 거짓말은 당신을 불편하게 합니다. 특히 신실한 이들은 당신이 의무의 드워프 신 @link[deities.kols]{콜스}의 축복을 받았다고 여기기도 했을 것입니다.

당신은 @link[actions.sense-motive]{동기 감지}를 위한 감지 판정과 당신에게 @link[actions.lie]{거짓말}을 하려는 시도에 대한 감지 DC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

또한 당신은 진실을 말하고 있을 때 상대에게 당신이 진실을 말한다고 설득하기 위한 외교 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 거짓말을 하는 것과 @link[actions.sense-motive]{동기 감지}에 대한 당신의 기만 DC에는 -4 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Riverside Tripkee

description.value: Your ancestors live in and on the water. You gain a 15-foot swim Speed.

_desc_en: Your ancestors live in and on the water. You gain a 15-foot swim Speed.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상은 물속과 물 위에서 살아갑니다. 당신은 15피트의 수영 이동 속도를 얻습니다.

name: Fungus Leshy

description.value: Your body was made from fungi that grows in the shade of caves and trees, and you are at home in dark caverns and warrens. You gain darkvision. You lose the plant trait and gain the fungus trait.

_desc_en: Your body was made from fungi that grows in the shade of caves and trees, and you are at home in dark caverns and warrens. You gain darkvision. You lose the plant trait and gain the fungus trait.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 동굴과 나무의 그늘에서 자라는 균류로 만들어졌으며, 당신은 어두운 동굴과 굴속에서 편안함을 느낍니다. 당신은 암시야를 얻습니다. 당신은 식물 특성을 잃고 균류 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Badlands Orc

description.value: You come from sun-scorched badlands, where long legs and an ability to withstand the elements helped you thrive. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JuqmIAnkL9hVGai8]{Hustle} twice as long while exploring before you have to stop, and you treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on).

_desc_en: You come from sun-scorched badlands, where long legs and an ability to withstand the elements helped you thrive. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JuqmIAnkL9hVGai8]{Hustle} twice as long while exploring before you have to stop, and you treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신은 햇볕에 그을린 황무지 출신으로, 긴 다리와 자연의 요소를 견디는 능력이 당신이 번영하는 데 도움이 되었습니다. 당신은 탐험 중에 멈춰야 하기 전까지 두 배로 오래 @link[actions.hustle]{서두르기}를 할 수 있으며, 환경상의 열기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극단적인 것으로 취급합니다(믿을 수 없는 열기는 극심한 열기로, 극심한 열기는 심각한 열기로, 이런 식으로 처리됩니다).

name: Kijimuna Gnome

description.value:
Your ancestors lived in the trees and fished in all the waters of Tian Xia. You gain your choice of the following benefits. Once made, this choice can't be changed.

  • You can climb any banyan. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} feat, and if you roll a success on the Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead.
  • You can catch any fish. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your ancestors lived in the trees and fished in all the waters of Tian Xia. You gain your choice of the following benefits. Once made, this choice can't be changed.

  • You can climb any banyan. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} feat, and if you roll a success on the Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead.
  • You can catch any fish. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.
_desc_ko:
당신의 조상은 나무 위에서 살며 티안 시아의 온갖 물에서 물고기를 잡았습니다. 당신은 다음 이점 중 하나를 선택하여 얻습니다. 한번 선택하면 이 선택은 바꿀 수 없습니다.

  • 당신은 어떤 반얀나무든 오를 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.combat-climber]{전투 등반가} 재주를 얻으며, 오르기를 위한 운동 판정에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.
  • 당신은 어떤 물고기든 잡을 수 있습니다. 당신은 15피트의 수영 이동 속도를 얻습니다.

name: House Drake

description.value: You have bright blue and purple scales, with silvery teeth and claws. Your jaws count as silver and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against fiends. You add Diabolic to your list of known languages.

_desc_en: You have bright blue and purple scales, with silvery teeth and claws. Your jaws count as silver and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against fiends. You add Diabolic to your list of known languages.
_desc_ko: 당신은 밝은 파란색과 보라색 비늘을 지녔으며, 이빨과 발톱은 은빛입니다. 당신의 턱은 은으로 취급되며, 악마에 대한 피해 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 당신은 아는 언어 목록에 디아볼릭을 추가합니다.

name: Tailed Goblin

description.value: You have a powerful tail, likely because you descend from a community of monkey goblins. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} as a bonus feat, and you reduce the number of free hands required to climb or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} by one.

_desc_en: You have a powerful tail, likely because you descend from a community of monkey goblins. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} as a bonus feat, and you reduce the number of free hands required to climb or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} by one.
_desc_ko: 당신은 아마도 원숭이 고블린 공동체의 후손이기에 강력한 꼬리를 지니고 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.climb]{오르기}를 위한 운동 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻고, @link[feats.combat-climber]{전투 등반가}를 보너스 재주로 얻으며, 오르거나 @link[actions.trip]{넘어뜨리기}에 필요한 빈 손의 수를 하나 줄입니다.

name: Hungerseed

description.value: One of your parents was an oni or a hungerseed. You possess a pair of horns, ranging in size from conical nubs to lengthy protrusions. You might have other signs of your parentage, such as colorful skin, fangs and claws, or a third eye in your forehead. You gain the oni trait. You gain a horns unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage and is in the brawling group. You can select from hungerseed feats and feats from your other parent's ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: One of your parents was an oni or a hungerseed. You possess a pair of horns, ranging in size from conical nubs to lengthy protrusions. You might have other signs of your parentage, such as colorful skin, fangs and claws, or a third eye in your forehead. You gain the oni trait. You gain a horns unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage and is in the brawling group. You can select from hungerseed feats and feats from your other parent's ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 부모 중 하나는 오니이거나 굶주림의 씨앗이었습니다. 당신은 원뿔형 돌기부터 길쭉하게 튀어나온 것까지 다양한 크기의 뿔 한 쌍을 지니고 있습니다. 당신은 색색의 피부, 송곳니와 발톱, 혹은 이마의 세 번째 눈 같은 부모의 혈통을 드러내는 다른 징표를 지녔을 수도 있습니다. 당신은 오니 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 1d6 관통 피해를 입히고 격투 무기군에 속하는 뿔 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 당신은 굶주림의 씨앗 재주와 다른 쪽 부모의 혈통 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Spined Azarketi

description.value: Your fins conceal launchable toxic spines. You have a spine ranged unarmed attack with the unarmed trait that deals @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage, has a range increment of 10 feet, and is in the dart weapon group.

_desc_en: Your fins conceal launchable toxic spines. You have a spine ranged unarmed attack with the unarmed trait that deals @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage, has a range increment of 10 feet, and is in the dart weapon group.
_desc_ko: 당신의 지느러미에는 발사 가능한 독성 가시가 숨겨져 있습니다. 당신은 비무장 특성을 지니고 @Damage[1d4[poison]] 피해를 입히며 사거리 증가치가 10피트이고 다트 무기군에 속하는 가시 원거리 비무장 공격을 지닙니다.

name: Nightglider Strix

description.value: You are a dedicated nocturnal avian, keeping watch and predating in the most lightless environments. You gain darkvision.

_desc_en: You are a dedicated nocturnal avian, keeping watch and predating in the most lightless environments. You gain darkvision.
_desc_ko: 당신은 빛이 가장 없는 환경에서 감시하고 사냥하는 철저한 야행성 조인입니다. 당신은 암시야를 얻습니다.

name: Trogloshi

description.value: You're adapted to the sunless regions of dense jungle forests and deep caves, with soft flesh lacking pigment and unusually clear crystalline horns. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TLuFqQwvnlJNeEsv]{Crystal Luminescence} ancestry feat.

_desc_en: You're adapted to the sunless regions of dense jungle forests and deep caves, with soft flesh lacking pigment and unusually clear crystalline horns. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TLuFqQwvnlJNeEsv]{Crystal Luminescence} ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 빽빽한 정글 숲과 깊은 동굴의 햇빛 없는 지역에 적응했으며, 색소가 없는 부드러운 살과 유난히 투명한 수정 뿔을 지니고 있습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.crystal-luminescence]{수정 발광} 혈통 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Deny the Firstborn Pursuit

description.value:
You swore a vow to shelter others from the First World's cruelties. Wise to fey's mind-affecting abilities, your vow grants mental resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and a +2 circumstance bonus to Nature checks to Recall Knowledge about fey.

Additional Edict confront cruel fey you encounter (as long as you have a reasonable chance of success)

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You swore a vow to shelter others from the First World's cruelties. Wise to fey's mind-affecting abilities, your vow grants mental resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and a +2 circumstance bonus to Nature checks to Recall Knowledge about fey.

Additional Edict confront cruel fey you encounter (as long as you have a reasonable chance of success)
_desc_ko:
당신은 다른 이들을 첫째 세계의 잔혹함으로부터 보호하겠다고 맹세했습니다. 요정의 정신 영향 능력에 밝은 당신의 맹세는 자신의 레벨 절반(최소 1)에 해당하는 정신 저항과, 요정에 관한 지식 상기를 위한 자연 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

추가 계율 마주치는 잔혹한 요정에 맞선다(합리적인 성공 가능성이 있는 한).

name: Sweetbreath Kholo

description.value: You're a striped, pale-furred kholo with oddly pleasant breath, which you can use to entrance your prey. You are trained in Diplomacy (or another skill if you were already trained in Diplomacy). You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} if the target can smell your breath.

_desc_en: You're a striped, pale-furred kholo with oddly pleasant breath, which you can use to entrance your prey. You are trained in Diplomacy (or another skill if you were already trained in Diplomacy). You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} if the target can smell your breath.
_desc_ko: 당신은 줄무늬가 있고 옅은 털을 지닌 콜로로, 묘하게 기분 좋은 숨결을 지녀 이를 이용해 사냥감을 홀릴 수 있습니다. 당신은 외교에 숙련되어 있습니다(이미 외교에 숙련되어 있었다면 다른 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다). 또한 목표가 당신의 숨결을 맡을 수 있다면 @link[actions.make-an-impression]{인상 남기기} 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Breaker Surki

description.value:
Your claws are especially hard and can break through earth and predators alike. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, unarmed, and versatile B traits.

  • Evolution Your wrist nodes project magic into a durable digging wedge. You can spend an Interact action to increase your claw unarmed attack's damage to 1d6; grant it the magical, razing, and versatile force traits; and remove the agile trait. You can spend another action to deactivate the wedge and return your claw to its normal statistics.
  • Evolution Your ankle nodes can emit grounding claw spikes of magic to hold you in place. If any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you can choose to move only half the distance. The extra traction from your claw spikes allows you to Climb with one hand occupied (or with both hands occupied if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} feat). You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kWrks0NxMQH39JHD]{Trench Digging} reaction.

_desc_en:
Your claws are especially hard and can break through earth and predators alike. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, unarmed, and versatile B traits.

  • Evolution Your wrist nodes project magic into a durable digging wedge. You can spend an Interact action to increase your claw unarmed attack's damage to 1d6; grant it the magical, razing, and versatile force traits; and remove the agile trait. You can spend another action to deactivate the wedge and return your claw to its normal statistics.
  • Evolution Your ankle nodes can emit grounding claw spikes of magic to hold you in place. If any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you can choose to move only half the distance. The extra traction from your claw spikes allows you to Climb with one hand occupied (or with both hands occupied if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} feat). You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kWrks0NxMQH39JHD]{Trench Digging} reaction.
_desc_ko:
당신의 발톱은 유난히 단단하여 흙과 포식자를 모두 뚫을 수 있습니다. 당신은 1d4 참격 피해를 입히는 발톱 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 발톱은 격투 무기군에 속하며 민첩, 섬세, 비무장, 다용도 B 특성을 지닙니다.

  • 진화 당신의 손목 마디가 마법을 내구성 있는 굴착 쐐기로 발산합니다. 당신은 상호작용 행동을 소비하여 발톱 비무장 공격의 피해를 1d6으로 증가시키고, 마법, 파괴, 다용도 역장 특성을 부여하며, 민첩 특성을 제거할 수 있습니다. 당신은 또 다른 행동을 소비하여 쐐기를 비활성화하고 발톱을 정상 수치로 되돌릴 수 있습니다.
  • 진화 당신의 발목 마디가 마법의 고정용 발톱 가시를 내뿜어 당신을 제자리에 붙들 수 있습니다. 어떤 효과가 당신을 10피트 이상 이동하게 강제한다면, 당신은 그 거리의 절반만 이동하도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 발톱 가시가 주는 추가 마찰력 덕분에 당신은 한 손이 차 있어도(또는 @link[feats.combat-climber]{전투 등반가} 재주가 있다면 양손이 모두 차 있어도) 오르기를 할 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.trench-digging]{참호 파기} 반응행동을 얻습니다.

name: Steelskin Hobgoblin

description.value: When you are cut or burned, your body responds by forming tough but flexible callouses over the site of the injury. Over time, this makes the most vulnerable sections of your body harder and more resistant to damage. Many steelskin hobgoblins intentionally use blades and flame to scar themselves in intricate patterns, though this isn't universal. Your flat check to recover from persistent physical (including bleed), energy, or poison damage is DC 13 (rather than DC 15), or @Check[flat|dc:8] when provided particularly effective assistance.

_desc_en: When you are cut or burned, your body responds by forming tough but flexible callouses over the site of the injury. Over time, this makes the most vulnerable sections of your body harder and more resistant to damage. Many steelskin hobgoblins intentionally use blades and flame to scar themselves in intricate patterns, though this isn't universal. Your flat check to recover from persistent physical (including bleed), energy, or poison damage is DC 13 (rather than DC 15), or @Check[flat|dc:8] when provided particularly effective assistance.
_desc_ko: 당신이 베이거나 화상을 입으면, 당신의 몸은 부상 부위 위에 질기지만 유연한 굳은살을 형성하여 반응합니다. 시간이 흐르며 이는 당신 몸에서 가장 취약한 부위를 더 단단하고 피해에 더 저항력 있게 만듭니다. 많은 강철피부 홉고블린은 칼날과 불꽃을 이용해 정교한 무늬로 일부러 흉터를 내지만, 이것이 보편적이지는 않습니다. 지속적인 물리(출혈 포함), 에너지, 또는 독 피해에서 회복하기 위한 당신의 무작위 판정은 DC 15가 아니라 DC 13이며, 특히 효과적인 도움을 받을 때는 @Check[flat|dc:8]입니다.

name: Waxing Moon Sarangay

description.value: Your ancestors dwelled in the swamps, fens, and flooded forests, where they contended with fierce predators and formed raiding parties to claim scarce resources. Blessed by the growing crescent, you're one of the eviscerators, and you can overcome threats that lurk in murky waters as well as those that hunt on land. You're a powerful swimmer with brown or gray fur and backward- or downward-curving horns. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your ancestors dwelled in the swamps, fens, and flooded forests, where they contended with fierce predators and formed raiding parties to claim scarce resources. Blessed by the growing crescent, you're one of the eviscerators, and you can overcome threats that lurk in murky waters as well as those that hunt on land. You're a powerful swimmer with brown or gray fur and backward- or downward-curving horns. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상은 늪지, 습지, 물에 잠긴 숲에서 살며 사나운 포식자와 다투고 희소한 자원을 차지하기 위해 습격대를 이루었습니다. 커져가는 초승달의 축복을 받은 당신은 도살자 중 하나이며, 탁한 물속에 숨어 있는 위협뿐 아니라 육지에서 사냥하는 위협도 극복할 수 있습니다. 당신은 갈색 또는 회색 털과 뒤로 혹은 아래로 굽은 뿔을 지닌 강력한 수영꾼입니다. 당신은 @link[actions.long-jump]{멀리 뛰기} 또는 @link[actions.swim]{수영}을 위한 운동 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Keen-Venom Vishkanya

description.value: You're practiced with using your venom in combat, allowing you to employ your venom at a moment's notice. Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.s4V7JWSMF9JPJAeX]{Envenom} action doesn't trigger reactions that normally trigger on a manipulate action. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.B7wDxyjX66JkiCOV]{Venom Draw} action.

_desc_en: You're practiced with using your venom in combat, allowing you to employ your venom at a moment's notice. Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.s4V7JWSMF9JPJAeX]{Envenom} action doesn't trigger reactions that normally trigger on a manipulate action. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.B7wDxyjX66JkiCOV]{Venom Draw} action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 전투에서 자신의 독을 사용하는 데 능숙하여, 순식간에 독을 쓸 수 있습니다. 당신의 @link[actions.envenom]{독 바르기} 행동은 일반적으로 조작 행동에 반응하는 반응행동을 유발하지 않습니다. 또한 당신은 @link[actions.venom-draw]{독 뽑기} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Polyglot Android

description.value: You were preprogrammed with a multitude of linguistic proficiencies, likely to act as a translator. You learn two new languages, chosen from common languages and any uncommon languages you have access to. These languages take the same form (signed or spoken) as your other languages. If you select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} feat, you learn three new languages instead of two.

_desc_en: You were preprogrammed with a multitude of linguistic proficiencies, likely to act as a translator. You learn two new languages, chosen from common languages and any uncommon languages you have access to. These languages take the same form (signed or spoken) as your other languages. If you select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} feat, you learn three new languages instead of two.
_desc_ko: 당신은 아마도 통역가 역할을 하도록 다수의 언어 숙련도가 사전 프로그래밍되었습니다. 당신은 일반 언어와 당신이 접근할 수 있는 비일반 언어 중에서 선택한 두 개의 새 언어를 배웁니다. 이 언어들은 당신의 다른 언어와 같은 형태(수화 또는 구어)를 취합니다. 당신이 @link[feats.multilingual]{다중언어} 재주를 선택하면, 당신은 두 개 대신 세 개의 새 언어를 배웁니다.

name: Ragdyan Vanara

description.value: Keepers of traditions and tellers of ancient tales, your family traces its lineage to those born directly from Ragdya's whims. When you speak, others are inclined to listen to you, perhaps due to the divine spark of your connection to Ragdya. You gain one cantrip from the divine spell list; this cantrip can't deal damage or otherwise cause direct harm. You can cast this spell as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: Keepers of traditions and tellers of ancient tales, your family traces its lineage to those born directly from Ragdya's whims. When you speak, others are inclined to listen to you, perhaps due to the divine spark of your connection to Ragdya. You gain one cantrip from the divine spell list; this cantrip can't deal damage or otherwise cause direct harm. You can cast this spell as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 전통의 수호자이자 고대 이야기의 전달자인 당신의 가문은 그 혈통을 라그디아의 변덕에서 직접 태어난 이들에게 두고 있습니다. 당신이 말할 때 다른 이들은 당신에게 귀 기울이려 하는데, 아마도 라그디아와의 연결이 지닌 신성한 불꽃 때문일 것입니다. 당신은 신성 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 얻습니다. 이 소마법은 피해를 입히거나 그 외의 방식으로 직접적인 해를 끼칠 수 없습니다. 당신은 이 주문을 신성 내재 주문으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다.

name: Mutated Fleshwarp

description.value: Transformed by uncontrolled magic, you originated in a the Mana Wastes or another region similarly devastated by uncontrolled magic. Due to your toughened or redundant organs, the DC for your checks to recover from persistent bleed damage is 10 instead of 15, and it's reduced to @Check[flat|dc:5] instead of 10 if you have particularly effective assistance recovering from the persistent damage.

_desc_en: Transformed by uncontrolled magic, you originated in a the Mana Wastes or another region similarly devastated by uncontrolled magic. Due to your toughened or redundant organs, the DC for your checks to recover from persistent bleed damage is 10 instead of 15, and it's reduced to @Check[flat|dc:5] instead of 10 if you have particularly effective assistance recovering from the persistent damage.
_desc_ko: 통제되지 않은 마법에 의해 변형된 당신은 마나 황무지 또는 통제되지 않은 마법으로 비슷하게 황폐해진 다른 지역에서 유래했습니다. 강인해지거나 여분으로 갖춰진 장기 덕분에, 지속적인 출혈 피해에서 회복하기 위한 당신의 판정 DC는 15가 아니라 10이며, 지속 피해에서 회복하는 데 특히 효과적인 도움을 받는다면 10 대신 @Check[flat|dc:5]로 감소합니다.

name: Ancient Ash

description.value: Your memory is sharp and clear, and you remember so much. You remember the calm before the storm and the soil after the rain, the acrid tang of magic and the whisper of a song. You remember it all. You become trained in one skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become an expert in that skill.

_desc_en: Your memory is sharp and clear, and you remember so much. You remember the calm before the storm and the soil after the rain, the acrid tang of magic and the whisper of a song. You remember it all. You become trained in one skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become an expert in that skill.
_desc_ko: 당신의 기억은 예리하고 선명하며, 당신은 아주 많은 것을 기억합니다. 당신은 폭풍 전의 고요함과 비 온 뒤의 흙, 마법의 매캐한 냄새와 노래의 속삭임을 기억합니다. 당신은 그 모든 것을 기억합니다. 당신은 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 5레벨에 당신은 그 기술의 전문가가 됩니다.

name: Root Leshy

description.value: Your body is made from hardy roots that attach you firmly to the ground. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8. You can go without sunlight for 2 weeks before you begin to starve. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to move you or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

_desc_en: Your body is made from hardy roots that attach you firmly to the ground. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8. You can go without sunlight for 2 weeks before you begin to starve. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to move you or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 당신을 땅에 단단히 고정하는 억센 뿌리로 만들어졌습니다. 당신은 혈통으로부터 8이 아니라 10의 체력을 얻습니다. 당신은 굶주리기 시작하기 전까지 2주 동안 햇빛 없이 지낼 수 있습니다. 당신은 자신을 @link[actions.reposition]{재배치}, @link[actions.shove]{밀치기}, 또는 @link[actions.trip]{넘어뜨리기}하려는 시도에 대한 당신의 인내 또는 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 당신을 이동시키거나 @link[conditions.prone]{넘어짐} 상태로 만들려는 주문이나 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에도 적용됩니다.

name: Quilled Athamaru

description.value: Sharp quills on your head can pierce your foes deeply. Most athamarus use such quills for defense, but a well-timed headbash can be devastatingly effective. You gain a quills melee unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your quills are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: Sharp quills on your head can pierce your foes deeply. Most athamarus use such quills for defense, but a well-timed headbash can be devastatingly effective. You gain a quills melee unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your quills are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 당신 머리의 날카로운 가시깃은 적을 깊숙이 찌를 수 있습니다. 대부분의 아타마루는 이러한 가시깃을 방어에 사용하지만, 시기적절한 박치기는 파괴적으로 효과적일 수 있습니다. 당신은 1d6 관통 피해를 입히는 가시깃 근접 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 가시깃은 격투 무기군에 속하며 민첩, 섬세, 비무장 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Bandaagee Vanara

description.value: Your family is one of many who claims to be descended from the regal vanara peacekeeping family called the Bandaagee. Bandaagee are the most common kind of vanaras. You're very familiar with the trappings of civilization and move easily through the most crowded communities. You ignore difficult terrain from crowds.

_desc_en: Your family is one of many who claims to be descended from the regal vanara peacekeeping family called the Bandaagee. Bandaagee are the most common kind of vanaras. You're very familiar with the trappings of civilization and move easily through the most crowded communities. You ignore difficult terrain from crowds.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가문은 반다기라 불리는 고귀한 바나라 평화 유지 가문의 후손임을 자처하는 수많은 가문 중 하나입니다. 반다기는 가장 흔한 종류의 바나라입니다. 당신은 문명의 산물에 매우 익숙하며 가장 붐비는 공동체 사이도 수월하게 지나갑니다. 당신은 군중으로 인한 험지를 무시합니다.

name: Shimmertongue Nagaji

description.value: You were born with a keen sense for magic, able to taste its unique effects in the air. You gain magicsense as a vague sense that has a range of 30 feet—like all vague senses, it's only about as precise as an average human's sense of smell, meaning you generally can predict only if magic is present; however, each tradition of magic has a unique taste to you, allowing you to identify the tradition of magic present.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You were born with a keen sense for magic, able to taste its unique effects in the air. You gain magicsense as a vague sense that has a range of 30 feet—like all vague senses, it's only about as precise as an average human's sense of smell, meaning you generally can predict only if magic is present; however, each tradition of magic has a unique taste to you, allowing you to identify the tradition of magic present.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마법에 대한 예리한 감각을 지니고 태어나, 공기 중에서 그 독특한 효과를 맛볼 수 있습니다. 당신은 30피트 범위의 흐릿한 감각으로서 마법감지를 얻습니다. 모든 흐릿한 감각과 마찬가지로, 이는 평범한 사람의 후각 정도로만 정밀합니다. 즉, 당신은 일반적으로 마법이 존재하는지 여부만 예측할 수 있습니다. 하지만 각 마법 전통은 당신에게 고유한 맛을 지니고 있어, 존재하는 마법의 전통을 식별할 수 있습니다.

name: Athamasi

description.value: You have a set of small secondary arms adapted for climbing and hanging from trees. You can't hold or retrieve objects with these limbs, but you can Climb or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} even if one or both of your primary hands are full. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while Climbing.

_desc_en: You have a set of small secondary arms adapted for climbing and hanging from trees. You can't hold or retrieve objects with these limbs, but you can Climb or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} even if one or both of your primary hands are full. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while Climbing.
_desc_ko: 당신은 나무를 오르고 매달리는 데 적응된 작은 보조 팔 한 쌍을 지니고 있습니다. 당신은 이 팔로 물체를 쥐거나 꺼낼 수는 없지만, 주된 손 중 하나 또는 둘 다가 차 있어도 오르기나 @link[actions.grab-an-edge]{모서리 붙잡기}를 할 수 있습니다. 당신은 오르는 동안 @link[conditions.off-guard]{경계 흐트러짐} 상태가 되지 않습니다.

name: Chrysanthemum Leshy

description.value:
You look like a human child, though with a grand crown of chrysanthemums growing from your head, ornate as an emperor's. These petals have medicinal properties, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against poison.

Furthermore, during your daily preparations, you can harmlessly pluck a few petals from your head and steep them in fresh water to create a single @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ktjFOp3U0wQD9t0Z]{Lesser Antidote}, which takes the form of a tea. At level 6, you instead create a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.AJ1dC7EtTIfBey0M]{Moderate Antidote}; at level 10, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XWkeL34yJK6t5qUE]{Greater Antidote}; and at level 14, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ANzB9WzlGQXDn76G]{Major Antidote}. The tea loses its effectiveness if not consumed before your next daily preparations.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You look like a human child, though with a grand crown of chrysanthemums growing from your head, ornate as an emperor's. These petals have medicinal properties, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against poison.

Furthermore, during your daily preparations, you can harmlessly pluck a few petals from your head and steep them in fresh water to create a single @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ktjFOp3U0wQD9t0Z]{Lesser Antidote}, which takes the form of a tea. At level 6, you instead create a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.AJ1dC7EtTIfBey0M]{Moderate Antidote}; at level 10, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XWkeL34yJK6t5qUE]{Greater Antidote}; and at level 14, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ANzB9WzlGQXDn76G]{Major Antidote}. The tea loses its effectiveness if not consumed before your next daily preparations.
_desc_ko:
당신은 사람 아이처럼 보이지만, 머리에서는 황제의 것처럼 화려한 국화의 웅장한 왕관이 자라나 있습니다. 이 꽃잎에는 약효가 있어, 독에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

또한 매일의 준비 과정에서 당신은 머리에서 꽃잎 몇 장을 해 없이 뜯어 신선한 물에 우려내어 차 형태를 띤 @link[equipment.antidote-lesser]{하급 해독제} 하나를 만들 수 있습니다. 6레벨에는 대신 @link[equipment.antidote-moderate]{중급 해독제}를, 10레벨에는 @link[equipment.antidote-greater]{상급 해독제}를, 14레벨에는 @link[equipment.antidote-major]{최상급 해독제}를 만듭니다. 이 차는 다음 일일 준비 전에 마시지 않으면 효력을 잃습니다.

name: Lethoci

description.value: You come from a kashrishi family adapted to coastal shores, or inland ponds and lakes. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Swim. If you critically fail an Athletics check to Swim, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: You come from a kashrishi family adapted to coastal shores, or inland ponds and lakes. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Swim. If you critically fail an Athletics check to Swim, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 해안가, 또는 내륙의 연못과 호수에 적응한 카쉬리시 가문 출신입니다. 당신은 수영을 위한 운동 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신이 수영을 위한 운동 판정에 대실패하면, 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Windup Poppet

description.value: You're made primarily of soft metals, such as tin or silver, and your life force dwells within an exceptional array of clockworks deep in your body. Provided you wind metal tabs on your body a few times each day, you don't need food or water to survive. You must still breathe to ventilate your internal mechanisms and sleep to give your mechanisms rest, just like other poppets.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You're made primarily of soft metals, such as tin or silver, and your life force dwells within an exceptional array of clockworks deep in your body. Provided you wind metal tabs on your body a few times each day, you don't need food or water to survive. You must still breathe to ventilate your internal mechanisms and sleep to give your mechanisms rest, just like other poppets.
