_desc_ko: 당신은 주로 주석이나 은 같은 무른 금속으로 만들어졌으며, 당신의 생명력은 몸 깊숙이 자리한 뛰어난 태엽 장치 안에 깃들어 있습니다. 매일 몇 번씩 몸에 달린 금속 태엽을 감아주기만 하면, 당신은 생존하기 위해 음식이나 물이 필요하지 않습니다. 다만 다른 포펫과 마찬가지로 당신은 여전히 내부 기계를 환기하기 위해 숨을 쉬어야 하고 기계에 휴식을 주기 위해 잠을 자야 합니다.

name: Runtboss Hobgoblin

description.value: You come from a long line of hobgoblins who commanded goblins. You are smaller than other hobgoblins, but goblins still listen to any commands you bellow. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gUqvezs2zzoTXFAI]{Group Coercion} skill feat. If you roll a success on an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} a goblin, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: You come from a long line of hobgoblins who commanded goblins. You are smaller than other hobgoblins, but goblins still listen to any commands you bellow. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gUqvezs2zzoTXFAI]{Group Coercion} skill feat. If you roll a success on an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} a goblin, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 고블린을 지휘해 온 홉고블린 혈통에서 왔습니다. 당신은 다른 홉고블린보다 작지만, 고블린은 여전히 당신이 외치는 명령이라면 무엇이든 따릅니다. 당신은 @link[feats.group-coercion]{집단 강압} 기술 재주를 얻습니다. 당신이 고블린을 @link[actions.coerce]{강압}하기 위한 위협 판정에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻으며, 대실패를 굴리면 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Fey-Touched Gnome

description.value: The blood of the fey flows through your veins, saturating you with their magic and making you truly one of them. You gain the fey trait, in addition to the gnome and humanoid traits. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You can change this cantrip to a different one from the same list once per day by meditating to realign yourself with the First World; this is a 10-minute activity that has the concentrate trait.

_desc_en: The blood of the fey flows through your veins, saturating you with their magic and making you truly one of them. You gain the fey trait, in addition to the gnome and humanoid traits. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You can change this cantrip to a different one from the same list once per day by meditating to realign yourself with the First World; this is a 10-minute activity that has the concentrate trait.
_desc_ko: 요정의 피가 당신의 혈관 속에 흘러, 당신을 그들의 마법으로 가득 채우고 진정으로 그들 중 하나로 만듭니다. 당신은 노움과 인간형 특성에 더해 요정 특성을 얻습니다. 근원 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 선택하세요. 당신은 이 주문을 근원 내재 주문으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다. 당신은 명상을 통해 첫째 세계와 자신을 다시 맞춤으로써 하루에 한 번 이 소마법을 같은 목록의 다른 소마법으로 바꿀 수 있습니다. 이는 집중 특성을 지닌 10분짜리 활동입니다.

name: Carcharodon Merfolk

description.value: As a fearsome shark merfolk, your lower body is similar to that of one of the apex predators of the ocean. Like a shark, you can smell blood from quite a distance. You gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. However, you can smell spilled blood at a range of 120 feet in the air and 500 feet in the water.

_desc_en: As a fearsome shark merfolk, your lower body is similar to that of one of the apex predators of the ocean. Like a shark, you can smell blood from quite a distance. You gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. However, you can smell spilled blood at a range of 120 feet in the air and 500 feet in the water.
_desc_ko: 무시무시한 상어 인어로서, 당신의 하반신은 바다의 최상위 포식자 중 하나와 유사합니다. 상어처럼 당신은 꽤 먼 거리에서도 피 냄새를 맡을 수 있습니다. 당신은 30피트 범위의 부정확한 감각으로서 후각을 얻습니다. 하지만 당신은 흘린 피를 공기 중에서는 120피트, 물속에서는 500피트 거리에서 맡을 수 있습니다.

name: Oracular Samsaran

description.value: Your past lives have provided heightened insight to the spiritual world and current and future events, as history repeats itself. Choose arcane, divine, or occult. You gain one cantrip from that magical tradition's spell list. You can Cast this Spell as an innate spell at will, as a spell of your chosen tradition. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your past lives have provided heightened insight to the spiritual world and current and future events, as history repeats itself. Choose arcane, divine, or occult. You gain one cantrip from that magical tradition's spell list. You can Cast this Spell as an innate spell at will, as a spell of your chosen tradition. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신의 전생은 역사가 반복되는 가운데 영적 세계와 현재 및 미래의 사건에 대한 고양된 통찰을 제공했습니다. 비전, 신성, 또는 신비 중 하나를 선택하세요. 당신은 그 마법 전통의 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 얻습니다. 당신은 선택한 전통의 주문으로서 이 주문을 내재 주문으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다.

name: Treedweller Goblin

description.value: You have adapted particularly well to living in forested environments. As long as you are in a forest or jungle, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist}, and your Survival DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Cover Tracks}.

_desc_en: You have adapted particularly well to living in forested environments. As long as you are in a forest or jungle, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist}, and your Survival DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Cover Tracks}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 특히 숲이 우거진 환경에서 사는 데 잘 적응했습니다. 숲이나 정글에 있는 한, 당신은 @link[actions.hide]{숨기}와 @link[actions.sneak]{잠행}을 위한 은신 판정, @link[actions.subsist]{연명}을 위한 생존 판정, 그리고 @link[actions.cover-tracks]{흔적 감추기}를 위한 당신의 생존 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Homing Drake

description.value:
You have a short, stubby nose, and tiny spines that resemble hairs. You might have vividly colored scales or be a dun brown. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tXa5vOu5giBNCjdR]{Know the Way} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

In addition, you always know the distance and direction to your home. You can designate a new location as your home after you spend 1 week there, but you can have only a single designated home at a time.

_desc_en:
You have a short, stubby nose, and tiny spines that resemble hairs. You might have vividly colored scales or be a dun brown. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tXa5vOu5giBNCjdR]{Know the Way} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

In addition, you always know the distance and direction to your home. You can designate a new location as your home after you spend 1 week there, but you can have only a single designated home at a time.
_desc_ko:
당신은 짧고 뭉툭한 코와 머리카락처럼 보이는 작은 가시들을 지녔습니다. 선명한 색의 비늘을 지녔거나 칙칙한 갈색일 수도 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.know-the-way]{길을 알기} 캔트립을 비전 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 캔트립은 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)과 같은 주문 랭크로 강화됩니다.

또한, 당신은 항상 자신의 집까지의 거리와 방향을 압니다. 어떤 장소에서 1주일을 보낸 뒤 그곳을 새로운 집으로 지정할 수 있지만, 한 번에 하나의 지정된 집만 가질 수 있습니다.

name: Toy Poppet

description.value: You have the form of a child's tiny toy or doll, but you don't let your small size impede your joy of life. Instead of Small, your size is Tiny. Like other Tiny creatures, you don't automatically receive lesser cover from being in a larger creature's space, but circumstances might allow you to Take Cover. You can purchase weapons, armor, and other items for your size with the same statistics as normal gear, except that melee weapons have a reach of 0 for you (or a reach 5 feet shorter than normal if they have the reach trait). You can enter another creature's space, which is important because you must usually enter a creature's space to attack it with melee Strikes! Remember to adjust the Bulk of items and your Bulk limit for Tiny size.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You have the form of a child's tiny toy or doll, but you don't let your small size impede your joy of life. Instead of Small, your size is Tiny. Like other Tiny creatures, you don't automatically receive lesser cover from being in a larger creature's space, but circumstances might allow you to Take Cover. You can purchase weapons, armor, and other items for your size with the same statistics as normal gear, except that melee weapons have a reach of 0 for you (or a reach 5 feet shorter than normal if they have the reach trait). You can enter another creature's space, which is important because you must usually enter a creature's space to attack it with melee Strikes! Remember to adjust the Bulk of items and your Bulk limit for Tiny size.
_desc_ko: 당신은 아이의 작은 장난감이나 인형의 모습을 하고 있지만, 그 작은 크기가 당신의 삶의 즐거움을 방해하게 두지 않습니다. 당신의 크기는 소형이 아니라 초소형입니다. 다른 초소형 크리처와 마찬가지로, 당신은 더 큰 크리처의 공간에 있다고 해서 자동으로 약한 엄폐를 받지는 않지만, 상황에 따라 엄폐하기를 할 수 있을 수도 있습니다. 당신은 자신의 크기에 맞는 무기, 방어구, 기타 물품을 일반 장비와 같은 수치로 구매할 수 있지만, 근접 무기는 당신에게 사거리가 0입니다(또는 사거리 특성이 있다면 일반보다 5피트 짧은 사거리). 당신은 다른 크리처의 공간에 들어갈 수 있으며, 이는 근접 타격으로 크리처를 공격하려면 보통 그 공간에 들어가야 하기 때문에 중요합니다! 초소형 크기에 맞춰 물품의 무게와 당신의 무게 한도를 조정하는 것을 잊지 마세요.

name: Changeling

description.value: Your mother was a hag. Your eyes' heterochromia is the most obvious signifier of this parentage, but you likely also have a slighter build, paler skin, and darker hair than most members of your other parent's ancestry. You gain the changeling trait. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can select from changeling feats and feats from your other parent's ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: Your mother was a hag. Your eyes' heterochromia is the most obvious signifier of this parentage, but you likely also have a slighter build, paler skin, and darker hair than most members of your other parent's ancestry. You gain the changeling trait. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can select from changeling feats and feats from your other parent's ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 어머니는 마귀할멈이었습니다. 눈의 홍채이색증이 이 혈통을 가장 뚜렷이 드러내는 표시이지만, 당신은 아마도 다른 쪽 부모의 혈통 구성원 대부분보다 더 가느다란 체구, 더 창백한 피부, 더 짙은 머리카락도 지녔을 것입니다. 당신은 체인질링 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 또한 저광 시야를 얻으며, 당신의 혈통이 이미 저광 시야를 지니고 있다면 대신 암시야를 얻습니다. 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 당신은 체인질링 재주와 다른 쪽 부모의 혈통 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Rite of Light

description.value: Your exoskeleton bears small shoots that can share life. When using your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.BgHrucbZ9TH92RDv]{Sunlight Healing}, you can restore the Hit Points of an adjacent ally instead of yourself. That ally becomes temporarily immune to all uses of Sunlight Healing for 1 day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your exoskeleton bears small shoots that can share life. When using your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.BgHrucbZ9TH92RDv]{Sunlight Healing}, you can restore the Hit Points of an adjacent ally instead of yourself. That ally becomes temporarily immune to all uses of Sunlight Healing for 1 day.
_desc_ko: 당신의 외골격에는 생명을 나눌 수 있는 작은 새싹이 돋아 있습니다. @link[feats.sunlight-healing]{햇빛 치유}를 사용할 때, 자신 대신 인접한 아군의 체력을 회복시킬 수 있습니다. 그 아군은 1일 동안 모든 햇빛 치유의 사용에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

name: Gutsy Halfling

description.value: Your family line is known for keeping a level head and staving off fear when the chips were down. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your family line is known for keeping a level head and staving off fear when the chips were down. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가문은 궁지에 몰렸을 때도 침착함을 유지하고 두려움을 물리치는 것으로 알려져 있습니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴렸을 때, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Xyloshi

description.value: You have prominent neck muscles that allow you to use your facial horn as a tool or weapon. You gain a horn unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your horn is in the brawling group, and has the finesse and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: You have prominent neck muscles that allow you to use your facial horn as a tool or weapon. You gain a horn unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your horn is in the brawling group, and has the finesse and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 두드러진 목 근육을 지니고 있어 얼굴의 뿔을 도구나 무기로 사용할 수 있습니다. 당신은 1d6 관통 피해를 입히는 뿔 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 뿔은 격투(brawling) 무기군에 속하며, 정교함(finesse)과 비무장(unarmed) 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Lorekeeper Shisk

description.value: You grew up surrounded by knowledge and secrets. You become trained in one Lore skill and one other Intelligence- or Wisdom-based skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become expert in the chosen skills.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You grew up surrounded by knowledge and secrets. You become trained in one Lore skill and one other Intelligence- or Wisdom-based skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become expert in the chosen skills.
_desc_ko: 당신은 지식과 비밀에 둘러싸여 자랐습니다. 당신은 하나의 지식학(Lore) 기술과, 지능 또는 지혜 기반의 다른 기술 하나를 선택해 숙련이 됩니다. 5레벨에 선택한 기술들에서 전문가가 됩니다.

name: Peachchild Leshy

description.value:
Your leshy spirit took hold in a massive peach fruit before your body split forth from it, possibly emulating a past hero who was born in the same manner. You look like a human child, though with a perpetual flush of pink to your complexion and perhaps a few peach leaves growing from your body. The nature spirit inside you puts certain animals at ease.

You can ask questions of and receive answers from household animals and livestock, such as dogs or pheasants, as well as use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on and Request things of them. Most domesticated animals have an indifferent or friendly starting attitude toward you and give you time to make your case, though other animals react to you like any other adventurer.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your leshy spirit took hold in a massive peach fruit before your body split forth from it, possibly emulating a past hero who was born in the same manner. You look like a human child, though with a perpetual flush of pink to your complexion and perhaps a few peach leaves growing from your body. The nature spirit inside you puts certain animals at ease.

You can ask questions of and receive answers from household animals and livestock, such as dogs or pheasants, as well as use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on and Request things of them. Most domesticated animals have an indifferent or friendly starting attitude toward you and give you time to make your case, though other animals react to you like any other adventurer.
_desc_ko:
당신의 레쉬 영혼은 몸이 갈라져 나오기 전에 거대한 복숭아 열매 속에 깃들었으며, 어쩌면 같은 방식으로 태어난 과거의 영웅을 본뜬 것일지도 모릅니다. 당신은 인간 아이처럼 보이지만, 늘 분홍빛으로 상기된 안색을 지니고 어쩌면 몸에서 복숭아 잎 몇 장이 자라나기도 합니다. 당신 안의 자연 영혼은 특정 동물들을 편안하게 만듭니다.

당신은 개나 꿩 같은 가축 및 가금에게 질문하고 대답을 들을 수 있으며, 그들에게 외교술(Diplomacy)을 사용해 좋은 인상 주기(Make an Impression)와 요청하기(Request)를 할 수 있습니다. 대부분의 길들여진 동물은 당신에게 무관심하거나 우호적인 시작 태도를 지니며 당신이 사정을 설명할 시간을 주지만, 그 밖의 동물은 다른 모험가와 마찬가지로 당신에게 반응합니다.

name: Heavenscribe Kobold

description.value: Your connection to wise and celestial imperial dragons has led others to seek your advice. You can speak Draconic. Whenever you critically fail a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, you get a failure instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your connection to wise and celestial imperial dragons has led others to seek your advice. You can speak Draconic. Whenever you critically fail a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 지혜롭고 천상적인 제국 용들과의 연결 덕분에 다른 이들이 당신에게 조언을 구하게 되었습니다. 당신은 용언(Draconic)을 말할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.make-an-impression]{좋은 인상 주기}나 @link[actions.request]{요청하기}를 위한 외교술 판정에서 대실패할 때마다, 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Sylph

description.value: You are descended from air elementals or were born under the element's influence. You gain the sylph trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You also gain low-light vision or darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from sylph feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: You are descended from air elementals or were born under the element's influence. You gain the sylph trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You also gain low-light vision or darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from sylph feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 공기 정령의 후손이거나 그 원소의 영향 아래 태어났습니다. 당신은 혈통에서 오는 특성에 더해 실프 특성을 얻습니다. 또한 당신은 저광 시야를 얻으며, 당신의 혈통이 이미 저광 시야를 지니고 있다면 암시야를 얻습니다. 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 실프 재주와 당신 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Jinxed Halfling

description.value: You were born with a strange blessing: bereft of the typical halfling luck, you can instead manipulate the fortunes of others. You can never take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZbRVqf14RTJJIZXG]{Halfling Luck} feat, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hFRHPBj6wjAayNtW]{Jinx} action.

_desc_en: You were born with a strange blessing: bereft of the typical halfling luck, you can instead manipulate the fortunes of others. You can never take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZbRVqf14RTJJIZXG]{Halfling Luck} feat, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hFRHPBj6wjAayNtW]{Jinx} action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 기이한 축복을 타고났습니다. 전형적인 하플링의 행운을 지니지 못한 대신, 당신은 다른 이들의 운을 조작할 수 있습니다. 당신은 결코 @link[feats.halfling-luck]{하플링의 행운} 재주를 취할 수 없으며, @link[actions.jinx]{불운 걸기} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Beastkin

description.value:
The blood of a beast flows through your veins, granting you the ferocity and might of animals. Only creatures with the humanoid trait can take the beastkin versatile heritage. Choose a type of animal such as bat, eagle, shark, spider, tyrannosaurus, wasp, or wolf. This is the type of animal tied to your heritage and is known as your inherent animal. A beastkin's hybrid form is their natural shape. You gain the beast and beastkin traits, in addition to the traits from your ancestry.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Change Shape} ability. You can choose from beastkin feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en:
The blood of a beast flows through your veins, granting you the ferocity and might of animals. Only creatures with the humanoid trait can take the beastkin versatile heritage. Choose a type of animal such as bat, eagle, shark, spider, tyrannosaurus, wasp, or wolf. This is the type of animal tied to your heritage and is known as your inherent animal. A beastkin's hybrid form is their natural shape. You gain the beast and beastkin traits, in addition to the traits from your ancestry.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Change Shape} ability. You can choose from beastkin feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko:
야수의 피가 당신의 혈관을 흐르며, 동물의 사나움과 힘을 부여합니다. 인간형(humanoid) 특성을 지닌 존재만이 야수혈족 다목적 유산을 취할 수 있습니다. 박쥐, 독수리, 상어, 거미, 티라노사우루스, 말벌, 늑대 등 동물의 종류를 하나 선택합니다. 이는 당신의 유산과 연결된 동물의 종류이며 당신의 고유 동물이라 불립니다. 야수혈족의 혼종 형태는 그들의 본래 모습입니다. 당신은 혈통에서 오는 특성에 더해 야수(beast)와 야수혈족(beastkin) 특성을 얻습니다.

당신은 @link[actions.change-shape]{변신} 능력을 얻습니다. 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 야수혈족 재주와 당신 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Talos

description.value:
Your physical features reflect the influence a zuhra or other metal elemental has had over your bloodline. Your skin likely has a metallic sheen, ranging from the dull luster of raw ore to the gleaming polish of a new blade, with the wear of age or hardship taking the form of tarnish, rust, or scouring. Your hair might resemble spun gold, coiled steel, copper wiring, or braided chains. You gain the talos trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You gain resistance to electricity equal to half your level (minimum 1). You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vJZ83ehQiM906lea]{Detect Metal} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

You can choose from talos feats, geniekin feats, and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en:
Your physical features reflect the influence a zuhra or other metal elemental has had over your bloodline. Your skin likely has a metallic sheen, ranging from the dull luster of raw ore to the gleaming polish of a new blade, with the wear of age or hardship taking the form of tarnish, rust, or scouring. Your hair might resemble spun gold, coiled steel, copper wiring, or braided chains. You gain the talos trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You gain resistance to electricity equal to half your level (minimum 1). You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vJZ83ehQiM906lea]{Detect Metal} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

You can choose from talos feats, geniekin feats, and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko:
당신의 신체적 특징은 주라 또는 다른 금속 정령이 당신의 혈통에 미친 영향을 반영합니다. 당신의 피부는 원광석의 흐릿한 광택부터 새 칼날의 반짝이는 윤기까지 아우르는 금속성 광택을 띠기 쉬우며, 세월이나 고난의 흔적은 변색, 녹, 마모의 형태로 나타납니다. 당신의 머리카락은 자아낸 금실, 감긴 강철, 구리 배선, 또는 엮인 사슬을 닮았을 수 있습니다. 당신은 혈통에서 오는 특성에 더해 탈로스 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 자신 레벨의 절반과 같은 전기 저항을 얻습니다(최소 1). 당신은 @link[spells.detect-metal]{금속 감지} 소마법을 마법(arcane) 선천 주문으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 자신 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 같은 주문 등급으로 상향됩니다.

혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 탈로스 재주, 정령혈족(geniekin) 재주, 그리고 당신 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: River Azarketi

description.value:
You come from azarketis who abandoned the oceans for the fresh water of inland life. The varied geography of rivers required you to develop advanced physical skills to swim against rapids, leap through cascading waters, and deftly navigate shallow and narrow channels.

When you succeed at an Athletics check to Swim, you get a critical success instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en:
You come from azarketis who abandoned the oceans for the fresh water of inland life. The varied geography of rivers required you to develop advanced physical skills to swim against rapids, leap through cascading waters, and deftly navigate shallow and narrow channels.

When you succeed at an Athletics check to Swim, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
당신은 바다를 버리고 내륙의 담수 생활을 택한 아자르케티 출신입니다. 강의 다양한 지형은 급류를 거슬러 헤엄치고, 쏟아지는 물살을 뛰어넘고, 얕고 좁은 수로를 능숙하게 헤쳐 나가기 위한 뛰어난 신체 기술을 익히도록 요구했습니다.

수영하기(Swim)를 위한 운동술(Athletics) 판정에 성공할 때, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Undine

description.value: A water elemental ancestor influences your bloodline. You gain the undine trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and the amphibious trait. Like all creatures with the amphibious trait, you can breathe both water and air. You can choose from undine feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: A water elemental ancestor influences your bloodline. You gain the undine trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and the amphibious trait. Like all creatures with the amphibious trait, you can breathe both water and air. You can choose from undine feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 물 정령 조상이 당신의 혈통에 영향을 미칩니다. 당신은 혈통에서 오는 특성에 더해 운디네 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 10피트의 수영 이동 속도와 양서(amphibious) 특성을 얻습니다. 양서 특성을 지닌 모든 존재와 마찬가지로, 당신은 물과 공기 양쪽에서 호흡할 수 있습니다. 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 운디네 재주와 당신 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Rite of Invocation

description.value: You augmented your exoskeleton with magic. You gain one cantrip from the arcane or occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You augmented your exoskeleton with magic. You gain one cantrip from the arcane or occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신은 외골격을 마법으로 강화했습니다. 당신은 마법(arcane) 또는 신비(occult) 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 얻습니다. 당신은 이 주문을 선천 주문으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 자신 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 같은 주문 등급으로 상향됩니다.

name: Shadow of the Courtier

description.value: Your shadow dances alongside you. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat, allowing you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} using Performance instead of Diplomacy. Once per day, if you fail, but not critically fail, a check to Make an Impression, you can play it off as part of a performance, allowing you to reroll the check; this is a fortune effect.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your shadow dances alongside you. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat, allowing you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} using Performance instead of Diplomacy. Once per day, if you fail, but not critically fail, a check to Make an Impression, you can play it off as part of a performance, allowing you to reroll the check; this is a fortune effect.
_desc_ko: 당신의 그림자가 당신과 함께 춤춥니다. 당신은 인상적인 공연(Impressive Performance) 기술 재주를 얻어, 외교술 대신 공연술(Performance)을 사용해 @link[actions.make-an-impression]{좋은 인상 주기}를 할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 좋은 인상 주기 판정에 실패했으나 대실패하지는 않았을 때, 그것을 공연의 일부인 척 넘겨 그 판정을 다시 굴릴 수 있습니다. 이는 행운(fortune) 효과입니다.

name: New Moon Sarangay

description.value: Some people call you a dwarf sarangay and your kind "hiding ones." Others whisper you go out with the moon when the moon "goes hunting"—a common folk saying for when the new moon vanishes from the sky. Your elusive ancestors built their lodgings in the shade of bamboo thickets, and your ancestral communities valued caution and independence, passing down the knowledge of walking lightly and moving like smoke through bamboo. Your ancestors had dark brown or gray fur with white markings and a V-shaped pair of flat, triangular horns. Your size is Small instead of Medium. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8 and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Some people call you a dwarf sarangay and your kind "hiding ones." Others whisper you go out with the moon when the moon "goes hunting"—a common folk saying for when the new moon vanishes from the sky. Your elusive ancestors built their lodgings in the shade of bamboo thickets, and your ancestral communities valued caution and independence, passing down the knowledge of walking lightly and moving like smoke through bamboo. Your ancestors had dark brown or gray fur with white markings and a V-shaped pair of flat, triangular horns. Your size is Small instead of Medium. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8 and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}.
_desc_ko: 어떤 이들은 당신을 드워프 사랑가이라 부르고 당신 종족을 "숨은 자들"이라 부릅니다. 또 다른 이들은 달이 "사냥을 나갈" 때—초승달이 하늘에서 사라질 때를 이르는 흔한 속담—당신도 달과 함께 나간다고 속삭입니다. 당신의 은둔적인 조상들은 대나무 숲의 그늘에 거처를 지었고, 당신의 조상 공동체는 신중함과 독립성을 소중히 여기며 가볍게 걷고 대나무 사이로 연기처럼 움직이는 지혜를 전했습니다. 당신의 조상들은 흰 무늬가 있는 짙은 갈색 또는 회색 털과 평평한 삼각형의 V자형 뿔 한 쌍을 지녔습니다. 당신의 크기는 중형(Medium)이 아니라 소형(Small)입니다. 당신은 혈통에서 8이 아닌 10 체력을 얻으며, @link[actions.shove]{밀치기}를 위한 운동술 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Roaming Minotaur

description.value: Your hooves are broad and powerful, perfect for clearing away rubble as you step. You become trained in Survival (or another skill if you were already trained in Survival) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4tTkRyOQ0VuRBac3]{Terrain Expertise} skill feat. You ignore difficult terrain caused by natural uneven ground while in the terrain chosen for your Terrain Expertise feat.

_desc_en: Your hooves are broad and powerful, perfect for clearing away rubble as you step. You become trained in Survival (or another skill if you were already trained in Survival) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4tTkRyOQ0VuRBac3]{Terrain Expertise} skill feat. You ignore difficult terrain caused by natural uneven ground while in the terrain chosen for your Terrain Expertise feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 발굽은 넓고 강력하여, 걸으면서 잔해를 치워내기에 안성맞춤입니다. 당신은 생존술(Survival)에 숙련이 되며(이미 생존술에 숙련되어 있었다면 다른 기술 하나), @link[feats.terrain-expertise]{지형 전문성} 기술 재주를 얻습니다. 당신은 지형 전문성 재주로 선택한 지형 안에 있는 동안, 자연적으로 울퉁불퉁한 지면으로 인한 험지를 무시합니다.

name: Benthic Azarketi

description.value: Your heritage traces to azarketis living deep beneath the sea, and you can handle the chilling depths more easily than most. You gain resistance to cold equal to half your level, and you don't treat environmental cold as one degree more severe when you are wet. You adapt to pressure changes from being deep underwater automatically without ill effect.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en: Your heritage traces to azarketis living deep beneath the sea, and you can handle the chilling depths more easily than most. You gain resistance to cold equal to half your level, and you don't treat environmental cold as one degree more severe when you are wet. You adapt to pressure changes from being deep underwater automatically without ill effect.
_desc_ko: 당신의 유산은 바다 깊은 곳에 사는 아자르케티까지 거슬러 올라가며, 당신은 대부분보다 오싹한 심해를 더 쉽게 견딜 수 있습니다. 당신은 자신 레벨의 절반과 같은 냉기 저항을 얻으며, 젖어 있을 때 환경 냉기를 한 단계 더 심각한 것으로 취급하지 않습니다. 당신은 깊은 수중에 있음으로 인한 수압 변화에 해로운 영향 없이 자동으로 적응합니다.

name: Jungle Catfolk

description.value: You're descended from jungle stalkers and can move swiftly through scrub and underbrush. You ignore difficult terrain from undergrowth, and greater difficult terrain from undergrowth is only difficult terrain for you.

_desc_en: You're descended from jungle stalkers and can move swiftly through scrub and underbrush. You ignore difficult terrain from undergrowth, and greater difficult terrain from undergrowth is only difficult terrain for you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 정글의 추적자들의 후손이며 덤불과 관목 사이를 재빠르게 이동할 수 있습니다. 당신은 덤불로 인한 험지를 무시하며, 덤불로 인한 상급 험지는 당신에게 그저 험지일 뿐입니다.

name: Celestial Envoy Kitsune

description.value: Whether due to Daikitsu's grace or faithful forebears, you have a strong connection to the divine, affording you certain protections. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Aq2mXT2hLlstFL5C]{Invoke Celestial Privilege} reaction. Your alternate form is a common Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human), called a tailless form.

_desc_en: Whether due to Daikitsu's grace or faithful forebears, you have a strong connection to the divine, affording you certain protections. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Aq2mXT2hLlstFL5C]{Invoke Celestial Privilege} reaction. Your alternate form is a common Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human), called a tailless form.
_desc_ko: 다이키츠의 은총 덕분이든 신실한 선조들 덕분이든, 당신은 신성한 존재와 강한 연결을 지니고 있어 특정한 보호를 받습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.invoke-celestial-privilege]{천상의 특권 발동} 반응행동을 얻습니다. 당신의 대체 형태는 당신이 자란 곳에서 널리 퍼진 일반적인 중형(Medium) 인간형 혈통(대개 인간)으로, 꼬리 없는 형태라 불립니다.

name: Oread

description.value: An earth elemental ancestor has influenced your bloodline, and your features highlight this elemental planar connection. You might have a crystalline or metallic sheen to your skin or hair, rough and stony flesh, or glittering gemstone eyes. You gain the oread trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from oread feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: An earth elemental ancestor has influenced your bloodline, and your features highlight this elemental planar connection. You might have a crystalline or metallic sheen to your skin or hair, rough and stony flesh, or glittering gemstone eyes. You gain the oread trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from oread feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 흙 정령 조상이 당신의 혈통에 영향을 미쳤으며, 당신의 특징은 이 정령계와의 연결을 부각시킵니다. 당신은 피부나 머리카락에 수정 같거나 금속성 광택을 띠거나, 거칠고 돌 같은 살결을 지니거나, 반짝이는 보석 같은 눈을 지녔을 수 있습니다. 당신은 혈통에서 오는 특성에 더해 오레아드 특성을 얻습니다. 또한 당신은 저광 시야를 얻으며, 당신의 혈통이 이미 저광 시야를 지니고 있다면 암시야를 얻습니다. 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 오레아드 재주와 당신 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Mountaineer Samsaran

description.value: Your past incarnations dwelled in the caves on the snowcapped mountains of Tian Xia, so your body has become adept at surviving frigid storms. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your past incarnations dwelled in the caves on the snowcapped mountains of Tian Xia, so your body has become adept at surviving frigid storms. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신의 과거 화신들은 티안 시아의 눈 덮인 산의 동굴에 거주했기에, 당신의 몸은 혹독한 폭풍에서 살아남는 데 능숙해졌습니다. 당신은 자신 레벨의 절반과 같은 냉기 저항을 얻습니다(최소 1). 당신은 환경 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극심한 것으로 취급합니다(믿기 힘든 냉기는 극심으로, 극심한 냉기는 심각으로, 이런 식으로).

name: Born of Celestial

description.value:
You were once a powerful celestial before an escape or great punishment left you trapped in a mortal shell, with only vague memories and limited power. Due to your residual divine power, the tradition of any spells or magical abilities you gain from a yaoguai heritage or ancestry feat is divine instead of its normal tradition (usually occult).

  • Humanoid Form Fragments of divine memory still litter your mind. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Religion checks.
  • Yaoguai Form Celestial power flows through you. Choose one cantrip from the divine spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate divine cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You were once a powerful celestial before an escape or great punishment left you trapped in a mortal shell, with only vague memories and limited power. Due to your residual divine power, the tradition of any spells or magical abilities you gain from a yaoguai heritage or ancestry feat is divine instead of its normal tradition (usually occult).

  • Humanoid Form Fragments of divine memory still litter your mind. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Religion checks.
  • Yaoguai Form Celestial power flows through you. Choose one cantrip from the divine spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate divine cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko:
당신은 한때 강력한 천상체였으나, 탈출이나 커다란 처벌로 인해 필멸의 껍질에 갇혔으며, 희미한 기억과 제한된 힘만이 남았습니다. 당신의 잔존하는 신성한 힘 덕분에, 당신이 요괴(yaoguai) 유산이나 혈통 재주에서 얻는 모든 주문이나 마법 능력의 전통은 본래의 전통(보통 신비) 대신 신성(divine)이 됩니다.

  • 인간형 형태 신성한 기억의 조각들이 여전히 당신의 마음에 흩어져 있습니다. 당신은 종교학(Religion) 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.
  • 요괴 형태 천상의 힘이 당신을 통해 흐릅니다. 신성 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 선택합니다. 당신은 이 주문을 신성 선천 소마법으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 자신 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 같은 주문 등급으로 상향됩니다.

name: Half Moon Sarangay

description.value: You come from one of many traveling communities that migrate seasonally along Tian Xia's vast rivers and mountains, bringing news and tidings to villages along their path. Your people connect sarangay communities to one another across vast distances and are symbolized by the half moon, which conjoins the light and dark; so too do you conjoin the dark from the bright, the red from the blue, the wind from the sea. Your ancestors were tall and burly with shiny black fur, light spots or markings, and short, tightly curved horns. You become trained in two Lore skills of your choice, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks using those skills.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You come from one of many traveling communities that migrate seasonally along Tian Xia's vast rivers and mountains, bringing news and tidings to villages along their path. Your people connect sarangay communities to one another across vast distances and are symbolized by the half moon, which conjoins the light and dark; so too do you conjoin the dark from the bright, the red from the blue, the wind from the sea. Your ancestors were tall and burly with shiny black fur, light spots or markings, and short, tightly curved horns. You become trained in two Lore skills of your choice, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks using those skills.
_desc_ko: 당신은 티안 시아의 광활한 강과 산을 따라 계절마다 이동하며 경로를 따라 마을에 소식과 소문을 전하는 수많은 유랑 공동체 중 하나 출신입니다. 당신의 사람들은 광대한 거리를 가로질러 사랑가이 공동체들을 서로 연결하며, 빛과 어둠을 잇는 반달로 상징됩니다. 당신 또한 밝음에서 어둠을, 파랑에서 빨강을, 바다에서 바람을 잇습니다. 당신의 조상들은 반들거리는 검은 털에 옅은 반점이나 무늬, 그리고 짧고 단단히 굽은 뿔을 지닌 크고 건장한 이들이었습니다. 당신은 원하는 지식학 기술 두 개에 숙련이 되며, 그 기술들을 사용한 지식 상기(Recall Knowledge) 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Mage Automaton

description.value: The chamber housing your core has a more direct connection to the rest of your humanoid shape, allowing you to tap into your core's magical energy. You gain one cantrip from the arcane spell list. You can cast this spell as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: The chamber housing your core has a more direct connection to the rest of your humanoid shape, allowing you to tap into your core's magical energy. You gain one cantrip from the arcane spell list. You can cast this spell as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신의 핵심부를 담은 격실은 당신의 인간형 몸의 나머지 부분과 더 직접적으로 연결되어 있어, 당신은 핵심부의 마법 에너지를 끌어낼 수 있습니다. 당신은 마법(arcane) 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 얻습니다. 당신은 이 주문을 마법 선천 주문으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 자신 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 같은 주문 등급으로 상향됩니다.

name: Cave Kholo

description.value: Storytellers spin ancient tales claiming that kholo lived in caves and underground before most of your kind ventured into the light. You're a throwback to these ancients, with a broad chest and markings that resemble short black slashes instead of spots. Your eyes are developed to see perfectly in the dark, a valuable advantage to your clan. You gain darkvision.

_desc_en: Storytellers spin ancient tales claiming that kholo lived in caves and underground before most of your kind ventured into the light. You're a throwback to these ancients, with a broad chest and markings that resemble short black slashes instead of spots. Your eyes are developed to see perfectly in the dark, a valuable advantage to your clan. You gain darkvision.
_desc_ko: 이야기꾼들은 대부분의 당신 종족이 빛 속으로 나오기 전, 콜로가 동굴과 지하에 살았다고 주장하는 옛 이야기를 지어냅니다. 당신은 이 고대 종족의 격세유전으로, 넓은 가슴과 반점 대신 짧은 검은 빗금을 닮은 무늬를 지녔습니다. 당신의 눈은 어둠 속에서 완벽하게 볼 수 있도록 발달했으며, 이는 당신 씨족에게 소중한 이점입니다. 당신은 암시야를 얻습니다.

name: Ghost Poppet

description.value: You awakened when a bit of another person's life force and a fragment of their soul-possibly, but not always, at the moment of their death-found its way into your constructed body. You don't remember anything more than vague flashes of your "before life," but that life essence still protects you. You gain resistance to void damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You awakened when a bit of another person's life force and a fragment of their soul-possibly, but not always, at the moment of their death-found its way into your constructed body. You don't remember anything more than vague flashes of your "before life," but that life essence still protects you. You gain resistance to void damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).
_desc_ko: 당신은 다른 사람의 생명력 일부와 영혼의 조각—항상은 아니지만 어쩌면 그 사람이 죽는 순간에—이 당신의 조형된 몸으로 흘러들었을 때 깨어났습니다. 당신은 자신의 "이전 삶"에 대해 희미한 섬광 이상의 것을 기억하지 못하지만, 그 생명 정수는 여전히 당신을 보호합니다. 당신은 자신 레벨의 절반과 같은 공허 피해 저항을 얻습니다(최소 1).

name: Virtuous Tanuki

description.value: Many tanuki carry a gourd of alcohol to remind themselves to act with virtue, and by these standards, you're quite virtuous indeed. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You can eat and drink things when you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}. You can't become incapacitated by conventional alcohol if you don't wish to be.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Many tanuki carry a gourd of alcohol to remind themselves to act with virtue, and by these standards, you're quite virtuous indeed. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You can eat and drink things when you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}. You can't become incapacitated by conventional alcohol if you don't wish to be.
_desc_ko: 많은 타누키는 자신이 덕을 지키며 행동하도록 상기시키기 위해 술이 든 호리병을 지니고 다니며, 그 기준으로 보면 당신은 실로 상당히 덕이 높습니다. 당신은 자신 레벨의 절반과 같은 독 저항을 얻습니다(최소 1). 당신은 @link[conditions.sickened]{메스꺼움} 상태일 때도 먹고 마실 수 있습니다. 당신은 원하지 않는 한 일반적인 술로 인해 무력화되지 않습니다.

name: Weaver Jotunborn

description.value: You've mastered the art of iivlar silk weaving, a technique that requires a fine attention to detail. You are trained in Crafting. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} when searching for hidden details like secret doors or traps.

_desc_en: You've mastered the art of iivlar silk weaving, a technique that requires a fine attention to detail. You are trained in Crafting. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} when searching for hidden details like secret doors or traps.
_desc_ko: 당신은 세심한 주의를 요하는 기법인 이블라르 비단 직조 기술을 통달했습니다. 당신은 제작에 숙련되어 있습니다. 비밀 문이나 함정 같은 숨겨진 세부 요소를 찾기 위해 @link[actions.seek]{탐색}할 때 지각 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다.

name: Warmarch Hobgoblin

description.value: You come from a line of wandering mercenaries constantly on the march and scavenging food on the trail. If you fail, but don't critically fail, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} in the wilderness, you can still keep yourself fed with poor meals. When exploring, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JuqmIAnkL9hVGai8]{Hustle} twice as long before you have to stop.

_desc_en: You come from a line of wandering mercenaries constantly on the march and scavenging food on the trail. If you fail, but don't critically fail, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} in the wilderness, you can still keep yourself fed with poor meals. When exploring, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JuqmIAnkL9hVGai8]{Hustle} twice as long before you have to stop.
_desc_ko: 당신은 끊임없이 행군하며 길에서 먹을 것을 조달하는 방랑 용병 혈통 출신입니다. 야생에서 @link[actions.subsist]{연명하기}에 실패했으나 대실패하지는 않았을 때, 당신은 여전히 부실한 식사로 배를 채울 수 있습니다. 탐험할 때, 당신은 멈춰야 하기 전까지 @link[actions.hustle]{강행군}을 두 배 더 오래 할 수 있습니다.

name: Plane-Hopper Jotunborn

description.value: You were chosen for your smaller size that allows you to move between planar thresholds with ease. You generally serve as a messenger or scout, and planar exposure has granted you a spark of magical power. Instead of Large, your size is Medium. You gain one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: You were chosen for your smaller size that allows you to move between planar thresholds with ease. You generally serve as a messenger or scout, and planar exposure has granted you a spark of magical power. Instead of Large, your size is Medium. You gain one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신은 차원 문턱 사이를 쉽게 이동할 수 있는 작은 체구 덕분에 선택되었습니다. 당신은 주로 전령이나 정찰병으로 활동하며, 차원에 노출되면서 마법적 힘의 불꽃을 얻었습니다. 당신의 크기는 대형 대신 중형입니다. 당신은 비학 주문 목록에서 캔트립 하나를 얻습니다. 이 주문을 비학 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 캔트립은 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)과 같은 주문 랭크로 강화됩니다.

name: Frightful Goloma

description.value: Your face has a particularly off-putting appearance. You are trained in Intimidation (or another skill of your choice if you were already trained in Intimidation) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat as a bonus feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your face has a particularly off-putting appearance. You are trained in Intimidation (or another skill of your choice if you were already trained in Intimidation) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat as a bonus feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 얼굴은 특히 불쾌한 외모를 지녔습니다. 당신은 위협술(Intimidation)에 숙련이 되며(이미 위협술에 숙련되어 있었다면 원하는 다른 기술 하나), @link[feats.intimidating-glare]{위협적인 노려보기} 기술 재주를 보너스 재주로 얻습니다.

name: Wintertouched Human

description.value: The power of winter flows through you. This heritage is most common among the Jadwiga of Irrisen, due to their descent from Baba Yaga, and certain Erutaki touched by the spirits. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

_desc_en: The power of winter flows through you. This heritage is most common among the Jadwiga of Irrisen, due to their descent from Baba Yaga, and certain Erutaki touched by the spirits. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 겨울의 힘이 당신을 통해 흐릅니다. 이 유산은 바바 야가의 후손인 이리센의 자드위가와 정령에 닿은 일부 에루타키 사이에서 가장 흔합니다. 당신은 자신 레벨의 절반과 같은 냉기 저항을 얻으며(최소 1), 환경 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극심한 것으로 취급합니다(믿기 힘든 냉기는 극심으로, 극심한 냉기는 심각으로, 이런 식으로).

name: Pine Leshy

description.value: You excrete a thick, sticky sap from your bark-like flesh, making it easier to climb and hold onto your gear. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} feat as a bonus feat, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} you.

_desc_en: You excrete a thick, sticky sap from your bark-like flesh, making it easier to climb and hold onto your gear. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} feat as a bonus feat, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 나무껍질 같은 살결에서 걸쭉하고 끈적한 수액을 분비하여, 오르기 쉽고 장비를 붙잡기 쉽게 만듭니다. 당신은 @link[feats.combat-climber]{전투 등반가} 재주를 보너스 재주로 얻으며, 당신을 @link[actions.disarm]{무장 해제}하려는 시도에 대한 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Pixie

description.value: You are larger than other sprites. Instead of Tiny, your size is Small.

_desc_en: You are larger than other sprites. Instead of Tiny, your size is Small.
_desc_ko: 당신은 다른 스프라이트보다 큽니다. 초소형(Tiny) 대신, 당신의 크기는 소형(Small)입니다.

name: Stronggut Shisk

description.value: Your metabolism is slow, allowing you to go for days without food and process maladies at a slower rate. You can go for 1 week without food before you begin to starve Additionally, the onset times and lengths of stages for all diseases and poisons that affect you are increased by 50%. If the onset time or stage is instant or lasts only 1 round, this ability has no effect.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your metabolism is slow, allowing you to go for days without food and process maladies at a slower rate. You can go for 1 week without food before you begin to starve Additionally, the onset times and lengths of stages for all diseases and poisons that affect you are increased by 50%. If the onset time or stage is instant or lasts only 1 round, this ability has no effect.
_desc_ko: 당신의 신진대사는 느려, 며칠 동안 음식 없이 지낼 수 있고 질병을 더 느린 속도로 처리할 수 있습니다. 당신은 굶주리기 시작하기 전까지 1주일 동안 음식 없이 지낼 수 있습니다. 또한, 당신에게 영향을 미치는 모든 질병과 독의 발현 시간과 단계 지속 시간이 50% 증가합니다. 발현 시간이나 단계가 즉시이거나 1라운드만 지속되는 경우, 이 능력은 효과가 없습니다.

name: Lahkgyan Vanara

description.value: Your vanara ancestors might have been born in Ragdya's image, but they found survival only in service to his enemy: the red-faced Lahkgya. You have sharp teeth meant for gnashing and ripping into flesh. You can subsist on raw meat alone. You have a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: Your vanara ancestors might have been born in Ragdya's image, but they found survival only in service to his enemy: the red-faced Lahkgya. You have sharp teeth meant for gnashing and ripping into flesh. You can subsist on raw meat alone. You have a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 바나라 조상은 라그디아의 모습으로 태어났을지 모르나, 그들은 오직 그의 적인 붉은 얼굴의 라크갸를 섬김으로써만 생존을 찾았습니다. 당신은 이를 갈고 살을 찢기 위한 날카로운 이빨을 지니고 있습니다. 당신은 날고기만으로도 연명할 수 있습니다. 당신은 1d6 관통 피해를 입히는 턱 비무장 공격을 지닙니다. 당신의 턱은 격투(brawling) 무기군에 속하며 정교함(finesse)과 비무장(unarmed) 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Ascetic Tanuki

description.value: It's said your round form is the result of calmness and restraint, not indulgence. You gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from something you're trying to smell or halve the range if you're upwind. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks whenever you're trying to locate food, drink, or a consumable item that's ingested (such as a potion or elixir) using your scent.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: It's said your round form is the result of calmness and restraint, not indulgence. You gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from something you're trying to smell or halve the range if you're upwind. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks whenever you're trying to locate food, drink, or a consumable item that's ingested (such as a potion or elixir) using your scent.
_desc_ko: 당신의 둥근 몸매는 방종이 아니라 침착함과 절제의 결과라고 합니다. 당신은 30피트 범위의 부정확한 감각으로 후각(scent)을 얻습니다. GM은 보통 당신이 냄새 맡으려는 대상으로부터 바람을 등지고 있으면 범위를 두 배로, 바람을 마주하고 있으면 범위를 절반으로 합니다. 또한, 당신은 후각을 사용해 음식, 음료, 또는 (물약이나 영약처럼) 섭취하는 소모성 물품을 찾으려 할 때마다 감지(Perception) 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Fruit Leshy

description.value: Your body continually produces small fruits imbued with primal magic. At dawn each day, a new fruit ripens. You or an ally can remove this fruit as an Interact action. If a living creature that can derive sustenance from fruit consumes it as an Interact action within the next hour, they regain @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d8[vitality,healing]|shortLabel] Hit Points, plus an additional 1d8 Hit Points for every 2 of your levels beyond 1st. This effect has the healing and vitality traits.

_desc_en: Your body continually produces small fruits imbued with primal magic. At dawn each day, a new fruit ripens. You or an ally can remove this fruit as an Interact action. If a living creature that can derive sustenance from fruit consumes it as an Interact action within the next hour, they regain @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d8[vitality,healing]|shortLabel] Hit Points, plus an additional 1d8 Hit Points for every 2 of your levels beyond 1st. This effect has the healing and vitality traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 원시(primal) 마법이 깃든 작은 열매를 끊임없이 생산합니다. 매일 새벽, 새로운 열매가 익습니다. 당신이나 아군은 이 열매를 조작(Interact) 행동으로 딸 수 있습니다. 열매로부터 자양분을 얻을 수 있는 살아있는 존재가 다음 한 시간 이내에 조작 행동으로 이를 섭취하면, @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d8[vitality,healing]|shortLabel] 체력에 더해 1레벨을 넘는 레벨 2당 추가로 1d8 체력을 회복합니다. 이 효과는 치유(healing)와 생기(vitality) 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Luminous Sprite

description.value: You glow with magical luminance. You naturally shed light as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.8Jdw4yAzWYylGePS]{Torch}; this light has the evocation, light, and primal traits. You can extinguish, rekindle, or change the color of this light using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

_desc_en: You glow with magical luminance. You naturally shed light as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.8Jdw4yAzWYylGePS]{Torch}; this light has the evocation, light, and primal traits. You can extinguish, rekindle, or change the color of this light using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마법적 광휘로 빛납니다. 당신은 자연히 @link[equipment.torch]{횃불}처럼 빛을 발합니다. 이 빛은 방출(evocation), 빛(light), 원시(primal) 특성을 지닙니다. 당신은 하나의 행동으로 이 빛을 끄거나, 다시 켜거나, 색을 바꿀 수 있으며, 이 행동은 집중(concentrate) 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Titan Nagaji

description.value: You were raised to be a warrior or a bodyguard, and your specialized diet and bulging muscles have made your scales as strong as armored plates. Your scales are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of +3, and have the comfort trait. You can never wear other armor or remove your scales. You can etch armor runes onto your scales.

_desc_en: You were raised to be a warrior or a bodyguard, and your specialized diet and bulging muscles have made your scales as strong as armored plates. Your scales are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of +3, and have the comfort trait. You can never wear other armor or remove your scales. You can etch armor runes onto your scales.
_desc_ko: 당신은 전사나 경호원으로 길러졌으며, 특수한 식단과 불룩한 근육이 당신의 비늘을 장갑판만큼 튼튼하게 만들었습니다. 당신의 비늘은 판금(plate) 무기군에 속하는 중형 방어구로, AC에 +4 물품 보너스, 민첩 상한 +1, 판정 페널티 –2, 이동 속도 페널티 –5피트, 근력 수치 +3을 부여하며 편안함(comfort) 특성을 지닙니다. 당신은 결코 다른 방어구를 착용하거나 자신의 비늘을 제거할 수 없습니다. 당신은 자신의 비늘에 방어구 룬을 새길 수 있습니다.

name: Observant Halfling

description.value: Your finely honed senses quickly clue you in to danger or trickery. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC, though not to your Perception checks.

_desc_en: Your finely honed senses quickly clue you in to danger or trickery. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC, though not to your Perception checks.
_desc_ko: 당신의 예리하게 벼려진 감각은 위험이나 속임수를 재빨리 알아챕니다. 당신은 감지(Perception) 판정에는 아니지만, 감지 DC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Waning Moon Sarangay

description.value:
Your ancestors were named for the moon in transition, ever-changing and ephemeral. They're the keepers of secret arts, just as the waning moon hides its face, and their communities were highly regarded for their storytellers, performers, and artists. You lived among your community on the outskirts of forests or rivers, where many answers came as riddles, and you learned to see the world from different perspectives. Your people are often red or fawn colored, with prominent eyes and flat, compact horns. You become trained in your choice of Acrobatics, Crafting, or Performance.

Once per day, when you roll a critical failure with the chosen skill, you can reroll the check, taking the new result, even if it's worse. Rerolling in this way is a fortune effect.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your ancestors were named for the moon in transition, ever-changing and ephemeral. They're the keepers of secret arts, just as the waning moon hides its face, and their communities were highly regarded for their storytellers, performers, and artists. You lived among your community on the outskirts of forests or rivers, where many answers came as riddles, and you learned to see the world from different perspectives. Your people are often red or fawn colored, with prominent eyes and flat, compact horns. You become trained in your choice of Acrobatics, Crafting, or Performance.

Once per day, when you roll a critical failure with the chosen skill, you can reroll the check, taking the new result, even if it's worse. Rerolling in this way is a fortune effect.
_desc_ko:
당신의 조상들은 변화하는 달, 늘 변하고 덧없는 달의 이름을 따서 불렸습니다. 하현달이 그 얼굴을 감추듯, 그들은 비밀스러운 기예의 수호자였으며, 그들의 공동체는 이야기꾼, 공연자, 예술가로 높이 존경받았습니다. 당신은 숲이나 강의 외곽에 있는 공동체에서 살았고, 그곳에서는 많은 답이 수수께끼로 다가왔으며, 당신은 세상을 다른 관점에서 보는 법을 배웠습니다. 당신의 사람들은 흔히 붉거나 담황색을 띠며, 두드러진 눈과 평평하고 작은 뿔을 지닙니다. 당신은 곡예술(Acrobatics), 제작술(Crafting), 공연술(Performance) 중 선택한 것에 숙련이 됩니다.

하루에 한 번, 선택한 기술로 대실패를 굴렸을 때, 그 판정을 다시 굴려 결과가 더 나쁘더라도 새 결과를 취할 수 있습니다. 이렇게 다시 굴리는 것은 행운(fortune) 효과입니다.

name: Laborer Android

description.value: Your body is adapted to endure physical hardships or perform hard labor for long periods of time. You become trained in Athletics (or another skill if you're already trained in Athletics), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.C0Tcelg3BAPhML6J]{Hefty Hauler} skill feat.

_desc_en: Your body is adapted to endure physical hardships or perform hard labor for long periods of time. You become trained in Athletics (or another skill if you're already trained in Athletics), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.C0Tcelg3BAPhML6J]{Hefty Hauler} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 육체적 고난을 견디거나 오랜 기간 힘든 노동을 수행하도록 적응되어 있습니다. 운동술 훈련을 받게 되며(이미 운동술 훈련을 받은 경우 다른 기술 하나), @link[feats.hefty-hauler]{힘센 짐꾼} 기술 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Hold-Scarred Orc

description.value: You are part of an orc community that participates in ritual scarification or tattooing. The marks on your skin show your exceptional hardiness and vitality. You gain 12 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 10. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} feat.

_desc_en: You are part of an orc community that participates in ritual scarification or tattooing. The marks on your skin show your exceptional hardiness and vitality. You gain 12 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 10. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 의식적 흉터내기나 문신을 행하는 오크 공동체의 일원입니다. 피부의 표식은 당신의 탁월한 강인함과 활력을 보여줍니다. 당신은 혈통으로부터 체력을 10 대신 12 얻습니다. 또한 @link[feats.diehard]{끝까지 버티기} 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Predator Strix

description.value: You come from a line of strix with exceptionally broad wings and lengthy talons. You gain a talon melee unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d4[slashing]] damage. Your talon attack is in the brawling group and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: You come from a line of strix with exceptionally broad wings and lengthy talons. You gain a talon melee unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d4[slashing]] damage. Your talon attack is in the brawling group and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 유난히 넓은 날개와 긴 발톱을 지닌 스트릭스 혈통 출신입니다. @Damage[1d4[slashing]] 피해를 입히는 발톱 근접 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 발톱 공격은 격투 무리에 속하며 민첩(agile), 정교함(finesse), 비무장(unarmed) 특성을 가집니다.

name: Elemental Heart Dwarf

description.value: Whether through a connection to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.sZrdzh0ANQnZGXJb]{Torag's} forge, the azers of the Plane of Fire, or another source, you can exude a burst of energy. Mbe'ke and Taralu dwarves of the Mwangi Expanse believe this heritage is a gift from dragons or elemental spirits. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. Once chosen, this can't be changed. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7qjfYsLNTr17Aftf]{Energy Emanation} activity.

_desc_en: Whether through a connection to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.sZrdzh0ANQnZGXJb]{Torag's} forge, the azers of the Plane of Fire, or another source, you can exude a burst of energy. Mbe'ke and Taralu dwarves of the Mwangi Expanse believe this heritage is a gift from dragons or elemental spirits. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. Once chosen, this can't be changed. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7qjfYsLNTr17Aftf]{Energy Emanation} activity.
_desc_ko: @link[deities.torag]{토라그}의 대장간과의 연결이든, 화염계의 애저이든, 또는 다른 근원을 통해서든, 당신은 에너지의 분출을 발산할 수 있습니다. 음와기 대확장지의 음베케와 타랄루 드워프들은 이 유산을 용이나 원소 정령의 선물이라 믿습니다. 다음 피해 유형 중 하나를 선택하십시오: 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염. 한 번 선택하면 변경할 수 없습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.energy-emanation]{에너지 발산} 활동을 얻습니다.

name: Thickcoat Shoony

description.value: You are a rare shoony who hails from colder climes. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on). You don't need to succeed at a flat check to target a concealed creature if that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} only by snow. Unless you wear protective gear or take shelter, environmental heat effects are one step more extreme for you.

_desc_en: You are a rare shoony who hails from colder climes. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on). You don't need to succeed at a flat check to target a concealed creature if that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} only by snow. Unless you wear protective gear or take shelter, environmental heat effects are one step more extreme for you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 더 추운 기후 출신의 드문 슈니입니다. 당신은 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 같은 냉기 저항을 얻으며, 환경적 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극심한 것으로 취급합니다(믿기 힘든 냉기는 극심한 냉기가 되고, 극심한 냉기는 심각한 냉기가 되는 식). 은폐된 크리쳐가 오직 눈(snow)에 의해서만 @link[conditions.concealed]{은폐(Concealed)}된 경우, 그 크리쳐를 목표로 삼을 때 평면 판정에 성공할 필요가 없습니다. 보호 장비를 착용하거나 피난처를 취하지 않는 한, 환경적 열기 효과는 당신에게 한 단계 더 극심합니다.

name: Hillock Halfling

description.value: Accustomed to a calm life in the hills, your people find rest and relaxation especially replenishing, particularly when indulging in creature comforts. When you regain Hit Points overnight, add your level to the Hit Points regained. When anyone uses the Medicine skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat your Wounds}, you can eat a snack to add your level to the Hit Points you regain from their treatment.

_desc_en: Accustomed to a calm life in the hills, your people find rest and relaxation especially replenishing, particularly when indulging in creature comforts. When you regain Hit Points overnight, add your level to the Hit Points regained. When anyone uses the Medicine skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat your Wounds}, you can eat a snack to add your level to the Hit Points you regain from their treatment.
_desc_ko: 언덕에서의 평온한 삶에 익숙한 당신의 종족은 특히 안락함을 누릴 때 휴식과 이완으로 유난히 잘 회복합니다. 밤사이 체력을 회복할 때, 회복하는 체력에 당신의 레벨을 더합니다. 누군가가 의술 기술로 당신의 @link[actions.treat-wounds]{상처를 치료(Treat your Wounds)}할 때, 당신은 간식을 먹어 그 치료로 회복하는 체력에 당신의 레벨을 더할 수 있습니다.

name: Impersonator Android

description.value:
Your body was augmented with processes and an appearance intended to blend in with humans more easily.

You become trained in Deception (or another skill if you're already trained in Deception). You don't require a disguise kit when attempting Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} a human.

In addition, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Impersonate checks to pretend that you're a human version of yourself, rather than an android. This bonus doesn't apply to other checks to Impersonate humans.

rules.label: Impersonator Android (to Impersonate a human version of yourself)

_desc_en:
Your body was augmented with processes and an appearance intended to blend in with humans more easily.

You become trained in Deception (or another skill if you're already trained in Deception). You don't require a disguise kit when attempting Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} a human.

In addition, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Impersonate checks to pretend that you're a human version of yourself, rather than an android. This bonus doesn't apply to other checks to Impersonate humans.
_desc_ko:
당신의 몸은 인간과 더 쉽게 어우러지도록 의도된 처리와 외양으로 강화되었습니다.

당신은 기만술 훈련을 받게 됩니다(이미 기만술 훈련을 받은 경우 다른 기술 하나). 인간을 @link[actions.impersonate]{사칭(Impersonate)}하기 위한 기만술 판정을 시도할 때 변장 도구가 필요하지 않습니다.

또한, 안드로이드가 아닌 자신의 인간 버전인 척하는 사칭 판정에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 다른 인간을 사칭하는 판정에는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Sanctuary Samsaran

description.value: Your past incarnations were reborn in sanctuaries in northern Zi Ha, and you have recollections of being trained to concentrate and focus for long periods of time. Your hazy flashbacks also reveal useful scripture in the books your past lives had eagerly consumed. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.jsEBrm8SPcsokJLw]{Tap the Past} action.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your past incarnations were reborn in sanctuaries in northern Zi Ha, and you have recollections of being trained to concentrate and focus for long periods of time. Your hazy flashbacks also reveal useful scripture in the books your past lives had eagerly consumed. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.jsEBrm8SPcsokJLw]{Tap the Past} action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 과거 화신들은 북부 지 하의 성역에서 다시 태어났으며, 당신은 오랜 기간 집중하고 몰두하도록 훈련받은 기억을 지니고 있습니다. 어렴풋한 회상은 과거의 삶들이 열심히 탐독했던 책 속의 유용한 경전 또한 드러냅니다. 당신은 @link[actions.tap-the-past]{과거 두드리기} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Murkeyed Azarketi

description.value: You live in murky waters and have grown accustomed to life in a low-visibility environment. You need only a successful @Check[flat|dc:3] when targeting a concealed creature and a successful @Check[flat|dc:9] when targeting a hidden creature.

_desc_en: You live in murky waters and have grown accustomed to life in a low-visibility environment. You need only a successful @Check[flat|dc:3] when targeting a concealed creature and a successful @Check[flat|dc:9] when targeting a hidden creature.
_desc_ko: 당신은 탁한 물속에 살며 시야가 낮은 환경에서의 삶에 익숙해졌습니다. 은폐된 크리쳐를 목표로 삼을 때는 @Check[flat|dc:3] 성공만, 은신한 크리쳐를 목표로 삼을 때는 @Check[flat|dc:9] 성공만 있으면 됩니다.

name: Aiuvarin

description.value: You have elves, or possibly other aiuvarins, in your family tree. You have pointed ears and other telltale signs of elf heritage. You gain the elf trait, the aiuvarin trait, and low-light vision. In addition, when you gain an ancestry feat, you can choose from aiuvarin and elf feats in addition to those from your ancestry.

_desc_en: You have elves, or possibly other aiuvarins, in your family tree. You have pointed ears and other telltale signs of elf heritage. You gain the elf trait, the aiuvarin trait, and low-light vision. In addition, when you gain an ancestry feat, you can choose from aiuvarin and elf feats in addition to those from your ancestry.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가계에는 엘프, 혹은 다른 아이우바린이 있습니다. 당신은 뾰족한 귀와 엘프 유산의 여타 명백한 징표들을 지니고 있습니다. 당신은 엘프 특성, 아이우바린 특성, 그리고 저광 시야를 얻습니다. 또한, 혈통 재주를 얻을 때 당신의 혈통 재주에 더해 아이우바린 및 엘프 재주 중에서도 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Healer Samsaran

description.value:
In seeking enlightenment, your past incarnations have wandered away from the ancestral homelands of Zi Ha, exploring the different nations of Tian Xia and elsewhere in Golarion. Your past incarnations had dangerous encounters while traveling, and you frequently have flashbacks to healing wounds. You become trained in Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in Medicine (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

When you use Medicine to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on yourself, you can use your special techniques to add your level to the Hit Points you regain from the treatment.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
In seeking enlightenment, your past incarnations have wandered away from the ancestral homelands of Zi Ha, exploring the different nations of Tian Xia and elsewhere in Golarion. Your past incarnations had dangerous encounters while traveling, and you frequently have flashbacks to healing wounds. You become trained in Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in Medicine (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

When you use Medicine to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on yourself, you can use your special techniques to add your level to the Hit Points you regain from the treatment.
_desc_ko:
깨달음을 추구하며 당신의 과거 화신들은 지 하의 선조 고향에서 벗어나 티안 시아의 여러 나라와 골라리온 곳곳을 탐험했습니다. 당신의 과거 화신들은 여행 중 위험한 조우를 겪었고, 당신은 상처를 치유하는 회상을 자주 합니다. 당신은 의술 훈련을 받게 됩니다. 만약 (예를 들어 배경이나 클래스로부터) 자동으로 의술 훈련을 받게 된다면, 대신 원하는 기술 하나의 훈련을 받게 됩니다.

의술로 자신에게 @link[actions.treat-wounds]{상처 치료(Treat Wounds)}를 사용할 때, 당신의 특수 기법을 사용해 그 치료로 회복하는 체력에 당신의 레벨을 더할 수 있습니다.

name: Sage Jotunborn

description.value: You were tasked with keeping oral and stitched histories for your family, your clan, or even an entire settlement. You are trained in Society. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for a lore skill of your choice.

_desc_en: You were tasked with keeping oral and stitched histories for your family, your clan, or even an entire settlement. You are trained in Society. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for a lore skill of your choice.
_desc_ko: 당신은 가족, 씨족, 심지어 정착지 전체를 위해 구전 및 실로 엮은 역사를 보존하는 임무를 맡았습니다. 당신은 사회에 숙련되어 있습니다. 또한 당신이 선택한 지식 기술에 대해 @link[feats.additional-lore]{추가 지식} 일반 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Dark Fields Kitsune

description.value: You can exert your unsettling presence to subtly Demoralize others. When you do, Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ul4I0ER6pj3U5eAk]{Invigorating Fear} reaction. Your alternate form is a fox, which has the statistics of 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}.

_desc_en: You can exert your unsettling presence to subtly Demoralize others. When you do, Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ul4I0ER6pj3U5eAk]{Invigorating Fear} reaction. Your alternate form is a fox, which has the statistics of 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 불안한 존재감을 발휘해 은근히 다른 이들을 위압할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 때 위압은 청각(auditory) 특성을 잃고 시각(visual) 특성을 얻으며, 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못하는 크리쳐를 위압하려 할 때 불이익을 받지 않습니다. 당신은 또한 @link[actions.invigorating-fear]{활력을 주는 공포} 반응을 얻습니다. 당신의 대체 형태는 여우로, 1랭크 @link[spells.pest-form]{해충 형태}의 수치를 가집니다.

name: Sharp-Eared Catfolk

description.value: You were born with big, expressive ears that move with your moods and perk up at any unexpected sound. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to locate undetected creatures that you could hear within 30 feet with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action. As long as you're aware of a creature via sound, once per round, your ears can help you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.sn2hIy1iIJX9Vpgj]{Point Out} the creature to all allies as a free action.

_desc_en: You were born with big, expressive ears that move with your moods and perk up at any unexpected sound. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to locate undetected creatures that you could hear within 30 feet with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action. As long as you're aware of a creature via sound, once per round, your ears can help you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.sn2hIy1iIJX9Vpgj]{Point Out} the creature to all allies as a free action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 기분에 따라 움직이고 예상치 못한 소리에 쫑긋 서는 크고 표현력 있는 귀를 타고났습니다. @link[actions.seek]{탐색(Seek)} 행동으로 9미터(30피트) 이내에서 들을 수 있는, 발각되지 않은 크리쳐의 위치를 찾는 데 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 소리를 통해 크리쳐를 인지하고 있는 한, 라운드당 한 번, 당신의 귀는 자유 행동으로 모든 아군에게 그 크리쳐를 @link[actions.point-out]{지목(Point Out)}하도록 도울 수 있습니다.

name: Ancient Elf

description.value: In your long life, you've dabbled in many paths and many styles. A typical ancient elf is at least 100 years old, though you might be younger at the GM's discretion. Choose a class other than your own. You gain the multiclass dedication feat for that class, even though you don't meet its level prerequisite. You must still meet its other prerequisites to gain the feat.

_desc_en: In your long life, you've dabbled in many paths and many styles. A typical ancient elf is at least 100 years old, though you might be younger at the GM's discretion. Choose a class other than your own. You gain the multiclass dedication feat for that class, even though you don't meet its level prerequisite. You must still meet its other prerequisites to gain the feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 긴 생애 동안 여러 길과 여러 방식을 조금씩 익혀 왔습니다. 전형적인 고대 엘프는 최소 100살이지만, GM의 재량에 따라 더 어릴 수도 있습니다. 자신의 클래스가 아닌 클래스 하나를 선택하십시오. 당신은 그 클래스의 멀티클래스 헌신 재주를 레벨 선행 조건을 충족하지 못하더라도 얻습니다. 다만 그 재주를 얻으려면 여전히 다른 선행 조건은 충족해야 합니다.

name: Cavern Elf

description.value: You were born or spent many years in underground tunnels or caverns where light is scarce. You gain darkvision.

_desc_en: You were born or spent many years in underground tunnels or caverns where light is scarce. You gain darkvision.
_desc_ko: 당신은 빛이 드문 지하 터널이나 동굴에서 태어났거나 여러 해를 보냈습니다. 당신은 암시야를 얻습니다.

name: Venom-Resistant Vishkanya

description.value: Your body contains not just venom but numerous antivenoms. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and each of your successful saving throws against a poison affliction reduces its stage by 2, or by 1 for a virulent poison. Each critical success against an ongoing poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 for a virulent poison.

_desc_en: Your body contains not just venom but numerous antivenoms. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and each of your successful saving throws against a poison affliction reduces its stage by 2, or by 1 for a virulent poison. Each critical success against an ongoing poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 for a virulent poison.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸에는 독뿐만 아니라 수많은 해독 성분도 들어 있습니다. 당신은 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 같은 독 저항을 얻으며, 독 질환에 대한 내성 굴림에 성공할 때마다 그 단계가 2 감소하거나, 맹독성 독의 경우 1 감소합니다. 지속 중인 독에 대한 대성공마다 그 단계가 3 감소하거나, 맹독성 독의 경우 2 감소합니다.

name: Bakuwa Lizardfolk

description.value: Your body is covered in bony plates. Your plates are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of +3, and have the aquadynamic and comfort traits. You can never wear other armor or remove your plates. You can etch armor runes onto your plates.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your body is covered in bony plates. Your plates are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of +3, and have the aquadynamic and comfort traits. You can never wear other armor or remove your plates. You can etch armor runes onto your plates.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 뼈 판으로 덮여 있습니다. 당신의 판은 판금 갑옷 무리에 속하는 중형 갑옷으로, AC에 +4 아이템 보너스, +1의 민첩 상한, -2의 판정 불이익, -1.5미터(-5피트)의 이동력 불이익, +3의 근력 수치를 부여하며 수중역학(aquadynamic) 및 편안함(comfort) 특성을 가집니다. 당신은 다른 갑옷을 결코 착용하거나 판을 제거할 수 없습니다. 당신은 판에 갑옷 룬을 새길 수 있습니다.

name: Pelagic Merfolk

description.value: You're a merfolk of the open seas. Your tail is patterned after the silvery tuna and herring that school by the million in your hunting grounds. Water obeys your will, and with a quick word, you can draw a sheathe of it around you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yOk8s1pftOe5I9Sg]{Shielding Wave} action.

_desc_en: You're a merfolk of the open seas. Your tail is patterned after the silvery tuna and herring that school by the million in your hunting grounds. Water obeys your will, and with a quick word, you can draw a sheathe of it around you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yOk8s1pftOe5I9Sg]{Shielding Wave} action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 먼바다의 머포크입니다. 당신의 꼬리는 당신의 사냥터에서 수백만 마리씩 떼 지어 다니는 은빛 참치와 청어를 본떠 무늬져 있습니다. 물은 당신의 뜻에 따르며, 짧은 한마디로 당신 주위에 물의 막을 두를 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.shielding-wave]{보호의 파도} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Cliffscale Lizardfolk

description.value: Your toes are adapted for gripping and climbing. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} feat as a bonus feat, and as long as you aren't wearing footwear, you can use the sticky pads on your feet to climb, leaving your hands free. Additionally, if you roll a success on an Athletics check to climb, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your toes are adapted for gripping and climbing. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} feat as a bonus feat, and as long as you aren't wearing footwear, you can use the sticky pads on your feet to climb, leaving your hands free. Additionally, if you roll a success on an Athletics check to climb, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 발가락은 붙잡고 오르는 데 적응되어 있습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.combat-climber]{전투 등반가} 재주를 보너스 재주로 얻으며, 신발을 신지 않은 한 발의 끈끈한 발판을 사용해 손을 자유롭게 둔 채 등반할 수 있습니다. 또한, 등반을 위한 운동술 판정에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Discarded Fleshwarp

description.value: The biomancers and mutagenists who warped your form labeled you a "discard on discovery"—a euphemism for destroying you on sight. An anomaly among anomalies, your body stubbornly repudiates the efforts of fleshcrafters seeking to mold you to their grandiose visions, and your immune responses blunt the worst effects of unwanted fleshwarping attempts. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a transmutation effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: The biomancers and mutagenists who warped your form labeled you a "discard on discovery"—a euphemism for destroying you on sight. An anomaly among anomalies, your body stubbornly repudiates the efforts of fleshcrafters seeking to mold you to their grandiose visions, and your immune responses blunt the worst effects of unwanted fleshwarping attempts. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a transmutation effect, you get a critical success instead.
