_desc_ko: 당신의 형태를 변형시킨 생체술사와 변이원술사들은 당신에게 "발견 즉시 폐기"라는 딱지를 붙였습니다. 이는 발견하는 즉시 파괴하라는 완곡한 표현입니다. 이상 중의 이상인 당신의 몸은 웅대한 구상에 맞춰 당신을 빚으려는 살조각술사들의 노력을 완강히 거부하며, 당신의 면역 반응은 원치 않는 살변형 시도의 최악의 효과를 무디게 합니다. 변성계 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Dragonscaled Kobold

description.value: Thanks to your warren's association with a dragon, your scales are sturdier than other kobolds'. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against dragon breath, effects with the sleep trait, and effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}.

_desc_en: Thanks to your warren's association with a dragon, your scales are sturdier than other kobolds'. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against dragon breath, effects with the sleep trait, and effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 굴이 용과 연을 맺은 덕분에, 당신의 비늘은 다른 코볼드의 것보다 더 단단합니다. 당신은 혈통으로부터 체력을 6 대신 10 얻습니다. 당신은 용의 브레스, 수면(sleep) 특성을 지닌 효과, 그리고 당신을 @link[conditions.paralyzed]{마비(Paralyzed)}시킬 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Sturdy Skeleton

description.value: Certain hazardous conditions are not suitable for the average skeleton, so a necromancer might choose to reanimate the bones of a dwarf, orc, or other creature with a reputation for sturdiness. You have 10 Hit Points instead of 6 and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} feat.

_desc_en: Certain hazardous conditions are not suitable for the average skeleton, so a necromancer might choose to reanimate the bones of a dwarf, orc, or other creature with a reputation for sturdiness. You have 10 Hit Points instead of 6 and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} feat.
_desc_ko: 특정 위험한 환경은 평범한 해골에게 적합하지 않으므로, 강령술사는 강인함으로 명성 높은 드워프, 오크, 또는 다른 크리쳐의 뼈를 되살리기로 선택할 수 있습니다. 당신은 체력을 6 대신 10 가지며 @link[feats.diehard]{끝까지 버티기} 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Cataphract Fleshwarp

description.value:
Your battle-hardened skeleton is laced with additional cartilage and muscle to help bear armor across vast areas of operation, and your skin is bedecked with tiny spurs of pliable, resilient keratin to optimize the grip and weight distribution of your armor. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BStw1cANwx5baL6d]{Armor Proficiency} feat.

If your class makes you trained in all types of armor, you instead become trained in Athletics (or a skill of your choice if you're already trained in Athletics) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Lc4dJZivRwU3QEmT]{Armor Assist} skill feat.

_desc_en:
Your battle-hardened skeleton is laced with additional cartilage and muscle to help bear armor across vast areas of operation, and your skin is bedecked with tiny spurs of pliable, resilient keratin to optimize the grip and weight distribution of your armor. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BStw1cANwx5baL6d]{Armor Proficiency} feat.

If your class makes you trained in all types of armor, you instead become trained in Athletics (or a skill of your choice if you're already trained in Athletics) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Lc4dJZivRwU3QEmT]{Armor Assist} skill feat.
_desc_ko:
당신의 전투로 단련된 골격은 광활한 작전 지역에 걸쳐 갑옷을 지탱하도록 추가적인 연골과 근육으로 엮여 있으며, 당신의 피부는 갑옷의 접지력과 무게 분산을 최적화하기 위해 유연하고 탄력 있는 케라틴의 작은 돌기로 장식되어 있습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.armor-proficiency]{갑옷 숙련} 재주를 얻습니다.

만약 당신의 클래스가 모든 유형의 갑옷 훈련을 부여한다면, 당신은 대신 운동술 훈련을 받게 되며(이미 운동술 훈련을 받은 경우 원하는 기술 하나) @link[feats.armor-assist]{갑옷 보조} 기술 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Old-Blood Vishkanya

description.value: You have a direct matrilineal line to the original group of vishkanyas upon the Vudrani ships that came to reclaim Jalmeray. Since then, your family has adjusted well to a new life in the Inner Sea. You become trained in Society (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained in Society), and you gain your choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise} feat.

_desc_en: You have a direct matrilineal line to the original group of vishkanyas upon the Vudrani ships that came to reclaim Jalmeray. Since then, your family has adjusted well to a new life in the Inner Sea. You become trained in Society (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained in Society), and you gain your choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise} feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 잘메레이를 되찾으러 온 부드라니 선박에 탔던 원조 비쉬카냐 집단으로 이어지는 직계 모계 혈통을 지니고 있습니다. 그 이후로 당신의 가문은 이너 시의 새로운 삶에 잘 적응했습니다. 당신은 사회술 훈련을 받게 되며(이미 사회술 훈련을 받은 경우 원하는 기술 하나), @link[feats.courtly-graces]{궁정의 품위} 또는 @link[feats.streetwise]{거리 사정통} 재주 중 원하는 것을 얻습니다.

name: Liminal Fetchling

description.value: You come from a line of fetchlings with a closer connection to the Ethereal and Shadow Planes, and you share those realms' affinity with the in-between and unseen. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to locate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures within 60 feet when using the Seek action. Your flat check to target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creatures is @Check[flat|dc:3] instead of DC 5, and your flat check to target undetected creatures is @Check[flat|dc:9] instead of DC 11.

_desc_en: You come from a line of fetchlings with a closer connection to the Ethereal and Shadow Planes, and you share those realms' affinity with the in-between and unseen. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to locate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures within 60 feet when using the Seek action. Your flat check to target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creatures is @Check[flat|dc:3] instead of DC 5, and your flat check to target undetected creatures is @Check[flat|dc:9] instead of DC 11.
_desc_ko: 당신은 영기계와 그림자계에 더 가까이 연결된 페치링 혈통 출신으로, 그 영역들이 지닌 사이와 보이지 않는 것에 대한 친화성을 공유합니다. 탐색 행동을 사용할 때 18미터(60피트) 이내의 @link[conditions.undetected]{발각되지 않은(Undetected)} 크리쳐의 위치를 찾는 데 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. @link[conditions.concealed]{은폐된(Concealed)} 크리쳐를 목표로 삼기 위한 당신의 평면 판정은 DC 5 대신 @Check[flat|dc:3]이며, 발각되지 않은 크리쳐를 목표로 삼기 위한 평면 판정은 DC 11 대신 @Check[flat|dc:9]입니다.

name: Reef Merfolk

description.value: You were raised amid colorful corals and schools of tropical fish. Compared to most merfolk, your body is vividly hued with stripes, spots, and patterns like a clownfish or angelfish. You're used to the occasionally toxic denizens of your home and are bothered little by stings or petty poisons. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and each of your successful saving throws against a poison affliction reduces its stage by 2, or by 1 for a virulent poison. Each critical success against an ongoing poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 for a virulent poison.

_desc_en: You were raised amid colorful corals and schools of tropical fish. Compared to most merfolk, your body is vividly hued with stripes, spots, and patterns like a clownfish or angelfish. You're used to the occasionally toxic denizens of your home and are bothered little by stings or petty poisons. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and each of your successful saving throws against a poison affliction reduces its stage by 2, or by 1 for a virulent poison. Each critical success against an ongoing poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 for a virulent poison.
_desc_ko: 당신은 화려한 산호와 열대어 무리 속에서 자랐습니다. 대부분의 머포크와 비교해 당신의 몸은 흰동가리나 엔젤피시처럼 줄무늬, 반점, 무늬로 선명하게 물들어 있습니다. 당신은 고향의 이따금 독성을 띤 거주자들에 익숙하며 쏘임이나 하찮은 독에 거의 시달리지 않습니다. 당신은 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 같은 독 저항을 얻으며, 독 질환에 대한 내성 굴림에 성공할 때마다 그 단계가 2 감소하거나, 맹독성 독의 경우 1 감소합니다. 지속 중인 독에 대한 대성공마다 그 단계가 3 감소하거나, 맹독성 독의 경우 2 감소합니다.

name: Flying Animal

description.value:
You are an animal that can take flight for long or sustained bursts, such as an eagle, bat, bee, or flying squirrel.

The awakening process has disrupted your ability to fly as freely as you once did. What used to be an automatic process is now one that you must apply some thought to until it becomes automatic once again. You can still slow your descent, so you take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall. Most flying awakened animals choose the Take Flight ancestry feat at 1st level to regain a limited ability to fly. You have a land Speed of 20 feet and one animal attack of your choice (typically beak, claw, jaws, talon, or wing).

_desc_en:
You are an animal that can take flight for long or sustained bursts, such as an eagle, bat, bee, or flying squirrel.

The awakening process has disrupted your ability to fly as freely as you once did. What used to be an automatic process is now one that you must apply some thought to until it becomes automatic once again. You can still slow your descent, so you take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall. Most flying awakened animals choose the Take Flight ancestry feat at 1st level to regain a limited ability to fly. You have a land Speed of 20 feet and one animal attack of your choice (typically beak, claw, jaws, talon, or wing).
_desc_ko:
당신은 독수리, 박쥐, 벌, 날다람쥐처럼 길게 혹은 지속적으로 비행할 수 있는 동물입니다.

각성 과정은 당신이 예전만큼 자유롭게 나는 능력을 방해했습니다. 예전에는 자동적이던 과정이 이제는 다시 자동이 될 때까지 어느 정도 의식을 기울여야 하는 것이 되었습니다. 당신은 여전히 낙하 속도를 늦출 수 있어, 떨어지는 거리와 상관없이 낙하로 인한 피해를 입지 않습니다. 대부분의 비행 각성 동물은 1레벨에 제한적인 비행 능력을 되찾기 위해 비상(Take Flight) 혈통 재주를 선택합니다. 당신은 6미터(20피트)의 지상 이동력과 원하는 동물 공격 하나(보통 부리, 발톱, 턱, 갈고리발톱, 또는 날개)를 가집니다.

name: Tidepool Dragonet

description.value:
You have a slender, eel-like body with azure scales. Your wings sweep along your body like massive fins, making you well suited for watery terrain.

You gain the amphibious trait, and a swim Speed of 15 feet. You add Thalassic to your list of known languages.

_desc_en:
You have a slender, eel-like body with azure scales. Your wings sweep along your body like massive fins, making you well suited for watery terrain.

You gain the amphibious trait, and a swim Speed of 15 feet. You add Thalassic to your list of known languages.
_desc_ko:
당신은 하늘색 비늘로 덮인 뱀장어 같은 날씬한 몸을 지녔습니다. 당신의 날개는 거대한 지느러미처럼 몸을 따라 뻗어 있어, 물이 있는 지형에 잘 적응되어 있습니다.

당신은 수륙양용 특성을 얻고, 15피트의 수영 이동력을 얻습니다. 당신은 아는 언어 목록에 탈라식을 추가합니다.

name: Suli

description.value: You are descended from a janni or otherwise embody a dichotomy of opposing elemental planar forces. You gain the suli trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from suli feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: You are descended from a janni or otherwise embody a dichotomy of opposing elemental planar forces. You gain the suli trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from suli feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 잔니의 후손이거나 그 밖의 방식으로 상반되는 원소 차원 힘들의 이분법을 구현합니다. 당신은 혈통의 특성에 더해 술리 특성을 얻습니다. 또한 저광 시야를 얻거나, 당신의 혈통이 이미 저광 시야를 지녔다면 암시야를 얻습니다. 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 술리 재주와 당신 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Born of Elements

description.value:
You were an aspect of nature—the rain, the wind, a ray of light—until the wild essences gave you a soul. Due to your natural connection, the tradition of any spells or magical abilities you gain from a yaoguai heritage or ancestry feat is primal instead of its normal tradition (usually occult).

  • Humanoid Form You remain attuned to the natural world. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fJImDBQfqfjKJOhk]{Sense Direction}, and you don't take a penalty if you don't have a compass.
  • Yaoguai Form The power of nature flows through you, ready to lash out. Choose @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kBhaPuzLUSwS6vVf]{Electric Arc}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IxhGEKl63R4QBvkj]{Frostbite}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.iYRDFxeVpJ5KIjmr]{Needle Darts}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9I8mp7RkjeXbkYfx]{Timber}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zA0jNIBRgLsyTpbm]{Scatter Scree}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1Yoipc5jNcMehtEW]{Slashing Gust}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.eSL5hVT9gXrnRLtd]{Spout}. You can cast this spell as an innate primal cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

You can cast this spell as an innate primal cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko:
당신은 비, 바람, 한 줄기 빛과 같은 자연의 한 측면이었으나, 야생의 정수가 당신에게 영혼을 부여했습니다. 당신의 타고난 연결로 인해, 요괴 유산이나 혈통 재주로부터 얻는 주문이나 마법 능력의 전통은 일반적인 전통(대개 초자연) 대신 원시가 됩니다.

  • 인간형 형태 당신은 자연 세계와 계속 교감합니다. @link[actions.sense-direction]{방향 감지(Sense Direction)}를 위한 생존술 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 나침반이 없어도 불이익을 받지 않습니다.
  • 요괴 형태 자연의 힘이 당신을 통해 흘러, 언제든 후려칠 준비가 되어 있습니다. @link[spells.electric-arc]{전기 호}, @link[spells.frostbite]{서리 물림}, @link[spells.ignition]{점화}, @link[spells.needle-darts]{바늘 화살}, @link[spells.timber]{목재}, @link[spells.scatter-scree]{자갈 흩뿌리기}, @link[spells.slashing-gust]{베는 돌풍}, 또는 @link[spells.spout]{물기둥} 중에서 선택하십시오. 당신은 이 주문을 마음대로 시전할 수 있는 타고난 원시 소마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)과 같은 주문 랭크로 상승합니다.

name: Fodder Skeleton

description.value: Humans, and those who are physically closest to them, are the favored material of necromancers. They are readily available, and their physiology has been studied the most extensively, so these skeletons can be easily mass-produced. Despite their name, fodder skeletons make rather mobile foot soldiers due to how efficiently they transfer necromantic energy within their bodies. You have a base Speed of 30 feet, instead of 25 feet.

_desc_en: Humans, and those who are physically closest to them, are the favored material of necromancers. They are readily available, and their physiology has been studied the most extensively, so these skeletons can be easily mass-produced. Despite their name, fodder skeletons make rather mobile foot soldiers due to how efficiently they transfer necromantic energy within their bodies. You have a base Speed of 30 feet, instead of 25 feet.
_desc_ko: 인간과 그들에 육체적으로 가장 가까운 자들은 강령술사가 선호하는 재료입니다. 이들은 쉽게 구할 수 있고 그 생리가 가장 광범위하게 연구되어 있어, 이 해골들은 손쉽게 대량 생산될 수 있습니다. 그 이름과 달리, 총알받이 해골은 몸속에서 강령 에너지를 얼마나 효율적으로 전달하는지 덕분에 상당히 기동성 있는 보병이 됩니다. 당신은 기본 이동력이 7.5미터(25피트) 대신 9미터(30피트)입니다.

name: Warrior Android

description.value: Your body was originally created to function as a security officer or soldier. You're a naturally gifted warrior preprogrammed for combat. You're trained in all simple and martial weapons.

_desc_en: Your body was originally created to function as a security officer or soldier. You're a naturally gifted warrior preprogrammed for combat. You're trained in all simple and martial weapons.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 본래 보안 요원이나 병사로 기능하도록 만들어졌습니다. 당신은 타고난 재능을 지닌 전사로 전투를 위해 사전 프로그래밍되어 있습니다. 당신은 모든 단순 무기와 군용 무기 훈련을 받습니다.

name: Shoreline Strix

description.value: You're the descendant of strix who traveled to the coasts. Your feathers are especially water-repellent and sleekly angled for diving, allowing you to catch fish and other prey in the shallows. You are trained in Athletics, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iOY6YfGBaOvMNAor]{Underwater Marauder} skill feat as a bonus skill feat.

_desc_en: You're the descendant of strix who traveled to the coasts. Your feathers are especially water-repellent and sleekly angled for diving, allowing you to catch fish and other prey in the shallows. You are trained in Athletics, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iOY6YfGBaOvMNAor]{Underwater Marauder} skill feat as a bonus skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 해안으로 이주한 스트릭스의 후손입니다. 당신의 깃털은 특히 물을 잘 튕겨내고 잠수를 위해 매끄럽게 각져 있어, 얕은 물에서 물고기와 다른 먹이를 잡을 수 있게 해 줍니다. 당신은 운동술 훈련을 받으며, @link[feats.underwater-marauder]{수중 약탈자} 기술 재주를 보너스 기술 재주로 얻습니다.

name: Pearl Dragonet

description.value:
You have pearlescent scales and a round body, with short legs, small wings, and a long tail. The shape of your body lets you absorb a blow and roll away.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OpiIzr7h1EKY8wKh]{Bounce Away}r

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OpiIzr7h1EKY8wKh inline]

_desc_en:
You have pearlescent scales and a round body, with short legs, small wings, and a long tail. The shape of your body lets you absorb a blow and roll away.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OpiIzr7h1EKY8wKh]{Bounce Away}r

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OpiIzr7h1EKY8wKh inline]
_desc_ko:
당신은 진주빛 비늘과 둥근 몸, 짧은 다리, 작은 날개, 그리고 긴 꼬리를 지녔습니다. 당신의 몸 형태는 타격을 흡수하고 굴러서 벗어날 수 있게 해 줍니다.

@link[actions.bounce-away]{튕겨 나가기}r

@link[actions.bounce-away]

name: Tactile Azarketi

description.value: Your skin can detect the slightest changes in ocean currents. You gain imprecise wavesense with a range of 30 feet, allowing you to sense motion in the water around you. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Sense Direction in aquatic environments.

_desc_en: Your skin can detect the slightest changes in ocean currents. You gain imprecise wavesense with a range of 30 feet, allowing you to sense motion in the water around you. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Sense Direction in aquatic environments.
_desc_ko: 당신의 피부는 해류의 아주 미세한 변화도 감지할 수 있습니다. 당신은 9미터(30피트) 범위의 부정확한 파동감지를 얻어, 주변 물속의 움직임을 감지할 수 있습니다. 또한 수중 환경에서 방향 감지를 위한 생존술 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Mightyfall Kobold

description.value: Your proximity to a mighty kaiju has caused you to grow strong and hardy. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. Instead of the normal attribute boosts and flaws, you can choose to gain a boost to Strength, a boost to Charisma, and a flaw in Intelligence.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your proximity to a mighty kaiju has caused you to grow strong and hardy. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. Instead of the normal attribute boosts and flaws, you can choose to gain a boost to Strength, a boost to Charisma, and a flaw in Intelligence.
_desc_ko: 강대한 카이주와의 근접성으로 인해 당신은 강하고 강인하게 자랐습니다. 당신은 혈통으로부터 체력을 6 대신 10 얻습니다. 일반적인 능력치 증가 및 약점 대신, 근력 증가, 매력 증가, 그리고 지능 약점을 얻는 것을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Palace Echoes Kitsune

description.value:
You descend from kitsune who possessed such compelling powers of persuasion that they could walk into a palace at sunrise and end up as the power behind the throne by nightfall. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rlGVQku78DGoOl9V]{Nudging Whisper} action.

Your alternate form is a common Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human) called a tailless form.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You descend from kitsune who possessed such compelling powers of persuasion that they could walk into a palace at sunrise and end up as the power behind the throne by nightfall. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rlGVQku78DGoOl9V]{Nudging Whisper} action.

Your alternate form is a common Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human) called a tailless form.
_desc_ko:
당신은 해 뜰 무렵 궁전에 걸어 들어가 해 질 녘이면 왕좌 뒤의 실세가 될 정도로 설득력이 강렬했던 키츠네의 후손입니다. 당신은 @link[actions.nudging-whisper]{살짝 속삭이기} 행동을 얻습니다.

당신의 대체 형태는 당신이 자란 곳에서 흔한 일반적인 중형 인간형 혈통(보통 인간)으로, 꼬리 없는 형태라 불립니다.

name: Great Kholo

description.value: You're an imposing, powerful kholo, with tawny fur and brown spots on your hide. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8 and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}.

_desc_en: You're an imposing, powerful kholo, with tawny fur and brown spots on your hide. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8 and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 황갈색 털과 가죽에 갈색 반점이 있는 위압적이고 강력한 콜로입니다. 당신은 혈통으로부터 체력을 8 대신 10 얻으며, @link[actions.reposition]{재배치}, @link[actions.shove]{밀치기}, 또는 @link[actions.trip]{넘어뜨리기}를 위한 운동술 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Naari

description.value: You descend from fire elementals or bear the mark of the Inner Spheres, and your features illustrate the influence that elemental fire has over you. You gain the naari trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You gain resistance to fire equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less severe (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on). You can choose from naari feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: You descend from fire elementals or bear the mark of the Inner Spheres, and your features illustrate the influence that elemental fire has over you. You gain the naari trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You gain resistance to fire equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less severe (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on). You can choose from naari feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 화염 정령의 후손이거나 이너 스피어의 표식을 지니고 있으며, 당신의 이목구비는 원소의 화염이 당신에게 미치는 영향을 드러냅니다. 당신은 혈통의 특성에 더해 나아리 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 같은 화염 저항을 얻으며, 환경적 열기 효과를 한 단계 덜 심각한 것으로 취급합니다(믿기 힘든 열기는 극심한 열기가 되고, 극심한 열기는 심각한 열기가 되는 식). 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 나아리 재주와 당신 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Flexible Catfolk

description.value: You've inherited flexibility beyond that of most humanoids. You don't treat tight spaces that don't require you to Squeeze as difficult terrain. In addition, you get a +1 circumstance bonus to checks when you attempt to Escape.

_desc_en: You've inherited flexibility beyond that of most humanoids. You don't treat tight spaces that don't require you to Squeeze as difficult terrain. In addition, you get a +1 circumstance bonus to checks when you attempt to Escape.
_desc_ko: 당신은 대부분의 인간형을 넘어서는 유연함을 물려받았습니다. 당신은 비집고 지나가기가 필요하지 않은 비좁은 공간을 어려운 지형으로 취급하지 않습니다. 또한, 탈출을 시도할 때 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Woodstalker Lizardfolk

description.value: You move easily through thick forest and jungle, using every branch or bush. You can always use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} action when in forest or jungle terrain to gain cover, even if you're not next to an obstacle you would normally be able to Take Cover behind. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.beyw5bdA5hkQbmaG]{Terrain Stalker} feat, even if you're not trained in Stealth, and you must choose underbrush as your chosen terrain.

_desc_en: You move easily through thick forest and jungle, using every branch or bush. You can always use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} action when in forest or jungle terrain to gain cover, even if you're not next to an obstacle you would normally be able to Take Cover behind. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.beyw5bdA5hkQbmaG]{Terrain Stalker} feat, even if you're not trained in Stealth, and you must choose underbrush as your chosen terrain.
_desc_ko: 당신은 모든 나뭇가지와 덤불을 활용하며 울창한 숲과 밀림 속을 손쉽게 이동합니다. 당신은 숲이나 밀림 지형에 있을 때, 보통이라면 엄폐 뒤에 몸을 숨길 수 있을 장애물 옆에 있지 않더라도 언제나 @link[actions.take-cover]{엄폐 취하기(Take Cover)} 행동을 사용해 엄폐를 얻을 수 있습니다. 당신은 은신술 훈련을 받지 않았더라도 @link[feats.terrain-stalker]{지형 추적자} 재주를 얻으며, 선택 지형으로 반드시 덤불을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Dijiang

description.value:
You have the form of a faceless, leathery ball with short fur, six legs, and a connection to primordial chaos. While you have no face, head, mouth, eyes, or ears, you can somehow hear, speak, see, eat, and breathe just fine (though it's unclear exactly how). Your erratic nature means you often react to stimuli in unpredictable ways.

When you roll a failure (though not a critical failure) on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a success instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You have the form of a faceless, leathery ball with short fur, six legs, and a connection to primordial chaos. While you have no face, head, mouth, eyes, or ears, you can somehow hear, speak, see, eat, and breathe just fine (though it's unclear exactly how). Your erratic nature means you often react to stimuli in unpredictable ways.

When you roll a failure (though not a critical failure) on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a success instead.
_desc_ko:
당신은 짧은 털이 난 얼굴 없는 가죽질 공 모양에 여섯 개의 다리를 지녔으며, 원초적 혼돈과 연결되어 있습니다. 얼굴, 머리, 입, 눈, 귀가 없음에도 당신은 어찌 된 일인지 아무 문제 없이 듣고, 말하고, 보고, 먹고, 숨 쉴 수 있습니다(정확히 어떻게인지는 불분명합니다). 당신의 종잡을 수 없는 본성은 종종 자극에 예측 불가능한 방식으로 반응하게 합니다.

감정(emotion) 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패(대실패는 제외)를 굴리면 대신 성공을 얻습니다.

name: Melixie

description.value: You have the features of a bee, butterfly, or other insect that loves sweets. You can ask questions of and receive answers from arthropods (insects, spiders, scorpions, crabs, and similar invertebrate animals), as well as use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on and Request things of them. Most bees, butterflies, moths, and beetles have an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} starting attitude toward you and give you time to make your case, though other arthropods react to you like any other adventurer.

_desc_en: You have the features of a bee, butterfly, or other insect that loves sweets. You can ask questions of and receive answers from arthropods (insects, spiders, scorpions, crabs, and similar invertebrate animals), as well as use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on and Request things of them. Most bees, butterflies, moths, and beetles have an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} starting attitude toward you and give you time to make your case, though other arthropods react to you like any other adventurer.
_desc_ko: 당신은 벌, 나비, 또는 단것을 좋아하는 다른 곤충의 특징을 지니고 있습니다. 당신은 절지동물(곤충, 거미, 전갈, 게, 그리고 이와 유사한 무척추동물)에게 질문을 하고 그들로부터 답을 받을 수 있으며, 외교술을 사용하여 그들에게 좋은 인상 남기기와 요청하기를 할 수 있습니다. 대부분의 벌, 나비, 나방, 딱정벌레는 당신에 대해 @link[conditions.indifferent]{무관심} 또는 @link[conditions.friendly]{우호적} 시작 태도를 가지며 당신이 사정을 설명할 시간을 주지만, 다른 절지동물은 여느 모험가처럼 당신에게 반응합니다.

name: Tunnel Rat

description.value: You can easily compress your body and squeeze through gaps. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} feat as a bonus feat, even if you aren't trained in Acrobatics. Tight spaces not tight enough to require the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} action aren't difficult terrain for you.

_desc_en: You can easily compress your body and squeeze through gaps. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} feat as a bonus feat, even if you aren't trained in Acrobatics. Tight spaces not tight enough to require the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} action aren't difficult terrain for you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몸을 쉽게 압축하여 좁은 틈을 비집고 지나갈 수 있습니다. 당신은 곡예에 훈련되어 있지 않더라도 보너스 재주로 @link[feats.quick-squeeze]{빠른 비집기} 재주를 얻습니다. @link[actions.squeeze]{비집기} 행동이 필요할 만큼 좁지 않은 협소한 공간은 당신에게 험지가 아닙니다.

name: Unbreakable Goblin

description.value: You're able to bounce back from injuries easily due to an exceptionally thick skull, cartilaginous bones, or some other mixed blessing. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. When you fall, reduce the falling damage you take as though you had fallen half the distance.

_desc_en: You're able to bounce back from injuries easily due to an exceptionally thick skull, cartilaginous bones, or some other mixed blessing. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. When you fall, reduce the falling damage you take as though you had fallen half the distance.
_desc_ko: 당신은 유난히 두꺼운 두개골, 물렁뼈, 또는 그 밖의 양날의 축복 덕분에 부상에서 쉽게 회복할 수 있습니다. 당신은 혈통으로부터 체력을 6이 아닌 10 얻습니다. 추락할 때, 당신은 절반 거리만큼 떨어진 것처럼 받는 추락 피해를 줄입니다.

name: Strong-Blooded Dwarf

description.value: Your blood runs hearty and strong, and you can shake off toxins. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and each of your successful saving throws against a poison affliction reduces its stage by 2, or by 1 for a virulent poison. Each critical success against an ongoing poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 for a virulent poison.

_desc_en: Your blood runs hearty and strong, and you can shake off toxins. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and each of your successful saving throws against a poison affliction reduces its stage by 2, or by 1 for a virulent poison. Each critical success against an ongoing poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 for a virulent poison.
_desc_ko: 당신의 피는 튼튼하고 강하게 흐르며, 당신은 독소를 떨쳐낼 수 있습니다. 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반(최소 1)과 같은 독 저항을 얻으며, 독 질환에 대한 내성 굴림에 성공할 때마다 그 단계를 2 줄이고, 맹독성 독의 경우 1 줄입니다. 지속되는 독에 대해 대성공할 때마다 그 단계를 3 줄이고, 맹독성 독의 경우 2 줄입니다.

name: Dhampir

description.value: You are the scion of a vampire, half living and half undead, gifted with uncanny charm and grace, a bloodless pallor, and elongated incisors. You gain the dhampir trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You have the void healing ability, which means you are harmed by vitality damage and healed by void effects as if you were undead. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can select from dhampir feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: You are the scion of a vampire, half living and half undead, gifted with uncanny charm and grace, a bloodless pallor, and elongated incisors. You gain the dhampir trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You have the void healing ability, which means you are harmed by vitality damage and healed by void effects as if you were undead. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can select from dhampir feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 뱀파이어의 후예로, 절반은 살아 있고 절반은 언데드이며, 기묘한 매력과 우아함, 핏기 없는 창백함, 그리고 길게 자란 앞니를 타고났습니다. 당신은 혈통에서 오는 특성에 더해 댐피르 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 공허 치유 능력을 지니는데, 이는 당신이 언데드인 것처럼 생명력 피해에 의해 해를 입고 공허 효과에 의해 치유됨을 뜻합니다. 또한 당신은 저광 시야를 얻으며, 혈통이 이미 저광 시야를 지니고 있다면 대신 암시야를 얻습니다. 당신은 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 댐피르 재주와 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Resolute Fetchling

description.value: Your ancestors have long dealt with the horrific—in the Shadow Plane or elsewhere—and you bear their mental fortitude. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your ancestors have long dealt with the horrific—in the Shadow Plane or elsewhere—and you bear their mental fortitude. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들은 오랫동안 그림자 세계나 그 밖의 곳에서 끔찍한 것들을 상대해 왔으며, 당신은 그들의 정신적 강인함을 물려받았습니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Shadow of the Smith

description.value: Your shadow is thick and liquid, like it could quench the finest ore. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lgpJoFrkzfkjAzeV]{Inscribe Shadow Pamor} action.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your shadow is thick and liquid, like it could quench the finest ore. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lgpJoFrkzfkjAzeV]{Inscribe Shadow Pamor} action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 그림자는 최상급 광석을 담금질할 수 있을 것처럼 짙고 유동적입니다. 당신은 @link[actions.inscribe-shadow-pamor]{그림자 파모르 새기기} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Spellhorn Kobold

description.value: Since hatching in the vicinity of a powerful source of magic, a trace of it flows through your veins. Choose one common cantrip from the arcane spell list. You can Cast this Spell as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You are trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics, and your key spellcasting attribute is Charisma.

_desc_en: Since hatching in the vicinity of a powerful source of magic, a trace of it flows through your veins. Choose one common cantrip from the arcane spell list. You can Cast this Spell as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You are trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics, and your key spellcasting attribute is Charisma.
_desc_ko: 강력한 마법의 원천 근처에서 부화한 이래로, 그 흔적이 당신의 혈관을 타고 흐릅니다. 비전 주문 목록에서 일반 소마법 하나를 선택하십시오. 당신은 이 주문을 비전 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 자신의 레벨 절반을 올림한 값과 같은 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다. 당신은 주문 공격 수정치와 주문 DC 특성치에 훈련되어 있으며, 당신의 핵심 주문시전 능력치는 매력입니다.

name: Rock Dwarf

description.value:
Your ancestors lived and worked among the ancient stones of the mountains or the depths of the earth. This makes you solid as a rock when you plant your feet. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to force you to move or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

In addition, if any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you are moved only half the distance.

_desc_en:
Your ancestors lived and worked among the ancient stones of the mountains or the depths of the earth. This makes you solid as a rock when you plant your feet. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to force you to move or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

In addition, if any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you are moved only half the distance.
_desc_ko:
당신의 조상들은 산의 고대 바위들 사이나 대지 깊은 곳에서 살고 일했습니다. 이 덕분에 당신은 발을 단단히 디딜 때 바위처럼 굳건합니다. 당신은 당신을 @link[actions.reposition]{재배치}, @link[actions.shove]{밀치기}, 또는 @link[actions.trip]{넘어뜨리기}하려는 시도에 대해 당신의 인내 또는 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 당신을 강제로 이동시키거나 @link[conditions.prone]{넘어짐} 상태로 만들려는 주문이나 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에도 적용됩니다.

또한, 어떤 효과가 당신을 10피트 이상 강제로 이동시키려 한다면, 당신은 절반 거리만큼만 이동됩니다.

name: Death Warden Dwarf

description.value: Your ancestors were tomb guardians, and their power to ward off death passed on to you. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect that has the void trait or was created by an undead creature, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your ancestors were tomb guardians, and their power to ward off death passed on to you. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect that has the void trait or was created by an undead creature, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들은 무덤 수호자였으며, 죽음을 물리치는 그들의 힘이 당신에게 전해졌습니다. 공허 특성을 지녔거나 언데드 크리처가 생성한 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Unseen Lizardfolk

description.value: You can change your skin color to blend in with your surroundings, making minor shifts with a single action and dramatic changes over the course of an hour. When you're in an area where your coloration is roughly similar to the environment (for instance, forest green in a forest), you can use the minor, single-action application of this ability to make localized changes that help you blend into your surroundings, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks until your surroundings change in coloration or pattern.

_desc_en: You can change your skin color to blend in with your surroundings, making minor shifts with a single action and dramatic changes over the course of an hour. When you're in an area where your coloration is roughly similar to the environment (for instance, forest green in a forest), you can use the minor, single-action application of this ability to make localized changes that help you blend into your surroundings, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks until your surroundings change in coloration or pattern.
_desc_ko: 당신은 피부색을 바꿔 주변 환경과 어우러질 수 있으며, 한 번의 행동으로 미미한 변화를, 한 시간에 걸쳐 극적인 변화를 일으킬 수 있습니다. 당신의 색이 환경과 대략 비슷한 지역(예를 들어 숲에서의 짙은 녹색)에 있을 때, 당신은 이 능력의 미미한 단일 행동 적용을 사용하여 국소적인 변화를 만들어 주변에 섞여들 수 있으며, 주변의 색이나 무늬가 바뀔 때까지 은신 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Artisan Android

description.value: Your body was originally designed to create works of art, complex tools, or maintain advanced machinery. You become trained in Crafting (or another skill if you're already trained in Crafting), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat in a specialty of your choice.

_desc_en: Your body was originally designed to create works of art, complex tools, or maintain advanced machinery. You become trained in Crafting (or another skill if you're already trained in Crafting), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat in a specialty of your choice.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 원래 예술 작품을 창작하거나, 복잡한 도구를 만들거나, 첨단 기계를 정비하도록 설계되었습니다. 당신은 제작에 훈련됩니다(이미 제작에 훈련되어 있다면 다른 기술에 훈련됨). 그리고 당신은 원하는 전문 분야로 @link[feats.specialty-crafting]{전문 제작} 기술 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Vivacious Gnome

description.value: You have an incredibly strong connection to the vitality energy that flows through the First World, making it harder to attack your life force with void energy. You gain void resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). When you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition, the condition affects you as if its value was 1 lower than it actually is (doomed 1 has no effect, doomed 2 causes you to die at @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying 3}, and so on).

_desc_en: You have an incredibly strong connection to the vitality energy that flows through the First World, making it harder to attack your life force with void energy. You gain void resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). When you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition, the condition affects you as if its value was 1 lower than it actually is (doomed 1 has no effect, doomed 2 causes you to die at @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying 3}, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신은 첫 세계를 흐르는 생명력 에너지와 대단히 강한 연결을 지녀, 공허 에너지로 당신의 생명력을 공격하기가 더 어렵습니다. 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반(최소 1)과 같은 공허 저항을 얻습니다. 당신이 @link[conditions.doomed]{파멸} 상태일 때, 그 상태는 실제 수치보다 1 낮은 것처럼 당신에게 영향을 줍니다(파멸 1은 아무 효과가 없고, 파멸 2는 @link[conditions.dying]{빈사 3}에서 죽게 하는 식입니다).

name: Enchanting Lily

description.value: You smell ever so sweet—a delicate, floral scent like the intoxicating fragrance of lilies and the soft scent of lilacs. You're trained in Diplomacy (or another skill if you were already trained in Diplomacy). You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} if the target can smell your fragrance.

_desc_en: You smell ever so sweet—a delicate, floral scent like the intoxicating fragrance of lilies and the soft scent of lilacs. You're trained in Diplomacy (or another skill if you were already trained in Diplomacy). You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} if the target can smell your fragrance.
_desc_ko: 당신에게서는 언제나 아주 달콤한 향기, 백합의 도취적인 향과 라일락의 은은한 향 같은 섬세한 꽃향기가 납니다. 당신은 외교술에 훈련됩니다(이미 외교술에 훈련되어 있다면 다른 기술에 훈련됨). 또한 당신은 대상이 당신의 향기를 맡을 수 있다면 @link[actions.make-an-impression]{좋은 인상 남기기} 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Grave Orc

description.value: You were exposed to powerful necromantic energies that should have killed you—but you survived. Your skin is cold, clammy, and gray. You gain resistance to void damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects with the death or void trait.

_desc_en: You were exposed to powerful necromantic energies that should have killed you—but you survived. Your skin is cold, clammy, and gray. You gain resistance to void damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects with the death or void trait.
_desc_ko: 당신은 당신을 죽였어야 할 강력한 사령술 에너지에 노출되었지만—살아남았습니다. 당신의 피부는 차갑고 축축하며 잿빛입니다. 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반(최소 1)과 같은 공허 피해 저항을 얻습니다. 또한 당신은 죽음 또는 공허 특성을 지닌 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Wavediver Tengu

description.value: You're one of the rare tengu who can cut through water like a bird through air, and you often lurk in rivers or oceans where few expect you. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.

_desc_en: You're one of the rare tengu who can cut through water like a bird through air, and you often lurk in rivers or oceans where few expect you. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 새가 공기를 가르듯 물을 가를 수 있는 보기 드문 텐구 중 하나로, 아무도 예상치 못하는 강이나 바다에 종종 숨어 있습니다. 당신은 15피트의 수영 이동력을 얻습니다.

name: Strongjaw Kobold

description.value: Your warren is noted for their powerful jaws and sharp teeth, either to help protect against natural predators or due to reverence of a mighty beast. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: Your warren is noted for their powerful jaws and sharp teeth, either to help protect against natural predators or due to reverence of a mighty beast. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 소굴은 강력한 턱과 날카로운 이빨로 유명한데, 이는 천적으로부터 보호하기 위해서이거나 강력한 야수를 숭배하기 때문입니다. 당신은 1d6 관통 피해를 입히는 턱 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 턱은 격투 무기군에 속하며 정교 및 비무장 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Respite of Loam and Leaf

description.value:
You swore a vow to preserve the very foundation of sanctuary: the great earth and all that grows upon it. Your vow grants you the land's spiritual power; you gain one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate primal spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Your roots in the world grant you the plant trait.

Additional Edict cure or remove blight and pollution from the plants and soil you encounter

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You swore a vow to preserve the very foundation of sanctuary: the great earth and all that grows upon it. Your vow grants you the land's spiritual power; you gain one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate primal spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Your roots in the world grant you the plant trait.

Additional Edict cure or remove blight and pollution from the plants and soil you encounter
_desc_ko:
당신은 성역의 근본, 즉 위대한 대지와 그 위에서 자라나는 모든 것을 지키겠다는 맹세를 했습니다. 당신의 맹세는 대지의 영적 힘을 부여합니다. 당신은 원시 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 얻습니다. 당신은 이 주문을 원시 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 자신의 레벨 절반을 올림한 값과 같은 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다. 세계에 뿌리내린 당신은 식물 특성을 얻습니다.

추가 계율 당신이 마주치는 식물과 토양에서 마름병과 오염을 치료하거나 제거하십시오

name: Earthly Wilds Kitsune

description.value: You are a creature of the material world, with an affinity closer to the wilds than urban society. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits. Your alternate form is a fox, which has the statistics of 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}.

_desc_en: You are a creature of the material world, with an affinity closer to the wilds than urban society. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits. Your alternate form is a fox, which has the statistics of 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 물질계의 존재로, 도시 사회보다 야생에 더 가까운 친화성을 지닙니다. 당신은 1d6 관통 피해를 입히는 턱 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 턱은 격투 무기군에 속하며 정교 및 비무장 특성을 지닙니다. 당신의 대체 형태는 여우이며, 1등급 @link[spells.pest-form]{해충 형태}의 특성치를 지닙니다.

name: Spindly Anadi

description.value: Your limbs are exceptionally long in both forms, allowing you to skitter about with surprising agility. Your Speed increases from 25 to 30 feet.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your limbs are exceptionally long in both forms, allowing you to skitter about with surprising agility. Your Speed increases from 25 to 30 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신의 사지는 두 형태 모두에서 유난히 길어, 놀라운 민첩함으로 재빠르게 움직일 수 있습니다. 당신의 이동력은 25피트에서 30피트로 증가합니다.

name: Lantern Surki

description.value:
The nodes in your abdomen are particularly luminous. You can use an Interact action to shed light from your abdomen in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). This is a magical light effect with a counteract rank equal to half your level rounded up. You can change the color of the light or extinguish it with another Interact action.

  • Evolution Your abdominal nodes have evolved into a pair of secondary limbs that project a magical focusing lens. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ako5zZwC6o26cfCQ]{Lantern Beam} action.
  • Evolution Secondary light emitters grow from your shoulder nodes that flash in time with your lantern. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aVGNaNgG6cYNRp5A]{Lantern Strobe} action.

_desc_en:
The nodes in your abdomen are particularly luminous. You can use an Interact action to shed light from your abdomen in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). This is a magical light effect with a counteract rank equal to half your level rounded up. You can change the color of the light or extinguish it with another Interact action.

  • Evolution Your abdominal nodes have evolved into a pair of secondary limbs that project a magical focusing lens. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ako5zZwC6o26cfCQ]{Lantern Beam} action.
  • Evolution Secondary light emitters grow from your shoulder nodes that flash in time with your lantern. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aVGNaNgG6cYNRp5A]{Lantern Strobe} action.
_desc_ko:
당신의 복부에 있는 발광점은 특히 밝습니다. 당신은 상호작용 행동을 사용하여 복부에서 20피트 반경으로 빛을 발할 수 있습니다(그리고 그다음 20피트에는 흐릿한 빛). 이것은 자신의 레벨 절반을 올림한 값과 같은 상쇄 등급을 지닌 마법적 빛 효과입니다. 당신은 또 다른 상호작용 행동으로 빛의 색을 바꾸거나 끌 수 있습니다.

  • 진화 당신의 복부 발광점이 마법적 초점 렌즈를 투사하는 한 쌍의 보조 사지로 진화했습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.lantern-beam]{등불 광선} 행동을 얻습니다.
  • 진화 당신의 어깨 발광점에서 등불에 맞춰 번쩍이는 보조 발광기가 자라납니다. 당신은 @link[actions.lantern-strobe]{등불 섬광} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Ironhoof Centaur

description.value: Your hooves are incredibly strong and serve as formidable weapons. You gain a hoof unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Your hooves are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: Your hooves are incredibly strong and serve as formidable weapons. You gain a hoof unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Your hooves are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 발굽은 대단히 강하며 강력한 무기 역할을 합니다. 당신은 1d6 타격 피해를 입히는 발굽 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 발굽은 격투 무기군에 속하며 정교 및 비무장 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Chameleon Gnome

description.value: The color of your hair and skin is mutable, possibly due to latent magic from First World influences or lingering illusion effects. You can slowly change the vibrancy and the exact color, and the coloration can be different across your body, allowing you to create patterns or other colorful designs. It takes a single action for minor localized shifts and up to an hour for dramatic shifts throughout your body. While you're asleep, the colors shift on their own in tune with your dreams, giving you an unusual coloration each morning. When you're in an area where your coloration is roughly similar to the environment (for instance, forest green in a forest), you can use the single action to make minor localized shifts designed to help you blend into your surroundings. This grants you a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks until your surroundings shift in coloration or pattern.

_desc_en: The color of your hair and skin is mutable, possibly due to latent magic from First World influences or lingering illusion effects. You can slowly change the vibrancy and the exact color, and the coloration can be different across your body, allowing you to create patterns or other colorful designs. It takes a single action for minor localized shifts and up to an hour for dramatic shifts throughout your body. While you're asleep, the colors shift on their own in tune with your dreams, giving you an unusual coloration each morning. When you're in an area where your coloration is roughly similar to the environment (for instance, forest green in a forest), you can use the single action to make minor localized shifts designed to help you blend into your surroundings. This grants you a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks until your surroundings shift in coloration or pattern.
_desc_ko: 당신의 머리카락과 피부 색깔은, 아마도 첫 세계의 영향에서 온 잠재된 마법이나 남아 있는 환영 효과 때문에 변화할 수 있습니다. 당신은 색조와 정확한 색을 천천히 바꿀 수 있으며, 몸 전체에 걸쳐 색을 다르게 하여 무늬나 그 밖의 화려한 디자인을 만들 수 있습니다. 미미한 국소적 변화에는 단일 행동이 걸리고, 몸 전체의 극적인 변화에는 최대 한 시간이 걸립니다. 당신이 잠든 동안에는 색이 당신의 꿈에 맞춰 저절로 변하여, 매일 아침 당신에게 독특한 색을 안겨줍니다. 당신의 색이 환경과 대략 비슷한 지역(예를 들어 숲에서의 짙은 녹색)에 있을 때, 당신은 단일 행동을 사용하여 주변에 섞여들도록 설계된 미미한 국소적 변화를 만들 수 있습니다. 이는 주변의 색이나 무늬가 바뀔 때까지 은신 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

name: Fey Dragonet

description.value:
You have a brightly colored body with gleaming scales that become more lustrous as you age, and iridescent butterfly wings. You can change the coloration and pattern of your wings with a single action to let you blend into an area.

When your wings match your environment, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks until your surroundings shift in coloration or pattern. You gain the fey trait and add Fey to your list of known languages.

_desc_en:
You have a brightly colored body with gleaming scales that become more lustrous as you age, and iridescent butterfly wings. You can change the coloration and pattern of your wings with a single action to let you blend into an area.

When your wings match your environment, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks until your surroundings shift in coloration or pattern. You gain the fey trait and add Fey to your list of known languages.
_desc_ko:
당신은 나이가 들수록 더 윤기가 흐르는 반짝이는 비늘로 덮인 밝은 색의 몸과 무지갯빛 나비 날개를 지녔습니다. 당신은 단일 행동으로 날개의 색과 무늬를 바꿔 주변 환경에 섞여 들 수 있습니다.

당신의 날개가 주변 환경과 일치할 때, 주변의 색이나 무늬가 바뀔 때까지 은신 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 당신은 페이 특성을 얻고 아는 언어 목록에 페이를 추가합니다.

name: Deny the Traitor's Rebirth

description.value:
You swore a vow to deliver others from rakshasas and asuras, whom yaksha legends have condemned as corrupted kin. To counter their shadowy schemes, your vow grants you darkvision and a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense the Motives} of rakshasas and asuras.

Additional Edict confront rakshasas and asuras you come across (as long as you have a reasonable chance of success); in the unlikely event you find a benevolent rakshasa or asura, you don't have to confront them

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You swore a vow to deliver others from rakshasas and asuras, whom yaksha legends have condemned as corrupted kin. To counter their shadowy schemes, your vow grants you darkvision and a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense the Motives} of rakshasas and asuras.

Additional Edict confront rakshasas and asuras you come across (as long as you have a reasonable chance of success); in the unlikely event you find a benevolent rakshasa or asura, you don't have to confront them
_desc_ko:
당신은 야크샤 전설이 타락한 동족으로 규탄한 라크샤사와 아수라로부터 다른 이들을 구하겠다는 맹세를 했습니다. 그들의 음험한 계략에 맞서기 위해, 당신의 맹세는 암시야와 라크샤사 및 아수라를 @link[actions.seek]{탐색}하거나 @link[actions.sense-motive]{의도 감지}하기 위한 감지 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

추가 계율 당신이 마주치는 라크샤사와 아수라와 맞서십시오(성공의 합당한 가능성이 있는 한); 자비로운 라크샤사나 아수라를 발견하는 있음직하지 않은 경우에는, 그들과 맞설 필요가 없습니다

name: Tunnelflood Kobold

description.value: You grew up in a warren crisscrossed by underwater passages, whether natural or excavated, and were influenced by a powerful aquatic entity or being of primal water. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.

_desc_en: You grew up in a warren crisscrossed by underwater passages, whether natural or excavated, and were influenced by a powerful aquatic entity or being of primal water. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자연적이든 굴착되었든 수중 통로가 교차하는 소굴에서 자랐으며, 강력한 수중 존재나 원시 물의 존재에게 영향을 받았습니다. 당신은 15피트의 수영 이동력을 얻습니다.

name: Duskwalker

description.value: Thanks to an ancient bargain, your soul has been reborn as a duskwalker, a planar scion with a connection to psychopomps and the Boneyard. You gain the duskwalker trait. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. Neither your body nor your spirit can ever become undead. You can select from duskwalker feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: Thanks to an ancient bargain, your soul has been reborn as a duskwalker, a planar scion with a connection to psychopomps and the Boneyard. You gain the duskwalker trait. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. Neither your body nor your spirit can ever become undead. You can select from duskwalker feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 고대의 거래 덕분에, 당신의 영혼은 사이코폼프 및 뼈뜰과 연결된 이계 후예인 황혼보행자로 다시 태어났습니다. 당신은 황혼보행자 특성을 얻습니다. 또한 당신은 저광 시야를 얻으며, 혈통이 이미 저광 시야를 지니고 있다면 대신 암시야를 얻습니다. 당신의 육체도 영혼도 결코 언데드가 될 수 없습니다. 당신은 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 황혼보행자 재주와 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Razortooth Goblin

description.value: Your family's teeth are formidable weapons. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: Your family's teeth are formidable weapons. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 당신 가문의 이빨은 강력한 무기입니다. 당신은 1d6 관통 피해를 입히는 턱 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 턱은 격투 무기군에 속하며 정교 및 비무장 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Respite of Cloudless Paths

description.value:
You swore a vow to protect the waylaid and the lost. Both environmental heat effects and environmental cold effects are one step less extreme for you (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on), and you gain a + 1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against environmental features or hazards, such as floods, rockslides, and sandstorms.

Additional Edict assist lost or incapacitated travelers

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You swore a vow to protect the waylaid and the lost. Both environmental heat effects and environmental cold effects are one step less extreme for you (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on), and you gain a + 1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against environmental features or hazards, such as floods, rockslides, and sandstorms.

Additional Edict assist lost or incapacitated travelers
_desc_ko:
당신은 길을 잃고 방황하는 이들을 지키겠다는 맹세를 했습니다. 당신에게는 환경적 열기 효과와 환경적 냉기 효과가 모두 한 단계 덜 극심해집니다(엄청난 열기는 극한이 되고, 극한의 냉기는 심각이 되는 식). 그리고 당신은 홍수, 산사태, 모래폭풍 같은 환경 요소나 위험에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

추가 계율 길을 잃거나 무력화된 여행자를 도우십시오

name: Ghost Bull Minotaur

description.value: Your fur is as pale as death, possibly from some connection you or your family has to the afterlife, which lets you supernaturally find your way. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tXa5vOu5giBNCjdR]{Know the Way} as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus against spells or effects that cause the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition.

_desc_en: Your fur is as pale as death, possibly from some connection you or your family has to the afterlife, which lets you supernaturally find your way. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tXa5vOu5giBNCjdR]{Know the Way} as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus against spells or effects that cause the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition.
_desc_ko: 당신의 털은 죽음처럼 창백한데, 이는 아마도 당신이나 당신 가문이 사후 세계와 맺은 어떤 연결 때문일 것이며, 이 덕분에 당신은 초자연적으로 길을 찾을 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.know-the-way]{길 알기}를 신비 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 자신의 레벨 절반을 올림한 값과 같은 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다. 또한 당신은 @link[conditions.confused]{혼란} 상태를 일으키는 주문이나 효과에 대해 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Strong Oak

description.value: Most ghorans have bodies of pliable vines and tough stems, but you're covered in sturdy, rough bark and your legs are stable as roots. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against effects that would @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grab} you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrain} you, or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}.

_desc_en: Most ghorans have bodies of pliable vines and tough stems, but you're covered in sturdy, rough bark and your legs are stable as roots. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against effects that would @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grab} you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrain} you, or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}.
_desc_ko: 대부분의 고란은 유연한 덩굴과 질긴 줄기로 된 몸을 지녔지만, 당신은 튼튼하고 거친 나무껍질로 뒤덮여 있고 다리는 뿌리처럼 안정적입니다. 당신은 당신을 @link[actions.grapple]{붙잡기} 또는 @link[actions.trip]{넘어뜨리기}하려는 시도에 대해 당신의 인내 또는 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 당신을 @link[conditions.grabbed]{붙잡힘}, @link[conditions.restrained]{속박}, 또는 @link[conditions.prone]{넘어짐} 상태로 만들려는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에도 적용됩니다. 또한 당신은 @link[actions.balance]{균형잡기} 곡예 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Clawed Catfolk

description.value: Your family has particularly long, sharp claws capable of delivering bleeding wounds with a wicked swipe. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: Your family has particularly long, sharp claws capable of delivering bleeding wounds with a wicked swipe. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가문은 사악한 일격으로 출혈 상처를 입힐 수 있는 유난히 길고 날카로운 발톱을 지녔습니다. 당신은 1d6 참격 피해를 입히는 발톱 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 발톱은 격투 무기군에 속하며 기민, 정교, 비무장 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Poisonhide Tripkee

description.value: You may be small, but the poison glands concealed across your body hide a deadly defense. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kKKHwVUnroKuAnOt]{Toxic Skin} reaction.

_desc_en: You may be small, but the poison glands concealed across your body hide a deadly defense. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kKKHwVUnroKuAnOt]{Toxic Skin} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몸집은 작을지 몰라도, 온몸에 숨겨진 독샘이 치명적인 방어 수단을 감추고 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.toxic-skin]{유독한 피부} 반응행동을 얻습니다.

name: Running Animal

description.value:
You are an animal meant for running at great speeds across land. Typically, you run on all fours like a dog, cheetah, or an iguana, but you could also use two legs like a kangaroo, emu, or penguin.

You have a land Speed of 30 feet and one animal attack of your choice (typically claw, jaws, or tail).

_desc_en:
You are an animal meant for running at great speeds across land. Typically, you run on all fours like a dog, cheetah, or an iguana, but you could also use two legs like a kangaroo, emu, or penguin.

You have a land Speed of 30 feet and one animal attack of your choice (typically claw, jaws, or tail).
_desc_ko:
당신은 육지에서 엄청난 속도로 달리도록 태어난 동물입니다. 보통 당신은 개, 치타, 또는 이구아나처럼 네 발로 달리지만, 캥거루, 에뮤, 또는 펭귄처럼 두 다리를 쓸 수도 있습니다.

당신은 30피트의 육상 이동력과 당신이 선택한 동물 공격 하나(보통 발톱, 턱, 또는 꼬리)를 지닙니다.

name: Born of Animal

description.value:
You were a simple animal until the sun enlightened you.

  • Humanoid Form Animals can sense the power of your presence. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks against animals and beasts and don't take a penalty for attempting to Intimidate animals or beasts you don't share a language with.
  • Yaoguai Form You can dash like an animal. If you have both hands free, you can increase your Speed to 30 feet as you run on all fours.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You were a simple animal until the sun enlightened you.

  • Humanoid Form Animals can sense the power of your presence. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks against animals and beasts and don't take a penalty for attempting to Intimidate animals or beasts you don't share a language with.
  • Yaoguai Form You can dash like an animal. If you have both hands free, you can increase your Speed to 30 feet as you run on all fours.
_desc_ko:
당신은 태양이 당신을 깨우치기 전까지는 그저 평범한 동물이었습니다.

  • 인간형 형태 동물들은 당신 존재의 힘을 감지할 수 있습니다. 당신은 동물과 야수에 대한 위협 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 언어를 공유하지 않는 동물이나 야수를 위협하려 할 때 페널티를 받지 않습니다.
  • 요괴 형태 당신은 동물처럼 질주할 수 있습니다. 두 손이 모두 비어 있다면, 당신은 네 발로 달리며 이동력을 30피트로 늘릴 수 있습니다.

name: Twilight Halfling

description.value: Your ancestors performed many secret acts under the concealing cover of dusk, whether for good or ill, and over time they developed the ability to see in twilight beyond even the usual keen sight of halflings. You gain low-light vision.

_desc_en: Your ancestors performed many secret acts under the concealing cover of dusk, whether for good or ill, and over time they developed the ability to see in twilight beyond even the usual keen sight of halflings. You gain low-light vision.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들은 선한 목적이든 악한 목적이든 황혼의 가리개 아래에서 은밀한 행위를 많이 했으며, 시간이 지나면서 하플링 특유의 예리한 시력조차 뛰어넘어 어스름 속에서도 볼 수 있는 능력을 발전시켰습니다. 당신은 저광 시야를 얻습니다.

name: Whipfang Nagaji

description.value: You have a long, flexible neck that can curl into a striking pose like that of a snake. Your deceptively powerful muscles allow you to bite with surprising distance and speed. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MLOkyKi1Y3N6y56Q]{Raise Neck} action.

_desc_en: You have a long, flexible neck that can curl into a striking pose like that of a snake. Your deceptively powerful muscles allow you to bite with surprising distance and speed. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MLOkyKi1Y3N6y56Q]{Raise Neck} action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 뱀처럼 공격 자세로 휘어질 수 있는 길고 유연한 목을 지녔습니다. 당신의 겉보기와 다른 강력한 근육은 놀라운 거리와 속도로 물어뜯을 수 있게 해줍니다. 당신은 @link[actions.raise-neck]{목 세우기} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Tsukumogami Poppet

description.value:
You have the form and memories of a common tool. Choose one Lore skill related to what kind of tool you were; for instance, Cooking Lore for a kitchen knife or spoon. You're trained in this skill, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid with this skill. If you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ARBIhYAREcytOIaL]{Helpful Poppet} feat, the bonus increases to +3.

While most poppets are made of stuffing, cloth, or soft metals, some tsukumogami are made of other materials, changing the poppet weakness to fire. If your body is primarily wood or cloth, you have the normal poppet weakness to fire. If your body is primarily metal, you're instead weak to electricity; if its primarily ceramic, you're instead weak to cold.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You have the form and memories of a common tool. Choose one Lore skill related to what kind of tool you were; for instance, Cooking Lore for a kitchen knife or spoon. You're trained in this skill, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid with this skill. If you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ARBIhYAREcytOIaL]{Helpful Poppet} feat, the bonus increases to +3.

While most poppets are made of stuffing, cloth, or soft metals, some tsukumogami are made of other materials, changing the poppet weakness to fire. If your body is primarily wood or cloth, you have the normal poppet weakness to fire. If your body is primarily metal, you're instead weak to electricity; if its primarily ceramic, you're instead weak to cold.
_desc_ko:
당신은 흔한 도구의 형태와 기억을 지니고 있습니다. 당신이 어떤 종류의 도구였는지와 관련된 지식 기술 하나를 선택하십시오. 예를 들어 부엌칼이나 숟가락이었다면 요리 지식입니다. 당신은 이 기술에 훈련되며, 이 기술로 지원하기 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신이 @link[feats.helpful-poppet]{도움 되는 포펫} 재주를 택한다면, 이 보너스는 +3으로 증가합니다.

대부분의 포펫은 속솜, 천, 또는 무른 금속으로 만들어지지만, 일부 츠쿠모가미는 다른 재료로 만들어져 포펫의 화염 약점이 바뀝니다. 당신의 몸이 주로 나무나 천이라면, 당신은 평범한 포펫의 화염 약점을 지닙니다. 당신의 몸이 주로 금속이라면, 당신은 대신 전기에 약합니다. 주로 도자기라면, 당신은 대신 냉기에 약합니다.

name: Dragonblood

description.value: You're descended in some way from a dragon. Your physical features might show this outwardly, with a pair of draconic horns, patches of scaly skin, or even a tail, or you might develop an internal reserve of draconic power. You gain the dragonblood trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. Add Draconic to your ancestry's list of additional languages (allowing you to choose it as a language if your Intelligence modifier is positive). When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead. You can choose from dragonblood feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: You're descended in some way from a dragon. Your physical features might show this outwardly, with a pair of draconic horns, patches of scaly skin, or even a tail, or you might develop an internal reserve of draconic power. You gain the dragonblood trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. Add Draconic to your ancestry's list of additional languages (allowing you to choose it as a language if your Intelligence modifier is positive). When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead. You can choose from dragonblood feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 어떤 식으로든 용의 후손입니다. 당신의 신체적 특징은 이를 겉으로 드러낼 수 있는데, 한 쌍의 용뿔, 비늘 돋은 피부 조각, 또는 심지어 꼬리를 지니거나, 아니면 내면에 용의 힘의 저장고를 발달시킬 수도 있습니다. 당신은 혈통에서 오는 특성에 더해 용의 피 특성을 얻습니다. 당신의 혈통 추가 언어 목록에 용언을 추가합니다(지능 수정치가 양수라면 그것을 언어로 선택할 수 있게 함). 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 당신은 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 용의 피 재주와 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Insightful Goloma

description.value: You've learned to watch for telltale signs of dangerous sentiments to help you avoid trouble. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against attempts to Lie to you and your Perception checks to Sense Motive.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You've learned to watch for telltale signs of dangerous sentiments to help you avoid trouble. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against attempts to Lie to you and your Perception checks to Sense Motive.
_desc_ko: 당신은 곤경을 피하는 데 도움이 되도록 위험한 속내를 드러내는 조짐을 살피는 법을 익혔습니다. 당신은 당신에게 거짓말하려는 시도에 대해 당신의 감지 DC에 +1 상황 보너스를, 그리고 의도 감지 감지 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Snaring Anadi

description.value: You were hatched with hooked fangs that give you an edge when hunting in your true form. Your fangs attack gains the grapple and trip traits.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You were hatched with hooked fangs that give you an edge when hunting in your true form. Your fangs attack gains the grapple and trip traits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 진짜 형태로 사냥할 때 유리함을 주는 갈고리 모양의 송곳니를 지니고 부화했습니다. 당신의 송곳니 공격은 붙잡기 및 넘어뜨리기 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Umbral Gnome

description.value: Whether from a connection to dark or shadowy fey, from the underground gnomes known as drathnelar, or from another source, you can see in complete darkness. You gain darkvision.

_desc_en: Whether from a connection to dark or shadowy fey, from the underground gnomes known as drathnelar, or from another source, you can see in complete darkness. You gain darkvision.
_desc_ko: 어둡거나 그림자와 연관된 페이와의 연결에서 비롯되었든, 드라스넬라르라 불리는 지하 노움에게서 비롯되었든, 아니면 다른 원천에서 비롯되었든, 당신은 완전한 어둠 속에서도 볼 수 있습니다. 당신은 암시야를 얻습니다.

name: Battle-Trained Human (BB)

description.value:
Your family has trained for battle for generations, granting you advantages against your enemies. You gain a +1 bonus to initiative rolls. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} feat.

Note: This heritage is from the Beginner Box and features non-standard heritage features

publication.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

_desc_en:
Your family has trained for battle for generations, granting you advantages against your enemies. You gain a +1 bonus to initiative rolls. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} feat.

Note: This heritage is from the Beginner Box and features non-standard heritage features
_desc_ko:
당신의 가문은 여러 세대에 걸쳐 전투를 위해 훈련해 왔으며, 이는 적들에 맞서는 이점을 부여합니다. 당신은 우선권 굴림에 +1 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 당신은 @link[feats.diehard]{끈질긴 생명} 재주를 얻습니다.

참고: 이 유산은 입문자 상자에서 나온 것이며 비표준 유산 특성을 지닙니다

name: Wetlander Lizardfolk

description.value: Your family is descended from the most common lizardfolk heritage, and you are accustomed to aquatic environments. You gain a 15-foot swim Speed.

_desc_en: Your family is descended from the most common lizardfolk heritage, and you are accustomed to aquatic environments. You gain a 15-foot swim Speed.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가문은 가장 흔한 리자드포크 유산의 후예이며, 당신은 수생 환경에 익숙합니다. 당신은 15피트 수영 이동력을 얻습니다.

name: Leaf Leshy

description.value: Your body is made mostly from natural foliage, and like a leaf tumbling from a tree, you land from falls with particular grace. You take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall.

_desc_en: Your body is made mostly from natural foliage, and like a leaf tumbling from a tree, you land from falls with particular grace. You take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 대부분 자연의 잎으로 이루어져 있으며, 나무에서 떨어지는 잎처럼 당신은 특별히 우아하게 낙하에서 착지합니다. 당신은 낙하 거리에 관계없이 낙하로 인한 피해를 전혀 입지 않습니다.

name: Polychromatic Anadi

description.value: Your body is covered with exceptionally colorful hairs that create vibrant, eye-catching patterns, some of which might even show in your human form. You become trained in Performance (or another skill if you were already trained in Performance), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your body is covered with exceptionally colorful hairs that create vibrant, eye-catching patterns, some of which might even show in your human form. You become trained in Performance (or another skill if you were already trained in Performance), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 유난히 화려한 털로 뒤덮여 있어 선명하고 눈길을 끄는 무늬를 만들어내며, 그중 일부는 인간 형태에서도 드러날 수 있습니다. 당신은 예능에 숙련됩니다(이미 예능에 숙련되어 있었다면 다른 기술에 숙련됩니다). 그리고 당신은 @link[feats.impressive-performance]{인상적인 공연} 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Elementheart Kobold

description.value: When you hatched, you imprinted on a creature strongly associated with one of the Elemental Planes, such as an elemental or genie. Choose air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood for your elemental benefactor. You gain resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) to the damage type associated with your elemental benefactor: cold for air, electricity for earth, fire for fire, sonic for metal, acid for water, or poison for wood.

_desc_en: When you hatched, you imprinted on a creature strongly associated with one of the Elemental Planes, such as an elemental or genie. Choose air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood for your elemental benefactor. You gain resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) to the damage type associated with your elemental benefactor: cold for air, electricity for earth, fire for fire, sonic for metal, acid for water, or poison for wood.
_desc_ko: 당신이 부화했을 때, 당신은 원소의 계 중 하나와 강하게 연관된 존재, 이를테면 원소체나 지니에게 각인되었습니다. 당신의 원소 후원자로 대기, 대지, 불, 금속, 물, 나무 중 하나를 선택하세요. 당신은 당신의 원소 후원자와 연관된 피해 유형에 대해 당신 레벨의 절반(최소 1)에 해당하는 저항을 얻습니다: 대기는 냉기, 대지는 전기, 불은 화염, 금속은 음향, 물은 산성, 나무는 독.

name: Rainfall Orc

description.value: You were born in a rain forest with only tangles of trees providing protection from torrential rainstorms and flash floods. You've learned to move adeptly through jungle terrain and resist the various ailments common in humid environs. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim} and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases.

_desc_en: You were born in a rain forest with only tangles of trees providing protection from torrential rainstorms and flash floods. You've learned to move adeptly through jungle terrain and resist the various ailments common in humid environs. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim} and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases.
_desc_ko: 당신은 폭우와 급류로부터 보호해 줄 것이라곤 뒤엉킨 나무들뿐인 우림에서 태어났습니다. 당신은 정글 지형을 능숙하게 이동하고 습한 환경에서 흔한 여러 질병에 저항하는 법을 익혔습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.climb]{등반}이나 @link[actions.swim]{수영}을 위한 운동 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻고, 질병에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Wilderness Samsaran

description.value: Your preceding lives have been reborn in various remote environments away from major settlements in Tian Xia and beyond. Your past manifestations have had to learn how to survive on their own, and you recall this will to survive while possessing very little resources. You become trained in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can ignore difficult terrain from trees, foliage, and undergrowth.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your preceding lives have been reborn in various remote environments away from major settlements in Tian Xia and beyond. Your past manifestations have had to learn how to survive on their own, and you recall this will to survive while possessing very little resources. You become trained in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can ignore difficult terrain from trees, foliage, and undergrowth.
_desc_ko: 당신의 전생들은 티안 시아 및 그 너머의 주요 정착지에서 멀리 떨어진 다양한 외딴 환경에서 환생해 왔습니다. 당신의 과거 화신들은 스스로 살아남는 법을 익혀야 했으며, 당신은 자원이 거의 없는 상황에서도 이 생존 의지를 기억합니다. 당신은 생존에 숙련됩니다. 만약 (배경이나 클래스 등으로 인해) 자동으로 생존에 숙련되게 된다면, 대신 당신이 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다. 당신은 나무, 잎, 덤불로 인한 험지를 무시할 수 있습니다.

name: Makari Lizardfolk

description.value:
You have a trunk-like snout and a connection to the divine. The tradition of any spells or magical abilities you gain from a lizardfolk heritage or ancestry feat is divine instead of its normal tradition (usually primal).

You gain your choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwZBXN6zBoB9BHXE]{Divine Lance} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.RA7VKcen3p56rVyZ]{Forbidding Ward} cantrips, which you can cast as a divine innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. When you cast this cantrip, it loses the manipulate trait, as you cast purely by roaring and flaring your trunk.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You have a trunk-like snout and a connection to the divine. The tradition of any spells or magical abilities you gain from a lizardfolk heritage or ancestry feat is divine instead of its normal tradition (usually primal).

You gain your choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwZBXN6zBoB9BHXE]{Divine Lance} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.RA7VKcen3p56rVyZ]{Forbidding Ward} cantrips, which you can cast as a divine innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. When you cast this cantrip, it loses the manipulate trait, as you cast purely by roaring and flaring your trunk.
_desc_ko:
당신은 코처럼 생긴 주둥이와 신성한 존재와의 연결을 지닙니다. 당신이 리자드포크 유산이나 혈통 재주로 얻는 모든 주문이나 마법 능력의 전통은 원래의 전통(보통 원시) 대신 신성입니다.

당신은 @link[spells.divine-lance]{신성한 창}이나 @link[spells.forbidding-ward]{금지의 수호} 소마법 중 하나를 선택해 얻으며, 이를 신성 선천 소마법으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다. 이 소마법을 시전할 때, 당신은 순전히 포효하고 주둥이를 벌려 시전하므로 이 소마법은 조작 특성을 잃습니다.

name: Sewer Rat

description.value: You come from a long line of ratfolk with a community based in the sewers beneath a large settlement. You are immune to the disease putrid plague. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease or poison, you get a critical success instead. If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.gdSmSTaGDxf4g2d8]{Battle Hardened} fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: You come from a long line of ratfolk with a community based in the sewers beneath a large settlement. You are immune to the disease putrid plague. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease or poison, you get a critical success instead.
