If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.gdSmSTaGDxf4g2d8]{Battle Hardened} fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 큰 정착지 아래 하수구에 자리 잡은 공동체를 둔 랫포크의 오랜 혈통 출신입니다. 당신은 부패 역병 질병에 면역입니다. 당신은 질병과 독에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 질병이나 독에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 만약 이런 식으로 내성을 개선하는 다른 능력(이를테면 @link[feats.battle-hardened]{전투로 단련됨} 전사 클래스 특성)을 가지고 있다면, 그 내성에서 대실패를 굴렸을 때 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Forge-Blessed Dwarf

description.value: You are from a family in Highhelm that venerates a particular dwarven deity above all others. Your birth was blessed by your family's patron deity, granting you a fraction of their power. Choose one deity from the dwarven pantheon. You can cast the 1st-rank spell they grant clerics (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n]{Soothe} if your family's patron is Bolka) as an innate divine spell once per week.

_desc_en: You are from a family in Highhelm that venerates a particular dwarven deity above all others. Your birth was blessed by your family's patron deity, granting you a fraction of their power. Choose one deity from the dwarven pantheon. You can cast the 1st-rank spell they grant clerics (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n]{Soothe} if your family's patron is Bolka) as an innate divine spell once per week.
_desc_ko: 당신은 하이헬름에서 특정 드워프 신을 다른 무엇보다도 숭배하는 가문 출신입니다. 당신의 탄생은 가문의 수호신의 축복을 받았으며, 이는 당신에게 그들의 힘의 일부를 부여했습니다. 드워프 만신전에서 신 하나를 선택하세요. 당신은 그들이 클레릭에게 부여하는 1등급 주문(당신 가문의 수호신이 볼카라면 @link[spells.soothe]{진정} 같은)을 주 1회 선천 신성 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Wellspring Gnome

description.value:
Some other source of magic has a greater hold on you than the primal magic of your fey lineage does. This connection might come from an occult plane or an ancient occult song; a deity, celestial, or fiend; magical effluent left behind by a mage war; or ancient rune magic.

Choose arcane, divine, or occult. You gain one cantrip from that magical tradition's spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate spell at will, as a spell of your chosen tradition. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Whenever you gain a primal innate spell from a gnome ancestry feat, change its tradition from primal to your chosen tradition.

_desc_en:
Some other source of magic has a greater hold on you than the primal magic of your fey lineage does. This connection might come from an occult plane or an ancient occult song; a deity, celestial, or fiend; magical effluent left behind by a mage war; or ancient rune magic.

Choose arcane, divine, or occult. You gain one cantrip from that magical tradition's spell list. You can cast this spell as an innate spell at will, as a spell of your chosen tradition. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Whenever you gain a primal innate spell from a gnome ancestry feat, change its tradition from primal to your chosen tradition.
_desc_ko:
어떤 다른 마법의 원천이 당신의 페이 혈통의 원시 마법보다 당신을 더 강하게 사로잡고 있습니다. 이 연결은 신비계나 고대의 신비한 노래에서, 신이나 천상체 또는 악마에게서, 마법사 전쟁이 남긴 마법의 잔류물에서, 아니면 고대 룬 마법에서 비롯되었을 수 있습니다.

비전, 신성, 신비 중 하나를 선택하세요. 당신은 그 마법 전통의 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 얻습니다. 당신은 이 주문을 당신이 선택한 전통의 주문으로서 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다. 노움 혈통 재주로 원시 선천 주문을 얻을 때마다, 그 전통을 원시에서 당신이 선택한 전통으로 바꿉니다.

name: Vine Leshy

description.value: Your prehensile vines grant you unmatched skill at climbing. You do not need to have any hands free to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}. Additionally, if you roll a success on an Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your prehensile vines grant you unmatched skill at climbing. You do not need to have any hands free to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}. Additionally, if you roll a success on an Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 물건을 쥐는 덩굴은 당신에게 비할 데 없는 등반 기술을 부여합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.climb]{등반}을 위해 손을 자유롭게 비워둘 필요가 없습니다. 또한 등반을 위한 운동 판정에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Longsnout Rat

description.value:
Your long snout gives you a keener sense of smell than most ratfolk. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine a creature's location. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} a creature or object within the range of your scent.

_desc_en:
Your long snout gives you a keener sense of smell than most ratfolk. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine a creature's location. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} a creature or object within the range of your scent.
_desc_ko:
당신의 긴 주둥이는 대부분의 랫포크보다 더 예리한 후각을 부여합니다. 당신은 30피트 범위의 부정확한 후각을 얻습니다. 이는 후각을 사용해 생명체의 위치를 파악할 수 있음을 뜻합니다. GM은 보통 당신이 생명체의 바람 아래쪽에 있으면 범위를 두 배로, 바람 위쪽에 있으면 범위를 절반으로 합니다.

또한 당신은 후각 범위 내의 생명체나 물체를 @link[actions.seek]{탐색}하기 위한 감지 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Songbird Strix

description.value: You descend from a talented line of strix storytellers. From the highest mountains and purest landscapes where your lungs fill with glorious clean air, you trill, whistle, and croon sweet songs. While natural sounds make you predisposed to sing, voices make you predisposed to mimicry. You receive a +1 circumstance bonus on Deception checks to Impersonate a mimicked voice, where the sound of the voice is the only factor; if you are a master in Deception, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus instead. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Performance checks to sing; if you are a master in Performance, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus instead.

_desc_en: You descend from a talented line of strix storytellers. From the highest mountains and purest landscapes where your lungs fill with glorious clean air, you trill, whistle, and croon sweet songs. While natural sounds make you predisposed to sing, voices make you predisposed to mimicry. You receive a +1 circumstance bonus on Deception checks to Impersonate a mimicked voice, where the sound of the voice is the only factor; if you are a master in Deception, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus instead. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Performance checks to sing; if you are a master in Performance, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 재능 있는 스트릭스 이야기꾼의 혈통을 이어받았습니다. 폐가 영광스러운 맑은 공기로 가득 차는 가장 높은 산과 가장 순수한 풍경에서, 당신은 달콤한 노래를 지저귀고 휘파람 불며 흥얼거립니다. 자연의 소리가 당신을 노래하도록 이끄는 한편, 목소리는 당신을 흉내내도록 이끕니다. 당신은 소리로 된 목소리가 유일한 요인인, 흉내낸 목소리를 사칭하기 위한 기만 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 기만에 명인이라면 대신 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신은 또한 노래하기 위한 예능 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 예능에 명인이라면 대신 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Rite of Knowing

description.value: You enhanced your exoskeleton with a connection to Axis, allowing you to tap into the infinite knowledge of the plane. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.k5TASjIxghvGCy7g]{Call to Axis} action.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You enhanced your exoskeleton with a connection to Axis, allowing you to tap into the infinite knowledge of the plane. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.k5TASjIxghvGCy7g]{Call to Axis} action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 액시스와의 연결로 외골격을 강화하여, 그 계의 무한한 지식에 접근할 수 있게 되었습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.call-to-axis]{액시스에 호소} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Shadow of the Wanderer

description.value: Your shadow blazes out ahead of you, clearing your path. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your shadow blazes out ahead of you, clearing your path. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신의 그림자가 당신보다 앞서 이글거리며 길을 밝힙니다. 당신의 이동력이 5피트 증가합니다.

name: Jinxed Tengu

description.value: Your lineage has been exposed to curse after curse, and now they slide off your feathers like rain. If you succeed at a saving throw against a curse or misfortune effect, you get a critical success instead. When you would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, reduce the value of the doomed condition you would gain by 1.

_desc_en: Your lineage has been exposed to curse after curse, and now they slide off your feathers like rain. If you succeed at a saving throw against a curse or misfortune effect, you get a critical success instead. When you would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, reduce the value of the doomed condition you would gain by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈통은 저주에 또 저주를 거듭 겪어 왔으며, 이제 저주는 빗물처럼 당신의 깃털에서 미끄러져 내립니다. 저주나 불운 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 성공하면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 당신이 @link[conditions.doomed]{파멸} 상태를 얻게 될 때, @Check[flat|dc:17]을 시도하세요. 성공하면, 당신이 얻게 될 파멸 상태의 수치를 1 줄입니다.

name: Reflection

description.value: You were created as a duplicate of another creature, intentionally or accidentally, though you might not know of your origins. Other than a minor mark or two, you look just like your progenitor. You gain the reflection trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You don't need to attempt Deception checks to Impersonate your progenitor unless you're interacting with people who know them personally or you do something known to be out of character for them. The GM might require you to roll a Deception check in other circumstances, such as if you're mirror-risen and interacting with someone who has seen an accurate likeness of your progenitor and might notice a distinguishing feature on the reverse side. You can choose from reflection feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en: You were created as a duplicate of another creature, intentionally or accidentally, though you might not know of your origins. Other than a minor mark or two, you look just like your progenitor. You gain the reflection trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You don't need to attempt Deception checks to Impersonate your progenitor unless you're interacting with people who know them personally or you do something known to be out of character for them. The GM might require you to roll a Deception check in other circumstances, such as if you're mirror-risen and interacting with someone who has seen an accurate likeness of your progenitor and might notice a distinguishing feature on the reverse side. You can choose from reflection feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 의도적으로든 우연히든 다른 생명체의 복제로 창조되었으며, 자신의 기원을 모를 수도 있습니다. 사소한 표식 한둘을 제외하면, 당신은 당신의 원본과 똑같이 생겼습니다. 당신은 혈통에서 오는 특성에 더해 반영체 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 원본을 개인적으로 아는 사람들과 상호작용하거나 원본답지 않다고 알려진 행동을 하지 않는 한, 원본을 사칭하기 위해 기만 판정을 시도할 필요가 없습니다. GM은 다른 상황에서 기만 판정을 굴리도록 요구할 수 있는데, 예를 들어 당신이 거울에서 태어난 존재이고 원본의 정확한 모습을 본 적이 있어 반대쪽 면의 특징적인 부분을 알아챌 수 있는 사람과 상호작용하는 경우입니다. 당신은 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 반영체 재주와 당신 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Snow Goblin

description.value: You are acclimated to living in frigid lands and have skin ranging from sky blue to navy in color, as well as blue fur. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

_desc_en: You are acclimated to living in frigid lands and have skin ranging from sky blue to navy in color, as well as blue fur. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신은 혹한의 땅에서 사는 데 적응했으며, 하늘색부터 남색에 이르는 피부와 파란 털을 지닙니다. 당신은 당신 레벨의 절반(최소 1)에 해당하는 냉기 저항을 얻습니다. 당신은 환경의 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극심한 것으로 취급합니다(믿을 수 없는 추위는 극심한 추위가 되고, 극심한 추위는 심각한 추위가 되는 식으로).

name: Dokkaebi Goblin

description.value: Your ancestors mastered illusion-based magic, giving you an innate understanding of it. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment} as an innate occult cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against illusions.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your ancestors mastered illusion-based magic, giving you an innate understanding of it. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment} as an innate occult cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against illusions.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들은 환영 기반 마법을 통달하여, 당신에게 그에 대한 선천적 이해를 부여했습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.figment]{환영상}을 신비 선천 소마법으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다. 당신은 또한 환영에 대한 의지 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Grig

description.value: You have the hindquarters of a cricket and adore art and music. Your cricket legs grant you a +2 circumstance bonus on Athletics checks to High Jump or Long Jump, and you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{Ghost Sound} as a primal innate cantrip.

_desc_en: You have the hindquarters of a cricket and adore art and music. Your cricket legs grant you a +2 circumstance bonus on Athletics checks to High Jump or Long Jump, and you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{Ghost Sound} as a primal innate cantrip.
_desc_ko: 당신은 귀뚜라미의 하반신을 지녔으며 예술과 음악을 사랑합니다. 당신의 귀뚜라미 다리는 높이뛰기나 멀리뛰기를 위한 운동 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 부여하며, 당신은 @link[spells.ghost-sound]{유령의 소리}를 원시 선천 소마법으로 얻습니다.

name: Irongut Goblin

description.value:
You can subsist on food that most folks would consider spoiled. You can keep yourself fed with poor meals in a settlement as long as garbage is readily available, without using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} downtime activity. You can eat and drink things when you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against afflictions, against gaining the sickened condition, and to remove the sickened condition. When you roll a success on a Fortitude save affected by this bonus, you get a critical success instead. All these benefits apply only when the affliction or condition resulted from something you ingested.

_desc_en:
You can subsist on food that most folks would consider spoiled. You can keep yourself fed with poor meals in a settlement as long as garbage is readily available, without using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} downtime activity. You can eat and drink things when you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against afflictions, against gaining the sickened condition, and to remove the sickened condition. When you roll a success on a Fortitude save affected by this bonus, you get a critical success instead. All these benefits apply only when the affliction or condition resulted from something you ingested.
_desc_ko:
당신은 대부분의 사람들이 상했다고 여길 음식으로 연명할 수 있습니다. 당신은 정착지에서 쓰레기를 쉽게 구할 수 있는 한 @link[actions.subsist]{연명} 여가 활동을 사용하지 않고도 형편없는 식사로 스스로를 먹여 살릴 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[conditions.sickened]{메스꺼움} 상태일 때에도 먹고 마실 수 있습니다.

당신은 질환에 대한, 메스꺼움 상태를 얻는 것에 대한, 그리고 메스꺼움 상태를 제거하기 위한 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스가 적용되는 강인 내성에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 이 모든 이점은 질환이나 상태가 당신이 섭취한 무언가로 인해 발생한 경우에만 적용됩니다.

name: Nyktera

description.value: You have batlike features, an affinity for batkind, and hearing that is second to none. As long as you can hear normally, you can use the Seek action to sense @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:60] instead of a @Template[cone|distance:30]. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to locate undetected creatures that you could hear within 30 feet with a Seek action.

rules.label: To seek undetected you can hear within 30 feet (Nyktera)

_desc_en: You have batlike features, an affinity for batkind, and hearing that is second to none. As long as you can hear normally, you can use the Seek action to sense @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:60] instead of a @Template[cone|distance:30]. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to locate undetected creatures that you could hear within 30 feet with a Seek action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 박쥐 같은 특징과 박쥐 종족에 대한 친화력, 그리고 둘째가라면 서러운 청각을 지닙니다. 정상적으로 들을 수 있는 한, 당신은 탐색 행동을 사용해 @Template[cone|distance:30] 대신 @Template[cone|distance:60] 안의 @link[conditions.undetected]{미감지} 생명체를 감지할 수 있습니다. 당신은 또한 탐색 행동으로 30피트 안에서 들을 수 있는 미감지 생명체의 위치를 찾는 데 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Versatile Human

description.value: Humanity's versatility and ambition have fueled its ascendance to be the most common ancestry in most nations throughout the world. Select a general feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites (as with your ancestry feat, you can select this general feat at any point during character creation).

_desc_en: Humanity's versatility and ambition have fueled its ascendance to be the most common ancestry in most nations throughout the world. Select a general feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites (as with your ancestry feat, you can select this general feat at any point during character creation).
_desc_ko: 인류의 다재다능함과 야망은 인류가 세계 대부분의 나라에서 가장 흔한 혈통으로 부상하는 것을 이끌었습니다. 당신이 전제조건을 충족하는 일반 재주 하나를 선택하세요(혈통 재주와 마찬가지로, 이 일반 재주는 캐릭터 생성 중 어느 시점에서든 선택할 수 있습니다).

name: Nine Lives Catfolk

description.value: Your family has always seems to bounce back from disaster, not through physical hardiness or specialized skill, but from sheer luck. Other catfolk whisper that you have nine lives. While you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, you don't add your dying value to the DC of your recovery checks (this means the DC is typically 10). In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} general feat.

_desc_en: Your family has always seems to bounce back from disaster, not through physical hardiness or specialized skill, but from sheer luck. Other catfolk whisper that you have nine lives. While you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, you don't add your dying value to the DC of your recovery checks (this means the DC is typically 10). In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} general feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가문은 언제나 재난에서 되살아나는 듯한데, 육체적 강인함이나 특별한 기술이 아니라 순전한 행운으로 그렇습니다. 다른 캣포크들은 당신이 아홉 개의 목숨을 가졌다고 수군댑니다. 당신이 @link[conditions.dying]{빈사} 상태인 동안, 당신은 회복 판정의 DC에 빈사 수치를 더하지 않습니다(즉 DC는 보통 10입니다). 또한 당신은 @link[feats.diehard]{끈질긴 생명} 일반 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Seaweed Leshy

description.value: Your body is made from woven seaweed, and you're just as comfortable underwater as on land. You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet, and you can always breathe underwater. However, your land Speed is reduced by 5 feet (to 20 feet for most seaweed leshies).

_desc_en: Your body is made from woven seaweed, and you're just as comfortable underwater as on land. You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet, and you can always breathe underwater. However, your land Speed is reduced by 5 feet (to 20 feet for most seaweed leshies).
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 엮인 해초로 만들어져 있으며, 당신은 물속에서도 육지에서만큼 편안합니다. 당신은 20피트 수영 이동력을 얻으며, 언제나 물속에서 숨 쉴 수 있습니다. 그러나 당신의 육상 이동력은 5피트 감소합니다(대부분의 해초 레쉬는 20피트로).

name: Courageous Tanuki

description.value: Your heart beats with the courage of those who came before you, giving you the kind of bravery only a tanuki can demonstrate. Whenever you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, you also gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds that lasts as long as you're fleeing. When you have the fleeing condition, instead of having to spend all your actions trying to escape, you can act normally for one action but must still spend the remainder of your actions fleeing. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KInVpdfrxg0AqjRt]{Tactical Retreat} ability.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your heart beats with the courage of those who came before you, giving you the kind of bravery only a tanuki can demonstrate. Whenever you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, you also gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds that lasts as long as you're fleeing. When you have the fleeing condition, instead of having to spend all your actions trying to escape, you can act normally for one action but must still spend the remainder of your actions fleeing. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KInVpdfrxg0AqjRt]{Tactical Retreat} ability.
_desc_ko: 당신의 심장은 앞서간 이들의 용기로 뛰며, 이는 너구리만이 보여줄 수 있는 종류의 용맹을 부여합니다. 당신이 @link[conditions.fleeing]{도주} 상태를 얻을 때마다, 당신은 도주하는 동안 지속되는 +10피트 상황 보너스를 이동력에 얻습니다. 도주 상태일 때, 당신은 모든 행동을 도망치는 데 써야 하는 대신 한 행동으로는 평소처럼 행동할 수 있지만 나머지 행동은 여전히 도주하는 데 써야 합니다. 당신은 또한 @link[actions.tactical-retreat]{전술적 후퇴} 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Winter Kholo

description.value: You're a hardy kholo covered in thick, tufted fur that makes you able to survive in the harsh winters of the colder territories. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

_desc_en: You're a hardy kholo covered in thick, tufted fur that makes you able to survive in the harsh winters of the colder territories. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신은 두껍고 복슬복슬한 털로 뒤덮인 강인한 콜로로, 더 추운 지역의 혹독한 겨울에서도 살아남을 수 있습니다. 당신은 당신 레벨의 절반(최소 1)에 해당하는 냉기 저항을 얻습니다. 당신은 환경의 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극심한 것으로 취급합니다(믿을 수 없는 추위는 극심한 추위가 되고, 극심한 추위는 심각한 추위가 되는 식으로).

name: Surgewise Fleshwarp

description.value: The undulations of your body's cilia are hyper-attuned to wellsprings of magic; they trill and thrum with insights into occult energies, and their vibrations alert you to the presence of secrets. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Occultism. If you're trained in Occultism, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hDGosy2ZTwnyctEP]{Oddity Identification} skill feat.

_desc_en: The undulations of your body's cilia are hyper-attuned to wellsprings of magic; they trill and thrum with insights into occult energies, and their vibrations alert you to the presence of secrets. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Occultism. If you're trained in Occultism, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hDGosy2ZTwnyctEP]{Oddity Identification} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신 몸의 섬모의 물결은 마법의 원천에 극도로 조율되어 있습니다. 그것들은 신비한 에너지에 대한 통찰로 떨리고 진동하며, 그 진동은 당신에게 비밀의 존재를 알립니다. 당신은 신비학에서 숙련 능숙도 등급을 얻습니다. 이미 신비학에 숙련되어 있다면, 대신 당신이 선택한 다른 기술에 숙련됩니다. 당신은 또한 @link[feats.oddity-identification]{기이함 식별} 기술 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Sacred Nagaji

description.value: You stand out from most nagaji, with the upper body of a beautiful human and the lower body of a green or white snake. Legends claim your ancestors were faithful snakes uplifted by Nalinivati rather than nagaji created by the goddess. Instead of a fangs unarmed attack, you have a tail attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, is in the brawling weapon group, and has the finesse and unarmed traits. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against effects that would @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grab} you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrain} you, or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

_desc_en: You stand out from most nagaji, with the upper body of a beautiful human and the lower body of a green or white snake. Legends claim your ancestors were faithful snakes uplifted by Nalinivati rather than nagaji created by the goddess. Instead of a fangs unarmed attack, you have a tail attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, is in the brawling weapon group, and has the finesse and unarmed traits. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against effects that would @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grab} you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrain} you, or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 아름다운 인간의 상반신과 녹색이나 흰색 뱀의 하반신을 지녀 대부분의 나가지와 두드러집니다. 전설에 따르면 당신의 조상은 여신이 창조한 나가지가 아니라 날리니바티에 의해 승격된 신실한 뱀이었다고 합니다. 송곳니 비무장 공격 대신, 당신은 1d6 타격 피해를 입히고 격투 무기군에 속하며 정교함과 비무장 특성을 지닌 꼬리 공격을 가집니다. 당신은 당신을 @link[actions.grapple]{붙잡기}하거나 @link[actions.trip]{넘어뜨리기}하려는 시도에 대한 강인 또는 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 또한 당신을 @link[conditions.grabbed]{움켜쥠}하거나, @link[conditions.restrained]{구속}하거나, @link[conditions.prone]{넘어짐} 상태로 만드는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에도 적용됩니다.

name: Created Fleshwarp

description.value: You were created through occult or alchemical processes, such as being grown in a vat or stitched together from the body parts of other creatures by a scientist in Ustalav. Your manufactured body is durable; you don't need to eat and can't starve. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases.

_desc_en: You were created through occult or alchemical processes, such as being grown in a vat or stitched together from the body parts of other creatures by a scientist in Ustalav. Your manufactured body is durable; you don't need to eat and can't starve. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases.
_desc_ko: 당신은 신비하거나 연금술적인 과정을 통해 창조되었는데, 이를테면 통 속에서 배양되거나 우스탈라브의 과학자에 의해 다른 생명체의 신체 부위들로 꿰매어졌습니다. 당신의 제조된 몸은 튼튼합니다. 당신은 먹을 필요가 없고 굶어 죽을 수 없습니다. 당신은 질병에 대한 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Nomadic Halfling

description.value: Your ancestors have traveled from place to place for generations, never content to settle down. You gain two additional languages of your choice, chosen from among the common and uncommon languages available to you, and every time you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} feat, you gain another new language.

_desc_en: Your ancestors have traveled from place to place for generations, never content to settle down. You gain two additional languages of your choice, chosen from among the common and uncommon languages available to you, and every time you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} feat, you gain another new language.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들은 여러 세대에 걸쳐 이곳저곳을 여행하며 결코 정착하는 데 만족하지 않았습니다. 당신은 당신에게 열려 있는 흔한 언어와 흔치 않은 언어 중에서 선택한 추가 언어 두 개를 얻으며, @link[feats.multilingual]{다중언어} 재주를 취할 때마다 또 다른 새 언어를 얻습니다.

name: Shifting Skeleton

description.value: Constructed from the bones of various shapechanging creatures, shifting skeletons retain a measure of reconfigurability, allowing them to shift forms. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OqKYkzbc7NEWmJWB]{Rearrange Bones} action.

_desc_en: Constructed from the bones of various shapechanging creatures, shifting skeletons retain a measure of reconfigurability, allowing them to shift forms. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OqKYkzbc7NEWmJWB]{Rearrange Bones} action.
_desc_ko: 다양한 형태변환 생명체의 뼈로 구성된 변형 해골은 어느 정도 재구성 능력을 유지하여, 형태를 바꿀 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.rearrange-bones]{뼈 재배열} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Lotus Leshy

description.value: You effortlessly float on the surface of water. You can walk on the surface of still water and other non-damaging liquids, moving at half your normal Speed. You can also attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} to move across the surface of flowing water, using the DC of a Swim check to move through the water. When you do this, you can't move faster than half your Speed, and if you fail or critically fail, you fall into the water rather than the normal effects.

_desc_en: You effortlessly float on the surface of water. You can walk on the surface of still water and other non-damaging liquids, moving at half your normal Speed. You can also attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} to move across the surface of flowing water, using the DC of a Swim check to move through the water. When you do this, you can't move faster than half your Speed, and if you fail or critically fail, you fall into the water rather than the normal effects.
_desc_ko: 당신은 물 표면 위를 힘들이지 않고 떠다닙니다. 당신은 잔잔한 물과 그 밖의 피해를 주지 않는 액체의 표면을 평소 이동력의 절반으로 이동하며 걸을 수 있습니다. 당신은 또한 흐르는 물의 표면을 가로질러 이동하기 위해 @link[actions.balance]{균형잡기}를 시도할 수 있는데, 물속을 이동하기 위한 수영 판정의 DC를 사용합니다. 이렇게 할 때, 당신은 이동력의 절반보다 빠르게 이동할 수 없으며, 실패하거나 대실패하면 평소의 효과 대신 물속으로 빠집니다.

name: Elfbane Hobgoblin

description.value: Hobgoblins were engineered long ago from the unreliable and fecund goblins to be used as an army against the elves. Although the elves ultimately freed the hobgoblins from their bondage, some hobgoblins retain ancestral resistance to magic, which they refer to as "elf magic." You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.On5CQjX4euWqToly]{Resist Elf Magic} reaction.

_desc_en: Hobgoblins were engineered long ago from the unreliable and fecund goblins to be used as an army against the elves. Although the elves ultimately freed the hobgoblins from their bondage, some hobgoblins retain ancestral resistance to magic, which they refer to as "elf magic." You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.On5CQjX4euWqToly]{Resist Elf Magic} reaction.
_desc_ko: 홉고블린은 오래전 불안정하고 다산하는 고블린으로부터 엘프에 맞서는 군대로 사용되기 위해 만들어졌습니다. 엘프들이 결국 홉고블린을 속박에서 해방시켰지만, 일부 홉고블린은 그들이 "엘프 마법"이라 부르는 마법에 대한 조상 대대의 저항력을 유지합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.resist-elf-magic]{엘프 마법 저항} 반응행동을 얻습니다.

name: Fishseeker Shoony

description.value: You come from a long line of fisherfolk and have inherited the quick reflexes necessary to nab and reel in big game. If you roll a success on an attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge}, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. A creature that rolls a failure on a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} you gets a critical failure instead.

_desc_en: You come from a long line of fisherfolk and have inherited the quick reflexes necessary to nab and reel in big game. If you roll a success on an attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge}, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. A creature that rolls a failure on a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} you gets a critical failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 오랜 어부 혈통 출신이며 큰 사냥감을 낚아채고 끌어당기는 데 필요한 빠른 반사신경을 물려받았습니다. @link[actions.grab-an-edge]{모서리 붙잡기} 시도에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 대실패를 굴리면, 대신 실패를 얻습니다. 당신을 @link[actions.disarm]{무장해제}하려는 판정에서 실패를 굴린 생명체는 대신 대실패를 얻습니다.

name: Scavenger Strix

description.value: Your ancestors originated from a land where food was scarce and threats were many. You are trained in Survival. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8qebBeOJsyRIchcu]{Forager} skill feat as a bonus feat. Your thoroughness when gathering food provides you a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Subsist.

_desc_en: Your ancestors originated from a land where food was scarce and threats were many. You are trained in Survival. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8qebBeOJsyRIchcu]{Forager} skill feat as a bonus feat. Your thoroughness when gathering food provides you a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Subsist.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들은 식량이 부족하고 위협이 많은 땅에서 기원했습니다. 당신은 생존에 숙련됩니다. 당신은 @link[feats.forager]{채집가} 기술 재주를 보너스 재주로 얻습니다. 식량을 모을 때의 당신의 철저함은 연명하기 위한 생존 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

name: Sharpshooter Automaton

description.value: Your lithe, humanoid shape is designed for speed and accuracy suitable for ranged combat. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.9sXQf1SyppS5B6O1]{Automaton Aim} action.

_desc_en: Your lithe, humanoid shape is designed for speed and accuracy suitable for ranged combat. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.9sXQf1SyppS5B6O1]{Automaton Aim} action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 날렵하고 인간형인 형태는 원거리 전투에 적합한 속도와 정확성을 위해 설계되었습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.automaton-aim]{오토마톤 조준} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Ardande

description.value:
You descend from wood elementals or have some other heritage influenced by the elemental Plane of Wood. You might have green, mossy skin, vines that grow from your head instead of hair, or thin appendages that resemble twigs. You gain the ardande trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision.

You can choose from ardande feats, geniekin feats, and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

_desc_en:
You descend from wood elementals or have some other heritage influenced by the elemental Plane of Wood. You might have green, mossy skin, vines that grow from your head instead of hair, or thin appendages that resemble twigs. You gain the ardande trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You also gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision.

You can choose from ardande feats, geniekin feats, and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
_desc_ko:
당신은 나무 원소체의 후예이거나 원소의 나무의 계에 영향을 받은 다른 유산을 지닙니다. 당신은 녹색의 이끼 낀 피부를 지녔거나, 머리카락 대신 머리에서 덩굴이 자라거나, 잔가지를 닮은 가느다란 부속지를 가졌을 수 있습니다. 당신은 혈통에서 오는 특성에 더해 아르단데 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 또한 저광 시야를 얻으며, 당신의 혈통이 이미 저광 시야를 지녔다면 대신 암시야를 얻습니다.

당신은 혈통 재주를 얻을 때마다 아르단데 재주, 지니킨 재주, 그리고 당신 혈통의 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Seer Elf

description.value:
You have an inborn ability to detect and understand magical phenomena. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} of a magical nature. These skill actions typically use the Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion skill.

_desc_en:
You have an inborn ability to detect and understand magical phenomena. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} of a magical nature. These skill actions typically use the Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion skill.
_desc_ko:
당신은 마법 현상을 감지하고 이해하는 타고난 능력을 지니고 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.detect-magic]{마법 탐지} 소마법을 비전 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 동일한 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다.

또한 당신은 @link[actions.identify-magic]{마법 식별}과 마법적 성질의 @link[actions.decipher-writing]{문서 해독} 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 기술 행동은 보통 비전학, 자연학, 신비학, 종교학 기술을 사용합니다.

name: Glacier Cavern Minotaur

description.value: Your fur grows thick and warm, well suited to the frozen mountains in which you reside. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum of 1). Environmental cold effects are one step less extreme for you.

_desc_en: Your fur grows thick and warm, well suited to the frozen mountains in which you reside. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum of 1). Environmental cold effects are one step less extreme for you.
_desc_ko: 당신의 털은 두껍고 따뜻하게 자라나, 당신이 거주하는 얼어붙은 산맥에 잘 어울립니다. 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반과 동일한 냉기 저항(최소 1)을 얻습니다. 환경적 냉기 효과는 당신에게 한 단계 덜 극심해집니다.

name: Deep Fetchling

description.value: Your predecessors dwelled in the Shadow Plane's deepest, most treacherous regions. You might cast a denser shadow, have a slower pulse, or find comfort in the embrace of darkness. You gain cold or void resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), chosen when you gain this heritage.

_desc_en: Your predecessors dwelled in the Shadow Plane's deepest, most treacherous regions. You might cast a denser shadow, have a slower pulse, or find comfort in the embrace of darkness. You gain cold or void resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), chosen when you gain this heritage.
_desc_ko: 당신의 선조들은 그림자 세계의 가장 깊고 위험한 지역에 거주했습니다. 당신은 더 짙은 그림자를 드리우거나, 맥박이 더 느리거나, 어둠의 품에서 위안을 찾을지도 모릅니다. 당신은 이 유산을 얻을 때 선택한, 자신의 레벨 절반과 동일한 냉기 또는 공허 저항(최소 1)을 얻습니다.

name: Wisp Fetchling

description.value: Your ancestors' exposure to the Shadow Plane wrought great physical changes. Your hair or skin sometimes appears insubstantial, and you're slighter and more agile than other fetchlings. You're Small instead of Medium. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics, the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} skill feat, and a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to [[/act tumble-through]]. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

_desc_en: Your ancestors' exposure to the Shadow Plane wrought great physical changes. Your hair or skin sometimes appears insubstantial, and you're slighter and more agile than other fetchlings. You're Small instead of Medium. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics, the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} skill feat, and a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to [[/act tumble-through]]. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들이 그림자 세계에 노출되면서 커다란 신체적 변화가 일어났습니다. 당신의 머리카락이나 피부는 때때로 실체가 없어 보이며, 당신은 다른 페칠링보다 더 가냘프고 민첩합니다. 당신은 중형 대신 소형입니다. 당신은 곡예 기술의 숙련 숙련도 등급, @link[feats.quick-squeeze]{빠른 비집기} 기술 재주, 그리고 [[/act tumble-through]] 곡예 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 만약 당신이 (예를 들어 배경이나 클래스로부터) 자동으로 곡예에 숙련되었을 경우, 대신 원하는 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

name: Frozen Wind Kitsune

description.value: Your ancestors crossed the Crown of the World or resided on snowy peaks. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on). Your alternate form is a common Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human), called a tailless form.

_desc_en: Your ancestors crossed the Crown of the World or resided on snowy peaks. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on). Your alternate form is a common Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human), called a tailless form.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들은 세계의 정수리를 건너거나 눈 덮인 봉우리에 거주했습니다. 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반과 동일한 냉기 저항(최소 1)을 얻습니다. 당신은 환경적 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극심한 것처럼 취급합니다(믿기지 않는 냉기는 극심함이 되고, 극심한 냉기는 심각함이 되는 식입니다). 당신의 변신 형태는 당신이 자란 곳에서 흔한(보통 인간) 일반 중형 인간형 혈통이며, 꼬리 없는 형태라고 불립니다.

name: Born of Item

description.value:
You were an object until the moon breathed life into you. Choose one Lore skill related to what kind of tool you were; for instance, Cooking Lore for a cleaver or Farming Lore for a rake. You become trained in this skill.

  • Humanoid Form You retain memories of the tasks you performed as an object. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Lore skill you obtained through this heritage.
  • Yaoguai Form Your time as a mindless object makes it harder to affect you mentally. If you roll a success on a mental effect, you gain a critical success instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You were an object until the moon breathed life into you. Choose one Lore skill related to what kind of tool you were; for instance, Cooking Lore for a cleaver or Farming Lore for a rake. You become trained in this skill.

  • Humanoid Form You retain memories of the tasks you performed as an object. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Lore skill you obtained through this heritage.
  • Yaoguai Form Your time as a mindless object makes it harder to affect you mentally. If you roll a success on a mental effect, you gain a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
당신은 달이 생명을 불어넣기 전까지 하나의 물건이었습니다. 당신이 어떤 종류의 도구였는지와 관련된 지식 기술 하나를 선택하십시오. 예를 들어 식칼이라면 요리 지식, 갈퀴라면 농사 지식입니다. 당신은 이 기술에 숙련됩니다.

  • 인간형 형태 당신은 물건으로서 수행했던 작업의 기억을 간직하고 있습니다. 당신은 이 유산을 통해 얻은 지식 기술에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.
  • 요괴 형태 마음 없는 물건으로 지낸 시간 때문에 정신적으로 당신에게 영향을 주기가 더 어렵습니다. 정신 효과에 대해 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Anvil Dwarf

description.value: You are a descendant of a famed crafter and have your own amazing talent. Other dwarves might consider this a blessing from your ancestors or from the Forgefather himself, depending on where you grew up. You become trained in Crafting (or another skill if you were already trained in Crafting) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat, but you can pick two different specialties instead of one.

_desc_en: You are a descendant of a famed crafter and have your own amazing talent. Other dwarves might consider this a blessing from your ancestors or from the Forgefather himself, depending on where you grew up. You become trained in Crafting (or another skill if you were already trained in Crafting) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat, but you can pick two different specialties instead of one.
_desc_ko: 당신은 유명한 장인의 후손이며 자신만의 놀라운 재능을 지니고 있습니다. 다른 드워프들은 당신이 자란 곳에 따라 이를 당신 조상의 축복이나 대장장이 아버지 자신의 축복으로 여길지도 모릅니다. 당신은 제작에 숙련되며(이미 제작에 숙련되어 있었다면 다른 기술에 숙련됩니다) @link[feats.specialty-crafting]{전문 제작} 기술 재주를 얻는데, 다만 하나 대신 서로 다른 두 가지 전문 분야를 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Venomous Anadi

description.value: Your natural form's fangs are capable of injecting foes with venom. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8aIe57gXJ94mPpW4]{Anadi Venom} ability.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your natural form's fangs are capable of injecting foes with venom. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8aIe57gXJ94mPpW4]{Anadi Venom} ability.
_desc_ko: 당신의 자연 형태의 송곳니는 적에게 독을 주입할 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.anadi-venom]{아나디 독} 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Witch Kholo

description.value: You're a shaggy, dark-furred kholo capable of making some truly uncanny sounds. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment} cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} and Impersonate when using only your voice.

_desc_en: You're a shaggy, dark-furred kholo capable of making some truly uncanny sounds. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment} cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} and Impersonate when using only your voice.
_desc_ko: 당신은 털이 덥수룩하고 검은 콜로로, 정말 기이한 소리를 낼 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.figment]{환영상} 소마법을 신비 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 동일한 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다. 또한 당신은 목소리만 사용해 @link[actions.create-a-diversion]{교란 만들기}와 위장을 할 때 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Desert Elf

description.value: You live under the desert's blazing heat, gaining incredible resilience to warm environments. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and environmental heat effects are one step less extreme for you (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on).

_desc_en: You live under the desert's blazing heat, gaining incredible resilience to warm environments. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and environmental heat effects are one step less extreme for you (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신은 사막의 이글거리는 열기 아래에서 살아가며, 따뜻한 환경에 대한 놀라운 회복력을 얻습니다. 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반과 동일한 화염 저항(최소 1)을 얻으며, 환경적 열기 효과는 당신에게 한 단계 덜 극심해집니다(믿기지 않는 열기는 극심함이 되고, 극심한 열기는 심각함이 되는 식입니다).

name: Gandharva

description.value:
You're descended from the self-proclaimed musicians, poets, and dancers of the gods, with a body that's part humanoid and part horse or bird. If you gain wings, they come in many different brilliant colors. Due to your celestial connection, the tradition of any spells or magical abilities you gain from a sprite heritage or ancestry feat is divine instead of its normal tradition.

You become trained in Performance (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained in Performance), and you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yvs1zN5Pai5U4CJX]{Summon Instrument} as a divine innate cantrip.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You're descended from the self-proclaimed musicians, poets, and dancers of the gods, with a body that's part humanoid and part horse or bird. If you gain wings, they come in many different brilliant colors. Due to your celestial connection, the tradition of any spells or magical abilities you gain from a sprite heritage or ancestry feat is divine instead of its normal tradition.

You become trained in Performance (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained in Performance), and you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yvs1zN5Pai5U4CJX]{Summon Instrument} as a divine innate cantrip.
_desc_ko:
당신은 스스로를 신들의 음악가, 시인, 무용수라 칭하는 자들의 후손으로, 몸의 일부는 인간형이고 일부는 말이나 새입니다. 당신에게 날개가 생긴다면, 그것은 다양하고 눈부신 색으로 나타납니다. 당신의 천상적 연결 덕분에, 스프라이트 유산이나 혈통 재주로부터 얻는 주문이나 마법 능력의 전통은 원래 전통 대신 신성이 됩니다.

당신은 연기에 숙련되며(이미 연기에 숙련되어 있었다면 원하는 다른 기술에 숙련됩니다), @link[spells.summon-instrument]{악기 소환}을 신성 선천 소마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Stonestep Shisk

description.value: Navigating mountains and other rocky terrain is second nature to you. You can ignore non-magical difficult terrain caused by rubble and uneven ground made of stone and earth.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Navigating mountains and other rocky terrain is second nature to you. You can ignore non-magical difficult terrain caused by rubble and uneven ground made of stone and earth.
_desc_ko: 산이나 다른 바위투성이 지형을 헤쳐 나가는 것은 당신에게 자연스러운 일입니다. 당신은 돌과 흙으로 이루어진 잔해와 울퉁불퉁한 지면으로 인한 비마법적 험한 지형을 무시할 수 있습니다.

name: Keeper Jotunborn

description.value: Your work as an iivlar keeper has granted you a greater understanding of these sacred creatures and the ability to track them, as elusive as they may be. You are trained in Survival, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tGIXuk0XeWmG04CX]{Survey Wildlife} skill feat. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} animals.

_desc_en: Your work as an iivlar keeper has granted you a greater understanding of these sacred creatures and the ability to track them, as elusive as they may be. You are trained in Survival, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tGIXuk0XeWmG04CX]{Survey Wildlife} skill feat. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} animals.
_desc_ko: 이블라르 관리자로서의 일은 이 신성한 생물들에 대한 더 깊은 이해와, 그것들이 아무리 잡기 어렵더라도 추적할 수 있는 능력을 당신에게 주었습니다. 당신은 생존에 숙련되어 있으며, @link[feats.survey-wildlife]{야생 조사} 기술 재주를 얻습니다. 당신은 동물을 @link[actions.track]{추적}할 때 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다.

name: Venomtail Kobold

description.value: Thanks to the proximity of a venomous creature to your warren, you were born with a vestigial spur in your tail that secretes deadly venom. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ev8OHpBO3xq3Zt08]{Tail Toxin} action.

_desc_en: Thanks to the proximity of a venomous creature to your warren, you were born with a vestigial spur in your tail that secretes deadly venom. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ev8OHpBO3xq3Zt08]{Tail Toxin} action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 소굴 가까이에 독을 지닌 생물이 있었던 덕분에, 당신은 치명적인 독을 분비하는 흔적기관 돌기가 꼬리에 있는 채로 태어났습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.tail-toxin]{꼬리 독소} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Empty Sky Kitsune

description.value: Your spirit is open to the secrets of beyond, granting you greater access to kitsune magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Zz7isE8Td2xDWqR8]{Kitsune Spell Familiarity} ancestry feat. Your alternate form is a common Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human), called a tailless form.

_desc_en: Your spirit is open to the secrets of beyond, granting you greater access to kitsune magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Zz7isE8Td2xDWqR8]{Kitsune Spell Familiarity} ancestry feat. Your alternate form is a common Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human), called a tailless form.
_desc_ko: 당신의 정신은 저 너머의 비밀에 열려 있어, 키츠네 마법에 더 깊이 접근할 수 있게 해 줍니다. 당신은 @link[feats.kitsune-spell-familiarity]{키츠네 주문 친숙함} 혈통 재주를 얻습니다. 당신의 변신 형태는 당신이 자란 곳에서 흔한(보통 인간) 일반 중형 인간형 혈통이며, 꼬리 없는 형태라고 불립니다.

name: Slabsoul Minotaur

description.value: Your deep connection with stone and walls allows you to conjure massive slabs of granite that collapse on your foes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.0VwLAKI7QP6mib88]{Raise Slabs} activity.

_desc_en: Your deep connection with stone and walls allows you to conjure massive slabs of granite that collapse on your foes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.0VwLAKI7QP6mib88]{Raise Slabs} activity.
_desc_ko: 돌과 벽에 대한 당신의 깊은 연결은 적들에게 무너져 내리는 거대한 화강암 석판을 소환할 수 있게 해 줍니다. 당신은 @link[actions.raise-slabs]{석판 세우기} 활동을 얻습니다.

name: Compact Skeleton

description.value: For tasks that require a lighter touch, gnome, goblin, and halfling remains are more suitable than a larger creature's. These smaller, nimbler skeletons fit well in a traveling chest, can be forced through tight spaces, and more easily avoid detection. Your size is Small instead of Medium. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} feat, even if you aren't trained in Acrobatics. Tight spaces not tight enough to require the Squeeze activity aren't difficult terrain for you.

_desc_en: For tasks that require a lighter touch, gnome, goblin, and halfling remains are more suitable than a larger creature's. These smaller, nimbler skeletons fit well in a traveling chest, can be forced through tight spaces, and more easily avoid detection. Your size is Small instead of Medium. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} feat, even if you aren't trained in Acrobatics. Tight spaces not tight enough to require the Squeeze activity aren't difficult terrain for you.
_desc_ko: 더 섬세한 손길이 필요한 작업에는 노움, 고블린, 하플링의 유해가 더 큰 생물의 것보다 적합합니다. 이 더 작고 날렵한 스켈레톤은 여행용 상자에 잘 들어맞고, 좁은 공간에 억지로 밀어 넣을 수 있으며, 더 쉽게 발각을 피합니다. 당신의 크기는 중형 대신 소형입니다. 당신은 곡예에 숙련되어 있지 않더라도 @link[feats.quick-squeeze]{빠른 비집기} 재주를 얻습니다. 비집기 활동을 요구할 만큼 좁지 않은 좁은 공간은 당신에게 험한 지형이 아닙니다.

name: Paddler Shoony

description.value: You hail from shoonies who have lived long and successfully among the reeds and cattails of swamps and marshes, and have adapted to the challenges of living near waterlogged areas. You ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from bogs. When you roll a success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}, you get a critical success instead.

rules.text: When you roll a success to Swim, you get a critical success instead.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: You hail from shoonies who have lived long and successfully among the reeds and cattails of swamps and marshes, and have adapted to the challenges of living near waterlogged areas. You ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from bogs. When you roll a success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 습지와 늪의 갈대와 부들 사이에서 오랫동안 성공적으로 살아온 슈니 출신이며, 물에 잠긴 지역 근처에서 사는 어려움에 적응했습니다. 당신은 수렁으로 인한 험한 지형과 극심한 험한 지형을 무시합니다. @link[actions.swim]{수영}에 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Technological Fleshwarp

description.value: Your transformation is due to manipulation by advanced technology, like that found in Numeria. Your emotions are dulled and hard to influence. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your transformation is due to manipulation by advanced technology, like that found in Numeria. Your emotions are dulled and hard to influence. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 변형은 누메리아에서 발견되는 것과 같은 진보된 기술의 조작에 의한 것입니다. 당신의 감정은 무뎌져 있어 영향을 주기 어렵습니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Smokeworker Hobgoblin

description.value: Your family have been alchemists, engineers, and scientists for generations, laboring on projects that bring smoke and fire to the field of battle. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You automatically succeed at the DC 5 flat check to target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature if that creature is concealed only by smoke.

_desc_en: Your family have been alchemists, engineers, and scientists for generations, laboring on projects that bring smoke and fire to the field of battle. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You automatically succeed at the DC 5 flat check to target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature if that creature is concealed only by smoke.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가문은 여러 세대에 걸쳐 연금술사, 기술자, 과학자로서 전장에 연기와 화염을 불러오는 계획에 힘써 왔습니다. 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반과 동일한 화염 저항(최소 1)을 얻습니다. 당신은 오직 연기로만 은폐된 @link[conditions.concealed]{은폐} 상태의 생물을 대상으로 삼을 때 DC 5 평면 판정에 자동으로 성공합니다.

name: Wajaghand Vanara

description.value: Your ancestors were forced into labor by the rakshasa immortal Ravana, the First and the Last. Although their cleverness while in captivity saved countless lives, and they're bound no longer, the time marked your family with scars upon the mind that will never truly heal, even across the generations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects, and whenever you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your ancestors were forced into labor by the rakshasa immortal Ravana, the First and the Last. Although their cleverness while in captivity saved countless lives, and they're bound no longer, the time marked your family with scars upon the mind that will never truly heal, even across the generations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects, and whenever you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들은 라크샤사 불멸자 라바나, 처음이자 마지막에 의해 강제 노역에 내몰렸습니다. 포로 생활 중 그들의 영리함이 수많은 목숨을 구했고 이제 더는 속박되지 않지만, 그 시간은 당신의 가문에 세대를 넘어서도 결코 진정으로 아물지 않을 마음의 상처를 남겼습니다. 당신은 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 성공을 굴릴 때마다 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Woodland Elf

description.value:
You're adapted to life in the forest, the deep jungle, or a similar environment, and you know how to climb trees and use foliage to your advantage. When @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climbing} trees, vines, and other foliage, you move at half your Speed on a success and at full Speed on a critical success (and you move at full Speed on a success if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P04Hw8E6WAWARKHP]{Quick Climb}). This doesn't affect you if you're using a climb Speed.

You can always use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} action when you are within forest terrain to gain cover, even if you're not next to an obstacle you can Take Cover behind.

rules.text: When you climb trees, vines or other foliage, you move at half your Speed on a success, and full speed on a critical success.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en:
You're adapted to life in the forest, the deep jungle, or a similar environment, and you know how to climb trees and use foliage to your advantage. When @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climbing} trees, vines, and other foliage, you move at half your Speed on a success and at full Speed on a critical success (and you move at full Speed on a success if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P04Hw8E6WAWARKHP]{Quick Climb}). This doesn't affect you if you're using a climb Speed.

You can always use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} action when you are within forest terrain to gain cover, even if you're not next to an obstacle you can Take Cover behind.
_desc_ko:
당신은 숲, 깊은 정글, 또는 유사한 환경에서의 삶에 적응했으며, 나무를 오르고 나뭇잎을 유리하게 활용하는 법을 압니다. 나무, 덩굴, 그 밖의 나뭇잎을 @link[actions.climb]{등반}할 때, 성공 시 이동 속도의 절반으로, 대성공 시 전체 이동 속도로 이동합니다(그리고 @link[feats.quick-climb]{빠른 등반}을 지녔다면 성공 시에도 전체 이동 속도로 이동합니다). 등반 이동 속도를 사용 중이라면 이는 당신에게 영향을 주지 않습니다.

당신은 숲 지형 안에 있을 때, 엄폐할 만한 장애물 옆에 있지 않더라도 언제나 @link[actions.take-cover]{엄폐하기} 행동을 사용해 엄폐를 얻을 수 있습니다.

name: Battle-Ready Orc

description.value: You descend from a line of terrifying battlefield commanders. You become trained in Intimidation, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat.

_desc_en: You descend from a line of terrifying battlefield commanders. You become trained in Intimidation, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 무시무시한 전장 지휘관 혈통의 후손입니다. 당신은 위협에 숙련되며, @link[feats.intimidating-glare]{위협적 노려보기} 기술 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Swimming Animal

description.value:
You are an aquatic animal who is most comfortable in the water. You may spend much of your time in the water like an alligator, seal, whale, or dolphin, or you may require the water to breathe like a fish or some crustaceans.

You have one animal attack of your choice (typically claw, jaws, or tail; see the sidebar). Choose if you are aquatic or water-dwelling.

  • Aquatic: You gain the aquatic trait and you have a swim Speed of 30 feet. The aquatic trait means you breathe water but not air, and your bludgeoning and slashing unarmed Strikes don't take the usual –2 penalty for being underwater.
  • Water-dwelling: You can hold your breath underwater for 10 minutes before needing air. You have a swim Speed of 20 feet, and if you can move on land, you have base Speed of 20 feet.

_desc_en:
You are an aquatic animal who is most comfortable in the water. You may spend much of your time in the water like an alligator, seal, whale, or dolphin, or you may require the water to breathe like a fish or some crustaceans.

You have one animal attack of your choice (typically claw, jaws, or tail; see the sidebar). Choose if you are aquatic or water-dwelling.

  • Aquatic: You gain the aquatic trait and you have a swim Speed of 30 feet. The aquatic trait means you breathe water but not air, and your bludgeoning and slashing unarmed Strikes don't take the usual –2 penalty for being underwater.
  • Water-dwelling: You can hold your breath underwater for 10 minutes before needing air. You have a swim Speed of 20 feet, and if you can move on land, you have base Speed of 20 feet.
_desc_ko:
당신은 물속에서 가장 편안함을 느끼는 수생 동물입니다. 당신은 악어, 물개, 고래, 돌고래처럼 대부분의 시간을 물속에서 보낼 수도 있고, 물고기나 일부 갑각류처럼 숨쉬기 위해 물이 필요할 수도 있습니다.

당신은 원하는 동물 공격 하나를 지닙니다(보통 발톱, 턱, 꼬리이며, 곁상자를 참고하십시오). 자신이 수생인지 물거주형인지 선택하십시오.

  • 수생: 당신은 수생 특성을 얻고 30피트의 수영 이동 속도를 지닙니다. 수생 특성은 당신이 공기가 아닌 물로 숨쉰다는 뜻이며, 당신의 타격 및 참격 비무장 타격은 물속에 있을 때 받는 통상적인 –2 페널티를 받지 않습니다.
  • 물거주형: 당신은 공기가 필요하기 전까지 물속에서 10분 동안 숨을 참을 수 있습니다. 당신은 20피트의 수영 이동 속도를 지니며, 육지에서 이동할 수 있다면 기본 이동 속도 20피트를 지닙니다.

name: Scalekeeper Vishkanya

description.value: You are part of the family of vishkanyas in your community tasked with keeping records of the history and experiences of your people. Your scholarly skill affords you a quick mind. Once per day, you can attempt to Recall Knowledge as a free action.

_desc_en: You are part of the family of vishkanyas in your community tasked with keeping records of the history and experiences of your people. Your scholarly skill affords you a quick mind. Once per day, you can attempt to Recall Knowledge as a free action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 공동체 내에서 자신의 민족의 역사와 경험을 기록하는 임무를 맡은 비쉬카냐 가문의 일원입니다. 당신의 학문적 재능은 당신에게 재빠른 지성을 부여합니다. 하루에 한 번, 당신은 자유 행동으로 지식 상기를 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Nascent

description.value: While most kashrishi are fully adapted to their environment by the time they reach adulthood, some retain unrealized potential well into adulthood before unlocking it. You gain a 1st-level kashrishi ancestry feat for which you meet the prerequisites, if any.

_desc_en: While most kashrishi are fully adapted to their environment by the time they reach adulthood, some retain unrealized potential well into adulthood before unlocking it. You gain a 1st-level kashrishi ancestry feat for which you meet the prerequisites, if any.
_desc_ko: 대부분의 카쉬리시는 성인이 될 무렵이면 환경에 완전히 적응하지만, 일부는 성인이 된 후 한참까지 발현되지 않은 잠재력을 간직하다가 그것을 발현합니다. 당신은 필요한 경우 그 전제 조건을 충족하는 1레벨 카쉬리시 혈통 재주 하나를 얻습니다.

name: Winter Orc

description.value: Your ancestors survived in cold climates. You become trained in Survival, and you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

_desc_en: Your ancestors survived in cold climates. You become trained in Survival, and you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들은 추운 기후에서 살아남았습니다. 당신은 생존에 숙련되며, 환경적 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 극심한 것처럼 취급합니다(믿기지 않는 냉기는 극심함이 되고, 극심한 냉기는 심각함이 되는 식입니다).

name: Mountainkeeper Tengu

description.value: You come from a line of tengu ascetics, leaving you with a link to the spirits of the world and the Great Beyond. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash} cantrip as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Each time you cast a spell from a tengu heritage or ancestry feat, you can decide whether it's a divine or primal spell.

_desc_en: You come from a line of tengu ascetics, leaving you with a link to the spirits of the world and the Great Beyond. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash} cantrip as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Each time you cast a spell from a tengu heritage or ancestry feat, you can decide whether it's a divine or primal spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 텐구 고행자 혈통 출신으로, 세계와 위대한 저 너머의 정령들과 이어져 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.vitality-lash]{생명력 채찍} 소마법을 원시 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 동일한 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다. 텐구 유산이나 혈통 재주로부터 주문을 시전할 때마다, 당신은 그것이 신성 주문인지 원시 주문인지 결정할 수 있습니다.

name: Rite of Reinforcement

description.value:
Your woven exoskeleton rivals the hardest armors that can be found. Your exoskeleton is medium armor in the plate armor group that grants a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of -2, a speed penalty of -5 feet, and a Strength value of +3, and has the comfort trait. You can never wear other armor or remove your exoskeleton. You can etch armor runes onto your exoskeleton as normal.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.0KHgAaDi3tmu32Hq]{Rite of Reinforcement Exoskeleton}

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse
