Your woven exoskeleton rivals the hardest armors that can be found. Your exoskeleton is medium armor in the plate armor group that grants a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of -2, a speed penalty of -5 feet, and a Strength value of +3, and has the comfort trait. You can never wear other armor or remove your exoskeleton. You can etch armor runes onto your exoskeleton as normal.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.0KHgAaDi3tmu32Hq]{Rite of Reinforcement Exoskeleton}
_desc_ko:
당신의 짜인 외골격은 찾을 수 있는 가장 단단한 갑옷에 필적합니다. 당신의 외골격은 판금 갑옷 계열의 중형 갑옷으로, AC에 +4 아이템 보너스, 민첩 상한 +1, 판정 페널티 -2, 이동 속도 페널티 -5피트, 근력 수치 +3을 부여하며 편안함 특성을 지닙니다. 당신은 결코 다른 갑옷을 입거나 외골격을 벗을 수 없습니다. 당신은 통상적으로 자신의 외골격에 갑옷 룬을 새길 수 있습니다.

@link[equipment.rite-of-reinforcement-exoskeleton]{보강 의식 외골격}

name: Respite of a Thousand Roofs

description.value:
You swore a vow to shelter and feed the poor. Your vow grants you adroitness with carpentry, cook pot, and cloth; you become trained in Crafting and Cooking Lore, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3HChkcD1IRqv4DbA]{Improvise Tool} skill feat.

Additional Edict help the impoverished to the extent you're able by repairing their abodes and clothing or by feeding them

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You swore a vow to shelter and feed the poor. Your vow grants you adroitness with carpentry, cook pot, and cloth; you become trained in Crafting and Cooking Lore, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3HChkcD1IRqv4DbA]{Improvise Tool} skill feat.

Additional Edict help the impoverished to the extent you're able by repairing their abodes and clothing or by feeding them
_desc_ko:
당신은 가난한 이들을 보호하고 먹이겠다고 맹세했습니다. 당신의 맹세는 목공, 요리 냄비, 천에 대한 능숙함을 부여합니다. 당신은 제작과 요리 지식에 숙련되며, @link[feats.improvise-tool]{즉석 도구} 기술 재주를 얻습니다.

추가 계율 가능한 한도 내에서 가난한 이들의 거처와 옷을 수선하거나 그들을 먹임으로써 그들을 돕는다

name: Hardshell Surki

description.value:
Your carapace is much denser than that of other surkis, offering you a suit of your very own armor. Your carapace is medium armor in the plate armor group that grants a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of +3, and has the comfort trait. You can never wear other armor or remove your carapace. You can etch armor runes onto your carapace.

  • Evolution The magical circulatory system that runs between your nodes has become a reinforcing network that strengthens your carapace with magical energy. If you're struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage, you can use your reaction to attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17|showDC:all]. If successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.
  • Evolution Your abdominal nodes can project a field around you that guards you against the type of magic you're most familiar with. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cczvLO5r7QuHaXwx]{Dampening Harmonics} action.

_desc_en:
Your carapace is much denser than that of other surkis, offering you a suit of your very own armor. Your carapace is medium armor in the plate armor group that grants a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of +3, and has the comfort trait. You can never wear other armor or remove your carapace. You can etch armor runes onto your carapace.

  • Evolution The magical circulatory system that runs between your nodes has become a reinforcing network that strengthens your carapace with magical energy. If you're struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage, you can use your reaction to attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17|showDC:all]. If successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.
  • Evolution Your abdominal nodes can project a field around you that guards you against the type of magic you're most familiar with. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cczvLO5r7QuHaXwx]{Dampening Harmonics} action.
_desc_ko:
당신의 갑각은 다른 서키의 것보다 훨씬 밀도가 높아, 당신만의 갑옷 한 벌을 제공합니다. 당신의 갑각은 판금 갑옷 계열의 중형 갑옷으로, AC에 +4 아이템 보너스, 민첩 상한 +1, 판정 페널티 –2, 이동 속도 페널티 –5피트, 근력 수치 +3을 부여하며 편안함 특성을 지닙니다. 당신은 결코 다른 갑옷을 입거나 갑각을 벗을 수 없습니다. 당신은 자신의 갑각에 갑옷 룬을 새길 수 있습니다.

  • 진화 당신의 마디들 사이를 흐르는 마법 순환계가 마법 에너지로 당신의 갑각을 강화하는 보강 연결망이 되었습니다. 물리 피해를 입히는 대성공 공격에 맞으면, 당신은 반응행동을 사용해 @Check[flat|dc:17|showDC:all]을 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공하면 그 공격은 일반 명중이 됩니다.
  • 진화 당신의 복부 마디들은 당신 주위에 당신이 가장 익숙한 종류의 마법으로부터 당신을 지키는 장을 투사할 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.dampening-harmonics]{완충 화음} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Taloned Tengu

description.value: Your talons are every bit as sharp and strong as your beak. You gain a talons unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Your talons are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, unarmed, and versatile P traits.

_desc_en: Your talons are every bit as sharp and strong as your beak. You gain a talons unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Your talons are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, unarmed, and versatile P traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 발톱은 부리만큼이나 날카롭고 강합니다. 당신은 1d4 참격 피해를 입히는 발톱 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 발톱은 격투 계열에 속하며 민첩함, 정교함, 비무장, 다목적 P 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Thalassic Azarketi

description.value: You trace your lineage from azarketis who lived their lives among the great oceans and seas of the world. You know how to use the currents and the primal magic of water to guide your attacks. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iOY6YfGBaOvMNAor]{Underwater Marauder} skill feat, and your piercing ranged attacks don't have their range increments halved when fighting underwater targets.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en: You trace your lineage from azarketis who lived their lives among the great oceans and seas of the world. You know how to use the currents and the primal magic of water to guide your attacks. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iOY6YfGBaOvMNAor]{Underwater Marauder} skill feat, and your piercing ranged attacks don't have their range increments halved when fighting underwater targets.
_desc_ko: 당신은 세계의 거대한 대양과 바다 사이에서 삶을 보낸 아자르케티에게서 혈통을 이어받았습니다. 당신은 조류와 물의 원시 마법을 이용해 자신의 공격을 인도하는 법을 압니다. 당신은 @link[feats.underwater-marauder]{수중 약탈자} 기술 재주를 얻으며, 수중 대상과 싸울 때 당신의 관통 원거리 공격은 사거리 증가치가 절반이 되지 않습니다.

name: Deny Lady Nanbyo's Charity

description.value:
You swore a vow to release others from natural calamities. Your vow grants you the strength to carry 1 more Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered and up to a maximum of 2 more Bulk, as well as a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.

Additional Edict do your utmost to aid or rescue those trapped or affected by natural disasters

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You swore a vow to release others from natural calamities. Your vow grants you the strength to carry 1 more Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered and up to a maximum of 2 more Bulk, as well as a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.

Additional Edict do your utmost to aid or rescue those trapped or affected by natural disasters
_desc_ko:
당신은 다른 이들을 자연재해로부터 구하겠다고 맹세했습니다. 당신의 맹세는 짐 초과 상태가 되기 전까지 평소보다 1 부피를 더, 최대 2 부피까지 더 나를 수 있는 힘과 함께, @link[actions.force-open]{강제로 열기}나 @link[actions.escape]{탈출} 운동 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

추가 계율 자연재해에 갇히거나 영향을 받은 이들을 돕거나 구조하는 데 최선을 다한다

name: Ambitious Human

description.value:
You're ambitious, having accomplished more than your peers and always moving forward. You get two class abilities earlier than you normally could. Because you gain these abilities early, you can't select them again at a later level. One ability is the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ux73dmoF8KnavyUD]{Fleet} general feat. The second ability depends on your class.

  • Barbarian: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XseJI9XhKNtZN8pv]{Raging Intimidation}
  • Bard: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iX5HEqRImhKzfPR2]{Well-Versed}
  • Monk: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness}
  • Sorcerer: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.A7ofsoPva0UtjqrX]{Cantrip Expansion}

Note: This heritage is from the Beginner Box and features non-standard heritage features

publication.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

_desc_en:
You're ambitious, having accomplished more than your peers and always moving forward. You get two class abilities earlier than you normally could. Because you gain these abilities early, you can't select them again at a later level. One ability is the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ux73dmoF8KnavyUD]{Fleet} general feat. The second ability depends on your class.

  • Barbarian: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XseJI9XhKNtZN8pv]{Raging Intimidation}
  • Bard: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iX5HEqRImhKzfPR2]{Well-Versed}
  • Monk: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness}
  • Sorcerer: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.A7ofsoPva0UtjqrX]{Cantrip Expansion}

Note: This heritage is from the Beginner Box and features non-standard heritage features
_desc_ko:
당신은 야심가로, 동료들보다 더 많은 것을 이루었고 항상 앞으로 나아갑니다. 당신은 평소보다 일찍 두 개의 클래스 능력을 얻습니다. 이 능력들을 일찍 얻기 때문에, 나중 레벨에서 다시 선택할 수 없습니다. 하나의 능력은 @link[feats.fleet]{신속} 일반 재주입니다. 두 번째 능력은 당신의 클래스에 따라 달라집니다.

  • 바바리안: @link[feats.raging-intimidation]{격노의 위협}
  • 바드: @link[feats.well-versed]{박식함}
  • 몽크: @link[feats.toughness]{강인함}
  • 소서러: @link[feats.cantrip-expansion]{캔트립 확장}

참고: 이 혈통은 비기너 박스에서 나온 것으로 비표준 혈통 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Stickytoe Tripkee

description.value: Your hands and feet exude a film that helps them adhere to surfaces. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. When ascending trees, vines, and other foliage, if you roll a success on the Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your hands and feet exude a film that helps them adhere to surfaces. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. When ascending trees, vines, and other foliage, if you roll a success on the Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 손발은 표면에 달라붙는 것을 돕는 얇은 막을 분비합니다. 당신은 자신을 @link[actions.disarm]{무장 해제}, @link[actions.shove]{밀치기}, @link[actions.reposition]{위치 이동}, 또는 @link[actions.trip]{넘어뜨리기}하려는 시도에 대한 인내와 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 나무, 덩굴, 그 밖의 나뭇잎을 오를 때, 등반 운동 판정에 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Skyborn Tengu

description.value: Your bones may be especially light, you may be a rare tengu with wings, or your connection to the spirits of wind and sky might be stronger than most, slowing your descent through the air. You take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall.

_desc_en: Your bones may be especially light, you may be a rare tengu with wings, or your connection to the spirits of wind and sky might be stronger than most, slowing your descent through the air. You take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall.
_desc_ko: 당신의 뼈는 유난히 가벼울 수도 있고, 당신은 날개를 지닌 드문 텐구일 수도 있으며, 바람과 하늘의 정령과의 연결이 대부분보다 강해 공중에서의 낙하를 늦출 수도 있습니다. 당신은 낙하 거리와 상관없이 낙하로 인한 피해를 전혀 받지 않습니다.

name: Shortshanks Hobgoblin

description.value: You have a longer torso and broader shoulders than most hobgoblins, making your legs seem short by comparison. This gives you a strong, muscular core and lowers your center of gravity—features that assist you in riding and climbing—and you've trained at riding in a saddle from an extremely early age. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Rq5wkA8DtsmbzoGV]{Ride} feat. Additionally, you are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while you Climb.

_desc_en: You have a longer torso and broader shoulders than most hobgoblins, making your legs seem short by comparison. This gives you a strong, muscular core and lowers your center of gravity—features that assist you in riding and climbing—and you've trained at riding in a saddle from an extremely early age. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Rq5wkA8DtsmbzoGV]{Ride} feat. Additionally, you are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while you Climb.
_desc_ko: 당신은 대부분의 홉고블린보다 몸통이 길고 어깨가 넓어, 비교적 다리가 짧아 보입니다. 이는 당신에게 튼튼하고 근육질인 몸통과 낮은 무게 중심을 부여하며—승마와 등반을 돕는 특징입니다—당신은 아주 어릴 적부터 안장에 타는 훈련을 받아 왔습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.ride]{승마} 재주를 얻습니다. 또한 당신은 등반하는 동안 @link[conditions.off-guard]{무방비} 상태가 되지 않습니다.

name: Stoutheart Centaur

description.value: You're a hardy centaur, firm of stance and strong of heart. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8 and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} and to your Reflex DC to avoid being tripped.

_desc_en: You're a hardy centaur, firm of stance and strong of heart. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8 and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} and to your Reflex DC to avoid being tripped.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자세가 굳건하고 마음이 강인한 강건한 켄타우로스입니다. 당신은 자신의 혈통으로부터 8 대신 10 체력을 얻으며, @link[actions.balance]{균형 잡기} 곡예 판정과 넘어뜨림을 피하기 위한 반사 DC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Cloudleaper Lizardfolk

description.value: Your body is light with flaps of skin along your limbs that catch the air that passes beneath you. As long as you can act and have enough room, you can open the flaps to slow any fall just enough to avoid taking damage (whether you have the room to do so depends on the GM's discretion).

_desc_en: Your body is light with flaps of skin along your limbs that catch the air that passes beneath you. As long as you can act and have enough room, you can open the flaps to slow any fall just enough to avoid taking damage (whether you have the room to do so depends on the GM's discretion).
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 가볍고, 팔다리를 따라 아래로 지나가는 공기를 붙잡는 피부의 막이 있습니다. 행동할 수 있고 충분한 공간이 있는 한, 당신은 그 막을 펼쳐 어떤 낙하든 피해를 입지 않을 만큼 딱 늦출 수 있습니다(그럴 공간이 있는지 여부는 GM의 재량에 달려 있습니다).

name: Vigilant Goloma

description.value: You've learned to be aware of not just obvious physical dangers, but also noticeable magical threats. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. In addition, your awareness allows you to notice magical traps easier than others. Your proficiency rank in Perception is considered one step better when attempting to detect magical traps. (Trained is considered expert, expert is considered master, and master is considered legendary).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You've learned to be aware of not just obvious physical dangers, but also noticeable magical threats. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. In addition, your awareness allows you to notice magical traps easier than others. Your proficiency rank in Perception is considered one step better when attempting to detect magical traps. (Trained is considered expert, expert is considered master, and master is considered legendary).
_desc_ko: 당신은 명백한 물리적 위험뿐 아니라 눈에 띄는 마법적 위협도 인지하는 법을 배웠습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.detect-magic]{마법 탐지} 소마법을 비전 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 당신 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 동일한 주문 등급으로 상승됩니다. 또한 당신의 인식력은 다른 이들보다 마법 함정을 더 쉽게 알아차리게 해 줍니다. 마법 함정을 감지하려 시도할 때 당신의 감지 숙련도 등급은 한 단계 나은 것으로 간주됩니다. (숙련은 전문가로, 전문가는 명인으로, 명인은 전설로 간주됩니다.)

name: Warrior Jotunborn

description.value: Your hardier body made you a perfect recruit for combat. The damage die for your fist increases to 1d6. You don't take a penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist.

_desc_en: Your hardier body made you a perfect recruit for combat. The damage die for your fist increases to 1d6. You don't take a penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist.
_desc_ko: 당신의 더 강인한 몸은 당신을 전투에 완벽한 신병으로 만들었습니다. 당신의 주먹 피해 주사위가 1d6으로 증가합니다. 당신은 주먹으로 치명적인 공격을 할 때 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Dromaar

description.value: Orcish strength emboldens your bloodline. You have a green tinge to your skin and other indicators of orc heritage. You gain the orc trait, the dromaar trait, and low-light vision. When you gain an ancestry feat, you can choose from dromaar and orc feats in addition to those from your ancestry.

_desc_en: Orcish strength emboldens your bloodline. You have a green tinge to your skin and other indicators of orc heritage. You gain the orc trait, the dromaar trait, and low-light vision. When you gain an ancestry feat, you can choose from dromaar and orc feats in addition to those from your ancestry.
_desc_ko: 오크의 힘이 당신의 혈통을 대담하게 합니다. 당신은 피부에 녹색 기운이 돌며 오크 유산의 다른 지표들을 지닙니다. 당신은 오크 특성, 드로마르 특성, 그리고 저광 시야를 얻습니다. 혈통 재주를 얻을 때, 당신은 자신의 혈통 재주에 더해 드로마르 및 오크 재주 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Sensate Gnome

description.value:
You see all colors as brighter, hear all sounds as richer, and especially smell all scents with incredible detail. You gain a special sense: imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine the exact location of a creature. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks whenever you're trying to locate an undetected creature that is within the range of your scent.

_desc_en:
You see all colors as brighter, hear all sounds as richer, and especially smell all scents with incredible detail. You gain a special sense: imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine the exact location of a creature. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks whenever you're trying to locate an undetected creature that is within the range of your scent.
_desc_ko:
당신은 모든 색이 더 밝게 보이고, 모든 소리가 더 풍부하게 들리며, 특히 모든 냄새를 놀라울 만큼 세밀하게 맡습니다. 당신은 특수 감각인 사거리 30피트의 부정확한 후각을 얻습니다. 이는 후각을 사용하여 생물의 정확한 위치를 파악할 수 있음을 의미합니다. GM은 보통 당신이 생물의 바람 아래쪽에 있으면 사거리를 두 배로, 바람 위쪽에 있으면 절반으로 조정합니다.

추가로, 당신의 후각 사거리 안에 있는 미탐지 상태의 생물을 찾으려 할 때마다 감지 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Stalker Minotaur

description.value: Despite your heavy frame, you walk on shaggy hooves that muffle your footfalls, allowing you to surprise your prey. You become trained in Stealth (or another skill if you were already trained in Stealth) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.beyw5bdA5hkQbmaG]{Terrain Stalker} skill feat, except you must choose rubble and you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} no more than 10 feet instead of 5 feet without attempting a Stealth check.

_desc_en: Despite your heavy frame, you walk on shaggy hooves that muffle your footfalls, allowing you to surprise your prey. You become trained in Stealth (or another skill if you were already trained in Stealth) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.beyw5bdA5hkQbmaG]{Terrain Stalker} skill feat, except you must choose rubble and you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} no more than 10 feet instead of 5 feet without attempting a Stealth check.
_desc_ko: 당신은 육중한 체구에도 불구하고 발소리를 죽이는 텁수룩한 발굽으로 걸어, 먹잇감을 기습할 수 있습니다. 당신은 은신에 숙련됨(이미 은신에 숙련되어 있었다면 다른 기술 하나)이 되고 @link[feats.terrain-stalker]{험지 추적자} 기술 재주를 얻되, 반드시 잔해를 선택해야 하며 은신 판정 없이 @link[actions.sneak]{잠행}할 때 5피트가 아니라 10피트까지 이동할 수 있습니다.

name: Shadow Rat

description.value:
Your ancestors lived in dark spaces underground, granting you dark fur and a vaguely unnatural mien. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Intimidation and can use Intimidation to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} animals. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} an animal, you don't take a penalty for not sharing a language with it. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice.

Animals' attitudes toward you begin one degree worse than normal, usually starting at unfriendly instead of indifferent for domesticated animals, and hostile instead of unfriendly for wild animals.

_desc_en:
Your ancestors lived in dark spaces underground, granting you dark fur and a vaguely unnatural mien. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Intimidation and can use Intimidation to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} animals. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} an animal, you don't take a penalty for not sharing a language with it. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice.

Animals' attitudes toward you begin one degree worse than normal, usually starting at unfriendly instead of indifferent for domesticated animals, and hostile instead of unfriendly for wild animals.
_desc_ko:
당신의 조상들은 지하의 어두운 공간에서 살았기에, 당신은 검은 털과 어렴풋이 부자연스러운 분위기를 얻었습니다. 당신은 위협에 숙련됨 숙련도를 얻고 위협을 사용하여 동물을 @link[actions.coerce]{강압}할 수 있습니다. 당신이 동물을 @link[actions.demoralize]{위압}할 때, 언어를 공유하지 않는 것에 대한 벌점을 받지 않습니다. 만약 당신이 (배경이나 클래스 등으로) 자동으로 위협에 숙련됨이 될 경우, 대신 당신이 선택한 다른 기술에 숙련됨이 됩니다.

당신에 대한 동물의 태도는 정상보다 한 단계 나쁘게 시작하며, 가축의 경우 보통 무관심이 아니라 비우호적으로, 야생 동물의 경우 비우호적이 아니라 적대적으로 시작합니다.

name: Hooded Nagaji

description.value: You bear the hooded head of a spitting cobra, and like such cobras, you can shoot streams of venom from your mouth. You gain a venomous spit ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 10 feet that deals 1d4 poison damage. On a critical hit, the target takes persistent poison damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice. Your spit doesn't have a weapon group or a critical specialization effect.

_desc_en: You bear the hooded head of a spitting cobra, and like such cobras, you can shoot streams of venom from your mouth. You gain a venomous spit ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 10 feet that deals 1d4 poison damage. On a critical hit, the target takes persistent poison damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice. Your spit doesn't have a weapon group or a critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko: 당신은 침을 뱉는 코브라의 두건 머리를 지녔으며, 그런 코브라처럼 입에서 독액 줄기를 쏠 수 있습니다. 당신은 사거리 증가치 10피트에 1d4 독 피해를 입히는 독액 뱉기 원거리 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 결정타 시, 대상은 무기 피해 주사위 수와 같은 지속 독 피해를 받습니다. 당신의 뱉기는 무기 분류나 결정타 특화 효과를 갖지 않습니다.

name: Desert Rat

description.value: You are native to arid plains and likely grew up traveling the roads. If you have both hands free, you can increase your Speed to 30 feet as you run on all fours. In addition, environmental heat effects are one step less extreme for you, and you can go 10 times longer than normal before you are affected by starvation or thirst. However, unless you wear protective gear or take shelter, environmental cold effects are one step more extreme for you.

_desc_en: You are native to arid plains and likely grew up traveling the roads. If you have both hands free, you can increase your Speed to 30 feet as you run on all fours. In addition, environmental heat effects are one step less extreme for you, and you can go 10 times longer than normal before you are affected by starvation or thirst. However, unless you wear protective gear or take shelter, environmental cold effects are one step more extreme for you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 건조한 평원 태생이며 아마도 길을 여행하며 자랐을 것입니다. 양손이 모두 비어 있다면, 네 발로 달려 이동력을 30피트로 늘릴 수 있습니다. 추가로, 환경적 열기 효과가 당신에게 한 단계 덜 극심하게 작용하며, 굶주림이나 갈증의 영향을 받기까지 정상보다 10배 더 오래 버틸 수 있습니다. 그러나 보호 장구를 착용하거나 은신처를 취하지 않는 한, 환경적 냉기 효과는 당신에게 한 단계 더 극심하게 작용합니다.

name: Even-Tempered Tanuki

description.value: You're possessed of a serenity uncommon to other tanuki, who always seem to be flying off the handle. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success at a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead, but when you roll a failure at a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical failure instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You're possessed of a serenity uncommon to other tanuki, who always seem to be flying off the handle. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success at a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead, but when you roll a failure at a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 늘 발끈하는 것처럼 보이는 다른 너구리들에게는 드문 평온함을 지니고 있습니다. 당신은 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻지만, 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패를 굴리면 대신 대실패를 얻습니다.

name: Ant Kholo

description.value: You're a sharp-featured, big-eared kholo about 3 feet tall. Many are skeptical that you are in fact a kholo. Your size is Small instead of Medium. You are trained in Deception (or another skill if you were already trained in Deception). You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie when specifically claiming innocence, to Deception DCs against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} checks to uncover such lies, and to initiative checks when you roll Deception for initiative.

_desc_en: You're a sharp-featured, big-eared kholo about 3 feet tall. Many are skeptical that you are in fact a kholo. Your size is Small instead of Medium. You are trained in Deception (or another skill if you were already trained in Deception). You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie when specifically claiming innocence, to Deception DCs against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} checks to uncover such lies, and to initiative checks when you roll Deception for initiative.
_desc_ko: 당신은 날카로운 이목구비와 큰 귀를 가진 키 약 3피트의 콜로입니다. 많은 이들이 당신이 정말 콜로인지 의심합니다. 당신의 크기는 중형이 아니라 소형입니다. 당신은 기만에 숙련됨(이미 기만에 숙련되어 있었다면 다른 기술 하나)이 됩니다. 당신은 특히 결백을 주장하며 거짓말할 때의 기만 판정, 그런 거짓말을 밝혀내려는 @link[actions.sense-motive]{동기 간파} 판정에 대한 기만 DC, 그리고 기만으로 우선권을 굴릴 때의 우선권 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Shapewrought Fleshwarp

description.value: A victim of fleshwarping, you likely bear loose flesh, bony spurs, or features of inhuman creatures sprouting from your skin. You have nevertheless turned the psychic toll of your transformation into a strength. You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).

_desc_en: A victim of fleshwarping, you likely bear loose flesh, bony spurs, or features of inhuman creatures sprouting from your skin. You have nevertheless turned the psychic toll of your transformation into a strength. You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).
_desc_ko: 육체변형의 희생자인 당신은 아마도 늘어진 살, 뼈 돌기, 혹은 피부에서 돋아난 비인간적 생물의 특징을 지녔을 것입니다. 그럼에도 당신은 변형이 남긴 정신적 대가를 강점으로 바꾸었습니다. 당신은 자신 레벨의 절반(최소 1)과 같은 정신 피해에 대한 저항을 얻습니다.

name: Quillcoat Shisk

description.value: Your body has adapted a defensive mechanism to break off your quills in an attacker, allowing you to defend yourself against aggressive predators, though it takes a while for the quills to grow back. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.oAWNluJaMlaGysXA]{Barbed Quills} reaction.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your body has adapted a defensive mechanism to break off your quills in an attacker, allowing you to defend yourself against aggressive predators, though it takes a while for the quills to grow back. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.oAWNluJaMlaGysXA]{Barbed Quills} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 공격자에게 가시를 부러뜨려 박는 방어 기제를 발달시켜, 공격적인 포식자로부터 자신을 방어할 수 있게 되었지만, 가시가 다시 자라나는 데는 시간이 걸립니다. 당신은 @link[actions.barbed-quills]{가시 발사} 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Prismatic Vishkanya

description.value: Your scales shimmer and catch the light in an intoxicating display of colors. You become trained in Performance (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained in Performance) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7LB00jkh6JaJr3vS]{Fascinating Performance} feat.

_desc_en: Your scales shimmer and catch the light in an intoxicating display of colors. You become trained in Performance (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained in Performance) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7LB00jkh6JaJr3vS]{Fascinating Performance} feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 비늘은 반짝이며 빛을 받아 도취적인 색채의 향연을 펼칩니다. 당신은 공연에 숙련됨(이미 공연에 숙련되어 있었다면 당신이 선택한 다른 기술 하나)이 되고 @link[feats.fascinating-performance]{매혹적인 공연} 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Wishborn Poppet

description.value: You were wished to life, either by a powerful spellcaster or by the earnest desire of an innocent person who loved you very much. You're living proof that a hopeful spirit can overcome any obstacle. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion or fear effect, you get a critical success instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You were wished to life, either by a powerful spellcaster or by the earnest desire of an innocent person who loved you very much. You're living proof that a hopeful spirit can overcome any obstacle. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion or fear effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 강력한 주문시전자에 의해서든, 당신을 무척 사랑한 순수한 사람의 간절한 바람에 의해서든 소원으로 생명을 얻었습니다. 당신은 희망찬 정신이 어떤 장애물도 극복할 수 있다는 살아있는 증거입니다. 감정이나 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Monstrous Skeleton

description.value: Inhuman skeletons are often created for both their deadly physical attacks and their terrifying appearances. Beasts and monstrous humanoids with the strangest skeletons tend to be the centerpiece of the collection of a necromancer skilled enough to raise one. You gain a claw, horn, tail, or wing unarmed attack that deals 1d6 damage. A claw deals slashing damage, a horn deals piercing damage, and a tail or wing deals bludgeoning damage. This unarmed attack is in the brawling group and has the finesse and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: Inhuman skeletons are often created for both their deadly physical attacks and their terrifying appearances. Beasts and monstrous humanoids with the strangest skeletons tend to be the centerpiece of the collection of a necromancer skilled enough to raise one. You gain a claw, horn, tail, or wing unarmed attack that deals 1d6 damage. A claw deals slashing damage, a horn deals piercing damage, and a tail or wing deals bludgeoning damage. This unarmed attack is in the brawling group and has the finesse and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 비인간적 해골은 흔히 치명적인 물리 공격과 공포스러운 외형을 위해 만들어집니다. 가장 기이한 골격을 가진 야수와 괴물형 인간형은 그런 것을 일으킬 만큼 숙련된 사령술사의 수집품에서 중심이 되곤 합니다. 당신은 1d6 피해를 입히는 발톱, 뿔, 꼬리, 또는 날개 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 발톱은 참격 피해를, 뿔은 관통 피해를, 꼬리나 날개는 타격 피해를 입힙니다. 이 비무장 공격은 격투 분류에 속하며 정교함과 비무장 특성을 갖습니다.

name: Bright Fetchling

description.value: Your body proves that shadow can't exist without light. Perhaps your eyes glow brighter or your veins occasionally pulse with light. You emit dim light within 5 feet of you. You can activate or suppress this ability as an action, which has the concentrate trait. Additionally, you can force fragments of your shadow to glow and cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} as an occult innate cantrip. Cantrips are heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: Your body proves that shadow can't exist without light. Perhaps your eyes glow brighter or your veins occasionally pulse with light. You emit dim light within 5 feet of you. You can activate or suppress this ability as an action, which has the concentrate trait. Additionally, you can force fragments of your shadow to glow and cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} as an occult innate cantrip. Cantrips are heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 그림자가 빛 없이는 존재할 수 없음을 증명합니다. 어쩌면 당신의 눈이 더 밝게 빛나거나 혈관이 이따금 빛으로 고동칠지도 모릅니다. 당신은 자신 주변 5피트 이내에 흐릿한 빛을 냅니다. 당신은 정신집중 특성을 가진 행동으로 이 능력을 활성화하거나 억제할 수 있습니다. 추가로, 당신은 그림자 조각들을 빛나게 하여 @link[spells.light]{빛}을 신비계 선천 소마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 자신 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 같은 주문 등급으로 강화됩니다.

name: Gourd Leshy

description.value: You have a large gourd for a skull, and since you don't have a physical brain, you can use the space inside your head. You can store a collection of up to 1 Bulk of objects within your head. The DC of checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} objects from inside your head increases by 4. Additionally, if you store only one object within your head, you can draw it effortlessly into your hand as part of another action to use the object. Drawing the item grants this other action the manipulate trait.

_desc_en: You have a large gourd for a skull, and since you don't have a physical brain, you can use the space inside your head. You can store a collection of up to 1 Bulk of objects within your head. The DC of checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} objects from inside your head increases by 4. Additionally, if you store only one object within your head, you can draw it effortlessly into your hand as part of another action to use the object. Drawing the item grants this other action the manipulate trait.
_desc_ko: 당신은 두개골로 커다란 박을 지니고 있으며, 물리적인 뇌가 없으므로 머릿속 공간을 활용할 수 있습니다. 당신은 머릿속에 최대 1 부피의 물건 모음을 보관할 수 있습니다. 당신의 머릿속에서 물건을 @link[actions.steal]{훔치기} 위한 판정의 DC는 4만큼 증가합니다. 추가로, 머릿속에 단 하나의 물건만 보관하는 경우, 그 물건을 사용하기 위한 다른 행동의 일부로 손쉽게 손으로 뽑아낼 수 있습니다. 이 물건을 뽑는 행위는 그 다른 행동에 조작 특성을 부여합니다.

name: Deep Orc

description.value: Your calloused hands and red eyes speak to a life spent in the deep darkness of mountain caverns, where you learned to battle on rocky cliffs and survive with minimal resources. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4tTkRyOQ0VuRBac3]{Terrain Expertise} skill feat for underground terrain and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} skill feat.

_desc_en: Your calloused hands and red eyes speak to a life spent in the deep darkness of mountain caverns, where you learned to battle on rocky cliffs and survive with minimal resources. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4tTkRyOQ0VuRBac3]{Terrain Expertise} skill feat for underground terrain and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 굳은살 박인 손과 붉은 눈은 산악 동굴의 깊은 어둠 속에서 보낸 삶을 말해주며, 그곳에서 당신은 바위 절벽에서 싸우고 최소한의 자원으로 생존하는 법을 배웠습니다. 당신은 지하 지형에 대한 @link[feats.terrain-expertise]{지형 전문성} 기술 재주와 @link[feats.combat-climber]{전투 등반가} 기술 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Leungli

description.value: You have the head of a goldfish or carp and scales that come in an auspicious combination of stark white, black, orange, red, and gold. If you gain wings, they appear much like the wispy hairs of a dragon. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and the amphibious trait. Like all creatures with the amphibious trait, you can breathe both water and air.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You have the head of a goldfish or carp and scales that come in an auspicious combination of stark white, black, orange, red, and gold. If you gain wings, they appear much like the wispy hairs of a dragon. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and the amphibious trait. Like all creatures with the amphibious trait, you can breathe both water and air.
_desc_ko: 당신은 금붕어나 잉어의 머리를 지녔으며, 새하얀색, 검은색, 주황색, 빨간색, 금색이 상서롭게 어우러진 비늘을 가지고 있습니다. 만약 당신이 날개를 얻는다면, 그것은 용의 가느다란 수염처럼 보일 것입니다. 당신은 10피트의 수영 이동력과 양서 특성을 얻습니다. 양서 특성을 가진 모든 생물처럼, 당신은 물과 공기 모두에서 호흡할 수 있습니다.

name: Vicious Goloma

description.value: The chitin on your hands forms powerful claws that allow you to defend yourself. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: The chitin on your hands forms powerful claws that allow you to defend yourself. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 손에 돋은 갑각이 강력한 발톱을 이루어 자신을 방어할 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 1d6 참격 피해를 입히는 발톱 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 발톱은 격투 분류에 속하며 민첩함, 정교함, 비무장 특성을 갖습니다.

name: Windweb Tripkee

description.value: Tough webbing along your hands and toes can slow any fall. As long as you have one hand free, you take no falling damage, regardless of the distance you fall.

_desc_en: Tough webbing along your hands and toes can slow any fall. As long as you have one hand free, you take no falling damage, regardless of the distance you fall.
_desc_ko: 손과 발가락을 따라 나 있는 질긴 거미줄이 어떤 추락도 늦출 수 있습니다. 한 손이 비어 있는 한, 당신은 떨어지는 거리와 상관없이 낙하 피해를 받지 않습니다.

name: Wildwood Halfling

description.value: You hail from deep within a jungle or forest, and you've learned how to use your small size to wriggle through undergrowth and other obstacles. You ignore any difficult terrain caused by plants and fungi, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth.

_desc_en: You hail from deep within a jungle or forest, and you've learned how to use your small size to wriggle through undergrowth and other obstacles. You ignore any difficult terrain caused by plants and fungi, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth.
_desc_ko: 당신은 정글이나 숲 깊은 곳 출신으로, 작은 체구를 이용해 덤불과 다른 장애물 사이를 비집고 나아가는 법을 익혔습니다. 당신은 덤불, 덩굴, 잡목 등 식물과 균류로 인한 험지를 모두 무시합니다.

name: Warrior Automaton

description.value: Sporting a bulkier, powerful design, your body has been designed for combat. You have a bulky, humanoid shape. The damage die for your fist increases to 1d6 instead of 1d4. You don't take a penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist or any other unarmed attack.

_desc_en: Sporting a bulkier, powerful design, your body has been designed for combat. You have a bulky, humanoid shape. The damage die for your fist increases to 1d6 instead of 1d4. You don't take a penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist or any other unarmed attack.
_desc_ko: 더 육중하고 강력한 설계를 뽐내는 당신의 몸은 전투를 위해 설계되었습니다. 당신은 육중한 인간형 형태를 지닙니다. 당신의 주먹 피해 주사위는 1d4가 아니라 1d6으로 증가합니다. 당신은 주먹이나 다른 어떤 비무장 공격으로 치명적 공격을 할 때 벌점을 받지 않습니다.

name: Born of Vegetation

description.value:
You were a plant or fungi until the rain gifted you a mind. You gain your choice of the plant or fungus trait.

  • Humanoid Form With fresh vegetation, you can better aid those in need. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}.
  • Yaoguai Form When anyone uses the Medicine skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat your Wounds}, add your level to the Hit Points you regain from that treatment. Additionally, the creature attempting the check gains a +1 circumstance bonus if you have the plant trait and are in bright light, or the fungus trait and are in darkness.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You were a plant or fungi until the rain gifted you a mind. You gain your choice of the plant or fungus trait.

  • Humanoid Form With fresh vegetation, you can better aid those in need. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}.
  • Yaoguai Form When anyone uses the Medicine skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat your Wounds}, add your level to the Hit Points you regain from that treatment. Additionally, the creature attempting the check gains a +1 circumstance bonus if you have the plant trait and are in bright light, or the fungus trait and are in darkness.
_desc_ko:
당신은 비가 정신을 선사하기 전까지 식물이나 균류였습니다. 당신은 식물 또는 균류 특성 중 하나를 선택해 얻습니다.

  • 인간형 형태 싱싱한 초목으로, 당신은 도움이 필요한 이들을 더 잘 도울 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.administer-first-aid]{응급 처치} 시의 의술 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.
  • 요괴 형태 누군가가 의술 기술로 당신의 @link[actions.treat-wounds]{부상 치료}를 할 때, 그 치료로 당신이 회복하는 체력에 당신의 레벨을 더합니다. 추가로, 당신이 식물 특성을 지니고 밝은 빛 속에 있거나, 균류 특성을 지니고 어둠 속에 있을 경우, 판정을 시도하는 생물은 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Hopeful Athamaru

description.value: You have begun to prepare yourself to become an athamaru matriarch, and are likely stepping outside of your community to better prepare yourself as a leader. As part of the physical change, you are substantially taller than you once were. Instead of Medium, your size is Large. In addition, you instill your allies with a feeling of hopefulness. You have a 10-foot aura that grants any ally in it a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fear; this is an emotion and mental effect.

_desc_en: You have begun to prepare yourself to become an athamaru matriarch, and are likely stepping outside of your community to better prepare yourself as a leader. As part of the physical change, you are substantially taller than you once were. Instead of Medium, your size is Large. In addition, you instill your allies with a feeling of hopefulness. You have a 10-foot aura that grants any ally in it a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fear; this is an emotion and mental effect.
_desc_ko: 당신은 아타마루 여족장이 될 준비를 시작했으며, 지도자로서 더 잘 준비하기 위해 아마도 자신의 공동체 밖으로 발을 내딛고 있을 것입니다. 신체적 변화의 일환으로, 당신은 예전보다 눈에 띄게 키가 커졌습니다. 당신의 크기는 중형이 아니라 대형입니다. 추가로, 당신은 아군에게 희망의 감정을 불어넣습니다. 당신은 10피트 오라를 지니며, 그 안의 모든 아군에게 공포에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여합니다. 이는 감정 및 정신 효과입니다.

name: Ancient-Blooded Dwarf

description.value: Dwarven heroes of old could shrug off their enemies' magic, and some of that resistance manifests in you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8w6esW689NNbbq3i]{Call on Ancient Blood} reaction.

_desc_en: Dwarven heroes of old could shrug off their enemies' magic, and some of that resistance manifests in you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8w6esW689NNbbq3i]{Call on Ancient Blood} reaction.
_desc_ko: 옛 드워프 영웅들은 적의 마법을 떨쳐낼 수 있었으며, 그 저항력의 일부가 당신에게 발현됩니다. 당신은 @link[actions.call-on-ancient-blood]{고대의 피 호출} 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Rite of Passage

description.value: Your exoskeleton remains connected with the plants that created it. You can ignore difficult terrain and uneven ground caused by undergrowth. In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to Balance on narrow surfaces or uneven ground within forests, you aren't off-guard. When you roll a success attempting one of these Acrobatics checks, you get a critical success instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your exoskeleton remains connected with the plants that created it. You can ignore difficult terrain and uneven ground caused by undergrowth. In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to Balance on narrow surfaces or uneven ground within forests, you aren't off-guard. When you roll a success attempting one of these Acrobatics checks, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 외골격은 그것을 만든 식물들과 여전히 연결되어 있습니다. 당신은 잡목으로 인한 험지와 울퉁불퉁한 지면을 무시할 수 있습니다. 추가로, 숲속에서 좁은 표면이나 울퉁불퉁한 지면 위를 곡예 기술로 균형 잡을 때, 당신은 무방비 상태가 되지 않습니다. 이 곡예 판정 중 하나를 시도하여 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Elusive Vishkanya

description.value: Your flexible body seems unnaturally fluid to some, though they can rarely put a finger on what seems strange about you. You can escape foes with ease. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}. Additionally, you move twice as fast when Squeezing.

_desc_en: Your flexible body seems unnaturally fluid to some, though they can rarely put a finger on what seems strange about you. You can escape foes with ease. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}. Additionally, you move twice as fast when Squeezing.
_desc_ko: 당신의 유연한 몸은 일부에게 부자연스러울 만큼 유동적으로 보이지만, 그들은 무엇이 이상한지 좀처럼 짚어내지 못합니다. 당신은 적으로부터 쉽게 벗어날 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.escape]{탈출} 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 추가로, 당신은 비집고 나아갈 때 두 배 빠르게 이동합니다.

name: Shadow of the Hermit

description.value: Your shadow seems somehow full of secrets and mysteries—secrets that it shares with you. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your shadow seems somehow full of secrets and mysteries—secrets that it shares with you. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신의 그림자는 어쩐지 비밀과 신비로 가득 차 있는 듯하며, 그 비밀들을 당신과 나눕니다. 신비계 주문 목록에서 소마법 하나를 선택하십시오. 당신은 이 주문을 무제한으로 신비계 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 소마법은 자신 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 같은 주문 등급으로 강화됩니다.

name: Fleetwind Centaur

description.value: You're sleek of frame and capable of reaching incredible speeds on hooves alone. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

_desc_en: You're sleek of frame and capable of reaching incredible speeds on hooves alone. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 날렵한 체구를 지녔으며 발굽만으로 놀라운 속도에 도달할 수 있습니다. 당신의 이동력이 5피트 증가합니다.

name: Bloodhound Shoony

description.value:
Your ancestors were famous trackers, and you carry in your blood that same gift of the hunt.

You gain a special sense: imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine the location of a creature, but it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} creatures that you have previously sensed with your scent.

_desc_en:
Your ancestors were famous trackers, and you carry in your blood that same gift of the hunt.

You gain a special sense: imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine the location of a creature, but it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} creatures that you have previously sensed with your scent.
_desc_ko:
당신의 조상들은 이름난 추적자였으며, 당신은 그 사냥의 재능을 피 속에 지니고 있습니다.

당신은 특수 감각인 사거리 30피트의 부정확한 후각을 얻습니다. 이는 후각을 사용하여 생물의 위치를 파악할 수 있지만, 그 생물은 @link[conditions.hidden]{은닉} 상태로 남는다는 것을 의미합니다.

추가로, 당신은 이전에 후각으로 감지한 적이 있는 생물을 @link[actions.track]{추적}하기 위한 생존 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Ancient Scale Azarketi

description.value:
Your lineage stems from azarketis who remain dedicated to their deep-sea roots. Divorced from land society, you're a foreigner to any world above a thousand fathoms deep. You gain darkvision.

Your body is dotted with phosphorescent spots that emit a guiding light and help you communicate. The spots - located primarily on your face, arms, and hands - illuminate a 10-foot radius around you with dim light. You can activate, deactivate, or change the arrangement of lights as an action, which has the concentration trait.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en:
Your lineage stems from azarketis who remain dedicated to their deep-sea roots. Divorced from land society, you're a foreigner to any world above a thousand fathoms deep. You gain darkvision.

Your body is dotted with phosphorescent spots that emit a guiding light and help you communicate. The spots - located primarily on your face, arms, and hands - illuminate a 10-foot radius around you with dim light. You can activate, deactivate, or change the arrangement of lights as an action, which has the concentration trait.
_desc_ko:
당신의 혈통은 심해의 뿌리에 여전히 헌신하는 아자르케티에서 비롯됩니다. 육지 사회와 단절된 당신은 수심 1천 패덤 위의 어떤 세계에도 이방인입니다. 당신은 암시야를 얻습니다.

당신의 몸은 길잡이 빛을 내고 의사소통을 돕는 인광 점들로 덮여 있습니다. 주로 얼굴, 팔, 손에 위치한 이 점들은 당신 주변 반경 10피트를 흐릿한 빛으로 밝힙니다. 당신은 정신집중 특성을 가진 행동으로 이 빛들을 활성화, 비활성화, 또는 배열을 변경할 수 있습니다.

name: Skilled Human

description.value: Your ingenuity allows you to train in a wide variety of skills. You become trained in one skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become an expert in the chosen skill.

_desc_en: Your ingenuity allows you to train in a wide variety of skills. You become trained in one skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become an expert in the chosen skill.
_desc_ko: 당신의 독창성은 다양한 기술을 익힐 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 당신이 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됨이 됩니다. 5레벨에, 당신은 선택한 기술의 전문가가 됩니다.

name: Draxie

description.value: You are kin to faerie dragons, tracing your heritage back to the death of the mightiest faerie dragon in the First World. You gain touch telepathy, allowing you to communicate silently and purely mentally with any creature you're touching, as long as you share a language.

_desc_en: You are kin to faerie dragons, tracing your heritage back to the death of the mightiest faerie dragon in the First World. You gain touch telepathy, allowing you to communicate silently and purely mentally with any creature you're touching, as long as you share a language.
_desc_ko: 당신은 요정 용의 친족으로, 그 유산을 제1세계에서 가장 강대했던 요정 용의 죽음까지 거슬러 올라가 추적할 수 있습니다. 당신은 접촉 텔레파시를 얻어, 언어를 공유하는 한 접촉하고 있는 어떤 생물과도 조용히 순전히 정신적으로 의사소통할 수 있습니다.
